title: Senior Analyst, Strategy Monitoring & Analytics (L09)
description:
**Title**
- Senior Analyst, Strategy Monitoring & Analytics (L09)
  
  
**Company Overview:**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.
  
  

* We have recently been ranked #2 among India’s Best Companies to Work for by Great Place to Work. We were among the Top 50 India’s Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All by GPTW and Top 25 among Best Workplaces in BFSI by GPTW. We have also been recognized by AmbitionBox Employee Choice Awards among the Top 20 Mid-Sized Companies, ranked #3 among Top Rated Companies for Women, and Top-Rated Financial Services Companies.
* We provide best-in-class employee benefits and programs that cater to work-life integration and overall well-being.
* We provide career advancement and upskilling opportunities, focusing on Advancing Diverse Talent to take up leadership roles.

**Organizational Overview**
Our Analytics organization comprises of data analysts who focus on enabling strategies to enhance customer and partner experience and optimize business performance through data management and development of full stack descriptive to prescriptive analytics solutions using cutting edge technologies thereby enabling business growth
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The
**Senior Analyst, Strategy Monitoring & Analytics**
, is part of the Strategy Monitoring pillar of the Model Operations & Analytics (MO&A) Center of Excellence and focuses on executing upon customer decisioning strategies. The analyst supports the maintenance of timely and accurate performance reporting, documenting results for governance and credit forums and identifying performance variances. This role also aligns closely with the Strategy Monitoring lead, executing on strategy changes and collaborating with strategy owners directly on KPIs and performance metrics.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Provide monitoring results for strategy changes relative to expected outcomes
* Adhere to and maintain alignment between model changes and strategy updates
* Support collaboration with strategy owners to define KPIs, dashboards, and real-time reporting tools for strategy monitoring
* Prepare inputs for strategy risk reports, audit reviews, and regulatory requests, ensuring traceability and completeness of monitoring evidence.
* Work cross functionally with strategy leads to support their analytics of strategies and models
* Support business leaders in driving timely course corrections due to execution gaps or divergence from strategic targets.
* Perform segmentation, cohort analysis, and experimentation to evaluate strategy impact.
* Adhere to governance principles over strategic initiative reviews and reporting cycles.
* Leverage tools such as SQL, Tableau, or Python to monitor trends and deliver insights that influence strategic recalibration.
* Maintain awareness of internal control and regulatory standards.
* Prepare inputs for mode/strategy risk reports, audit reviews, and regulatory requests, ensuring traceability and completeness of monitoring evidence.
* Participate in cross-functional working sessions to evaluate monitoring outcomes and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of analytics experience in areas such as strategy analytics, credit risk, business performance monitoring, or decision science in a financial services or regulated environment; or lieu of a Degree, a High School diploma / GED and a minimum of 4+ years of analytics experience in areas such as strategy analytics, credit risk, business performance monitoring, or decision science in a financial services or regulated
* 2 years of experience working with tools such as SQL, Tableau, Python, or other analytics and visualization platforms, with experience delivering actionable insights to senior audiences.
* Good critical thinking skills with analytical problem-solving mindset
* Ability and flexibility to travel for business as required

**Desired Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, analytical, or business-related discipline (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Finance, Data Science, Business Analytics)
* Strong verbal and written communication and detailed-oriented documentation
* Strong understanding of the consumer credit lending lifecycle and card programs
* Ability to effectively share knowledge by translating complex, technical subject matter
* Strong understanding of model evaluation metrics such as precision, recall, F1
* Familiarity with modeling approaches such as logistic regression, XGBoost and tree ensembles
* Understanding of the Lines of Defense (2nd Line Strategy Validation and 3rd Line Internal Audit)
* Familiarity with model governance frameworks, regulatory expectations, and internal audit processes (e.g., SR 11-7 compliance, , Model Risk Management policies MRM policies).

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree and 2+ years of analytics experience in areas such as strategy analytics, credit risk, business performance monitoring, or decision science in a financial services or regulated environment; or lieu of a Degree, a High School diploma / GED and a minimum of 4+ years of analytics experience in areas such as strategy analytics, credit risk, business performance monitoring, or decision science in a financial services or regulated

**Work Timings:**
**2PM to 11PM IST**
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs)
  
  
We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
  
  
Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.
  
  
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager and HRM before applying for any role on Workday.
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, other skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP)
* L7 Employees who have completed 12 months in the organization and 12 months in their current role and level are only eligible.
* L8+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in their current role and level are only eligible.
* L07+ Employees can apply.

**Grade/Level: 09**
**Job Family Group**
Data Analytics

title: AVP,  Supplier Risk & Analytics Lead (L10)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Supplier Risk & Analytics Lead (L10)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Role will be part of the Synchrony India Finance team under the Source to Pay team, which is responsible for managing the full cycle of supplier activity, including supplier risk management.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The AVP, Supplier Risk and Analytics Lead reports to the VP, Supplier Evaluation, QA and Analytics Leader, and has responsibility for executing supplier evaluations and assisting in QA activities and supporting governance routines for supplier performance and quality. Responsibilities are carried out within established frameworks and procedures, with independent problem resolution and disciplined stakeholder management.

* Oversee execution of specific due diligence activities, such as background and reputational evaluations, in collaboration with subject matter experts, across multiple risk disciplines.
* Lead components of supplier due diligence and ongoing monitoring maturation efforts with a focus on simplification, disciplined execution, and regulatory compliance.
* Develop, enhance, and maintain program documentation (internal procedures and external-facing job aids for Program Participants) to promote consistent and disciplined execution across the organization.
* Collaborate with governance and control functions including Legal, Compliance, Operational Risk, Internal Audit, and Source to Pay partners to ensure program alignment and compliance.
* Cross train with Supplier Evaluation team members to provide backup for vacations and staffing changes.
* Support Regulatory, Audit, and other requests for data and documentation, participate in examinations/audits as necessary
* Develop and present periodic reports to Senior Management, including risk trends that can be obtained from monitoring activities
* Demonstrate deep, up-to-date knowledge of regulatory compliance of the financial services sector
* Execute other duties as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree with 5+ years financial services industry experience or in lieu of a bachelor’s degree 7+ years financial services industry experience
* 3+ years of previous process management/leadership experience
* Experience with risk management concepts, including supplier management and monitoring
* Experience with Coupa and its related modules (example: Core, Coupa Risk Assessments, etc.); or similar Third-Party Risk Management tools
* Strong facilitation and problem solving
* Proficient in Excel including pivot tables and complex conditional formulas
* Direct experience providing business requirements and performing user acceptance testing
* Ability to work in complex environments and utilize tools and Artificial Intelligence to enhance processes and procedures
* Strong Communication skills, including ability to communicate to all levels of the organization verbally, in writing and through PowerPoint presentations.
* Goal-oriented and must be self-motivated and able to work undirected

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Direct experience at a Bank, Financial Institution, or major supplier to Financial Services industry
* Experience with Supplier Management and Supplier Management business tools preferably within financial services industry.
* Demonstrated experience influencing and working effectively with senior management and peers to launch new processes or improve existing
* Demonstrated ability to solve open-ended problems with minimal direction from initial idea through full implementation
* Intelligence gathering background, preferably of suppliers supporting financial industry
* Project management experience driving project execution through planning, tracking, reporting, and control
* Direct experience providing business requirements and performing user acceptance testing
* Strong analytical, risk management, and problem-solving skills with ability to summarize data, identify trends, evaluate risk/opportunities and innovate
* Demonstrated independent strategic thinking
* Self-motivated, strong sense of urgency, ability to energize others to act
* Excellent organization, prioritization, and detail-oriented skills
* Customer service mindset. Team player and proven ability to work cross functionally as well as within own function
* Experience defining technical requirements
* Demonstrated success in managing time and achieving stretch goals in a varied and high pressure work environment

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor's degree with 5+ years financial services industry experience or in lieu of a bachelor’s degree 7+ years financial services industry experience

**Work Timings: 5:30 AM to 2:30 PM EST**

title: Lead Business Analyst
description:
We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with 8-12 years of experience in Banking, NBFC, or FinTech organizations to drive digital transformation initiatives across Mobile Banking and Super App platforms. The incumbent will be responsible for understanding business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and ensuring successful implementation of digital products, payment solutions, and customer journeys.

The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, product teams, technology partners, vendors, and QA teams to deliver customer-centric and regulatory-compliant digital solutions.

**Principal Accountabilities**

* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business requirements for Mobile Banking, Digital Banking, and Super App initiatives.
* Partner with business, product, operations, compliance, and technology teams to define functional and non-functional requirements.
* Prepare detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), User Stories, Use Cases, Process Flows, and Gap Analysis documents.
* Work closely with UI/UX teams to design and optimize customer journeys, onboarding flows, and digital experiences.
* Collaborate with internal development teams and external vendors to ensure accurate translation of business requirements into technology solutions.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Support API definition, integration requirements, and system interaction discussions across multiple platforms and channels.
* Facilitate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), coordinate testing activities, track defects, and ensure successful business sign-off.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks, dependencies, and issues, and work with stakeholders to drive timely resolutions.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements, including RBI guidelines, digital lending regulations, and information security standards.
* Analyze customer feedback, usage trends, and business metrics to identify opportunities for product enhancements and process improvements.
* Support rollout, implementation, and post-production stabilization activities for digital banking initiatives.

**Qualification, Experience & Skills – Desired Profile of the Candidate**

**Qualifications:**

BE / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related disciplines.

**Experience:**

* 8-12 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Implementation Specialist, or Product Analyst in Banking, NBFC, FinTech, or Digital Payments domain.
* Proven experience in Mobile Banking, Super App, or Digital Financial Services implementations.
* Hands-on experience delivering payment-related projects such as: UPI, BBPS, Other Payments, Account Aggregator integrations, Digital onboarding journeys
* Experience working with cross-functional teams and leading requirement discussions from concept through implementation.
* Strong understanding of API-based integrations, microservices architecture concepts, and third-party ecosystem integrations.
* Experience using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Visio, Draw.io, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Experience preparing BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Process Maps, Functional Specifications, and UAT documentation.
* Prior experience in Banking or NBFC organizations will be preferred.
* Exposure to modern FinTech and digital-first platforms will be an added advantage.

**Technical & Functional Skills**

**Digital Banking & Payments**

* Strong understanding of Mobile Banking and Digital Channel ecosystem.
* Knowledge of UPI, BBPS, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, merchant payments, bill payments, and QR-based transactions.
* Understanding of customer onboarding, eKYC, CKYC, Video KYC, and lending journeys.
* Familiarity with authentication and authorization mechanisms including OTP, MPIN, biometrics, and device binding.

**Business Analysis**

* Requirement gathering and stakeholder management.
* Process modelling and business process re-engineering.
* Gap analysis and solution design.
* User story writing and acceptance criteria definition.
* UAT planning and execution support.

**Technical Understanding**

* API concepts and integration workflows.
* Basic SQL and data analysis.
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Understanding of system integrations and digital architecture.

title: VP - Salesforce Tech Lead - IB Tech and CRM/ Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
About IB Technology:
  
  
IB Tech, CRM & Analytics is a strategic, agile and cross-functional team responsible for leading the firm's global digitalization effort through innovative technology, data science and deep analytics. The team partners with all client-facing business units and corporate functions, as well as industry experts, to build transformational technology impacting investment banking, trading, sales, and research teams to drive revenue, maximize efficiency, and optimize client service.
  
  
We are at the forefront of Jefferies' cloud initiative, leveraging best-in-class cloud-based technologies to replace legacy on-premises solutions to provide intelligent trend insights, actionable opportunities, decision support, and transparency into all client and business-related activities.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a VP, Salesforce Engineer, you will own the design and delivery of complex, end-to-end solutions on the Salesforce platform - integration orchestration, compliance-grade workflows, and custom framework extensions within a large-scale enterprise org. You operate independently: given a problem, you determine the technical approach and present architectural trade-offs. You will work within a global engineering team, coordinating across time zones, driving technical decisions, and ensuring work holds up at a scale. This role demands deep expertise, strong engineering judgment, and the ability to lead through delivery in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Hands-On Development: Design and build complex functionality using Apex, LWC, Flows, and process automation - balancing declarative and custom coding. Contribute to data model design and architecture decisions that support long-term scalability.
* Integration Engineering: Develop and maintain integration using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Named Credentials, and External Objects.
* Global Coordination: Collaborate daily with a distributed engineering team across multiple geographies. Communicate clearly on technical approach, dependencies, and delivery timelines. Participate actively in Agile ceremonies.
* Code Quality & Platform Health: Write robust, well-tested code. Participate in peer code reviews. Develop with governor limits and org health in mind - optimized queries, bulkification, and appropriate async processing at scale.
* Troubleshooting: Perform root-cause analysis and debug complex problems across Apex, LWC, and integration layers with urgency and precision.

Mandatory Qualifications & Skills:
  
  

* Custom Framework Experience: Worked within a large, heavily customized Salesforce org, config-driven UI frameworks, custom LWC component libraries, metadata-driven layouts. Experience integrating third-party JS libraries inside LWC shadow DOM
* Advanced Apex & Async Processing: Triggers, batch, Queueable chains, future methods, platform events - all at scale with governor limits in mind. Built parallel callout orchestration to multiple external systems with partial failure handling.
* LWC (Beyond Basics): Component composition, custom event architecture, imperative Apex, dynamic rendering, cross-component state management. Strong JS/HTML/CSS - can take a custom design and build it accurately in Lightning.
* Multi-Pattern Integration: REST APIs, SOAP, Named Credentials, file ingestion, legacy adapters. Understands retry logic and contract-first design.
* Data Modelling for Scale & Compliance: Complex parent-child hierarchies, Custom Metadata as config (not just settings), JSON serialization for data capture, SOQL optimized for volume. Have built systems where data correctness has regulatory consequences.
* Engineering Fundamentals: Git workflows (branching, PRs, conflict resolution), IDE + SF CLI, SOLID principles, Agile with distributed teams. Communicates technical decisions clearly across time zones.
* Good to have - working knowledge of TypeScript; experience with test automation; familiarity with AWS services (Lambda, S3, API Gateway); Financial Services exposure.

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
  
  
At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
  
  
Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

title: Risk Analytics - Audit Analytics - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Audit Analytics - Manager**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Manager – Audit Analytics, you will lead the design and delivery of data analytics solutions across Internal Audit, risk and controls engagements. You will partner with audit, business, technology and data stakeholders to translate risk and control objectives into scalable analytical solutions while providing technical oversight and driving high-quality delivery across teams.
  
  
The role provides an opportunity to drive Internal Audit transformation through data analytics, automation, Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM), AI/GenAI and modern data technologies. You will also contribute to business development through solutioning, proposals and RFPs, effort estimation, solution architecture and commercial discussions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of audit analytics, from understanding audit objectives and identifying data requirements through development, validation and presentation of results.
* Drive Internal Audit transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities to embed analytics, automation, AI/GenAI and technology-enabled approaches across the audit lifecycle.
* Lead solutioning for proposals, RFPs and RFIs, including understanding requirements, defining the analytics approach, developing solution architecture, estimating effort and supporting pricing and commercial discussions.
* Translate business, audit, risk and control requirements into analytical approaches, test logic, KRIs and exception scenarios.
* Provide technical direction and review across SQL, Python, ETL, Power BI and Snowflake/Databricks-based analytical solutions.
* Lead data profiling, transformation, reconciliation and validation activities across large and complex enterprise datasets.
* Design and oversee development of Power BI dashboards and analytical reporting that translate complex findings into clear risk and business insights.
* Partner with Internal Audit, business, technology and data stakeholders to identify data sources, resolve data challenges and drive analytics delivery.
* Review analytical logic, outputs and documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, scalability and alignment with audit objectives.
* Identify opportunities for automation, reusable analytics and Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM).
* Manage delivery plans, priorities, risks, resources and stakeholder expectations across multiple analytics initiatives.
* Coach and guide team members on analytics development, risk understanding and delivery quality.
* Allocate work, provide technical oversight and ensure teams have the appropriate direction and support to deliver against engagement objectives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong experience leading Audit Analytics, Risk Analytics, Controls Analytics or similar data analytics engagements.
* Strong understanding of Internal Audit, risk and controls concepts, including risk assessment, control testing, KRIs, exception testing and audit analytics.
* Experience with RFP/RFI responses, solutioning, effort estimation, proposal development and pricing for analytics, Internal Audit or risk-related engagements.
* Strong hands-on understanding of SQL, with the ability to design and review complex analytical queries, data transformations and testing logic.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, transformation, statistical modelling, automation and development of scalable analytical solutions.
* Strong understanding of ETL, data transformation, data quality and reconciliation techniques.
* Experience designing and reviewing dashboards and analytical solutions using Power BI.
* Strong experience working with Snowflake and/or Databricks in enterprise data environments.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI solutions and Large Language Models (LLMs), with the ability to identify opportunities for their application across analytics, audit and risk management engagements.
* Experience driving or contributing to Internal Audit transformation through adoption of analytics, automation, continuous monitoring and modern data technologies.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate analytical approaches, technical concepts and findings to audit, business and leadership stakeholders.
* Strong project and team management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and guide teams toward high-quality delivery.
* Have experience across business and technology processes such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P/PTP), Order-to-Cash (O2C/OTC), Travel & Expense (T&E), ITGC and SOX controls.
* Have experience working with enterprise systems and datasets such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, expense platforms, GRC tools or other ERP environments.
* We are looking for an experienced Audit Analytics leader who combines strong technical expertise with a sound understanding of Internal Audit, risk and controls. You should be comfortable leading end-to-end analytics delivery, providing technical direction to teams and translating complex analytical findings into clear risk and business insights.
* You should bring a solution-oriented and transformation mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities for analytics, automation, AI/GenAI and continuous monitoring across the Internal Audit lifecycle. The role also requires strong stakeholder management and commercial capabilities to contribute to proposals, RFPs, solutioning and development of scalable analytics offerings.

**What We Offer You**

title: Data Analytics Engineer I
description:
**Job Purpose**
Design and deliver data transformation pipelines, semantic models, and BI solutions that enable reliable, self-service analytics across the organization. The role bridges data engineering and business intelligence, owning the analytical data layer from source transformation through to governed, business-ready reporting assets.
  
  
Key Result Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and maintain modular, well-tested ELT pipelines using tools such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
* Build and maintain the semantic/analytical data layer in Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric, including fact and dimension tables, conformed metrics, and reusable dbt models.
* Develop production-grade Power BI reports and dashboards, including well-structured data models, DAX measures, and row-level security configurations.
* Define and implement data quality rules, testing frameworks, and monitoring to ensure accuracy and consistency of analytics outputs.

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued
  
  

* Collaborate with data analysts, business stakeholders, and data engineers to translate reporting requirements into robust, governed data assets.
* Apply and enforce dimensional modelling principles (star schema, slowly changing dimensions) to support efficient BI consumption.
* Work within Azure and Snowflake environments to manage datasets, optimize query performance, and control data access.
* Maintain clear documentation for all pipelines, semantic models, metric definitions, and report logic.
* Participate actively in code reviews and contribute to improving team standards for analytics engineering.

**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
* Fluent in English Language.
* ITIL Certification is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Strong SQL skills and solid working knowledge of Python for data transformation tasks.
* Working knowledge of dbt for transformation layer development, including tests, documentation, and lineage.
* Hands-on experience with Power BI: data modelling, DAX, report design, and workspace governance.
* Demonstrable experience delivering Power BI solutions in a professional setting.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric or Azure Data Factory for pipeline orchestration and data movement.
* Solid understanding of dimensional modelling (star/snowflake schema, SCD types).
* Understanding of BI governance principles: semantic model management, certified datasets, and access control in Power BI.

Work Experience
  
  

* With 2–4 years of hands-on experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI development.
* Experience with Snowflake or Azure Synapse Analytics for data warehousing and query optimization.
* Experience with Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows.

required to support standardized laboratory testing.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Responsible for Empower Master Data Management, including the creation, configuration, maintenance, and update of Custom Fields, Report Methods, View Filters, and other associated Empower methods.
* Analyze test method requirements and translate them into appropriate Empower technical requirement for configuration.
* Prepare technical assessments for proposed Empower changes, develop detailed system requirements, and document changes within applicable site or global change control systems.
* Manage assigned Empower changes through the applicable change control and system lifecycle processes, ensuring appropriate documentation, traceability, and compliance.
* Execute technical configuration and master data changes based on approved requirements and technical assessments.
* Review and assess Empower configurations to ensure they are aligned with approved requirements, established design principles, and global data standards.

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Biology, Microbiology, Pharmacy, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related scientific or technical field; or equivalent relevant experience.

* Experience supporting integration between Empower and external laboratory systems such as LabWare LIMS.

* Experience working within System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and computerized system validation processes.
* Ability to develop and execute test scripts and validation protocols and document results in accordance with established procedures.
* Strong technical aptitude for computerized laboratory systems, data analysis, troubleshooting, and method/configuration evaluation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail.

Join us as "Surveillance Optimization - AVP" to support the ongoing development, optimisation and effectiveness of the Market Surveillance programme by assessing surveillance model scenarios, analysing their performance and identifying opportunities to improve surveillance coverage, data quality and alert productivity.
  
  
The role will work closely with Surveillance Operations, Compliance Technology, Business Oversight Compliance, Product Compliance and other stakeholders to ensure surveillance scenarios remain effective, risk-based and aligned with regulatory requirements. The role will also support surveillance model inventory management, optimisation initiatives, documentation, governance forums and regulatory or audit requirements.

* Conduct regular and ad-hoc assessments of market surveillance scenarios to evaluate their effectiveness and efficiency.
* Perform ongoing monitoring and testing of surveillance models to ensure scenarios are operating as intended.
* Identify opportunities to optimise scenarios through improved data quality, risk coverage and alert productivity.
* Monitor market activity including order flows, prices, trading volumes, transactions and, where relevant, communications to identify potential market misconduct.
* Support investigations into potential market manipulation, insider trading and other forms of market abuse.
* Support surveillance coverage assessments and development of new or enhanced surveillance requirements.
* Assist with the management and delivery of the Surveillance Optimisation book of work and model inventory.
* Prepare and maintain supporting documentation explaining surveillance assessments, findings and recommendations.
* Present or support the presentation of optimisation recommendations to relevant Surveillance governance forums and Product Compliance stakeholders.
* Work collaboratively with teams developing surveillance models, analytics capabilities and optimisation tooling.
* Identify emerging surveillance risks and issues and support investigation and escalation where appropriate.
* Provide support for regulatory enquiries and internal or external audit requests.
* Produce accurate and timely reporting on surveillance activities, issues, trends and optimisation outcomes.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with Surveillance Operations, Product Compliance, Compliance Technology and Change Management teams.
* Execute appropriate controls and reviews in line with the Barclays control framework and applicable standards.

**Required Skills**

* Market Surveillance: Proven experience supporting the maintenance, assessment or optimisation of a Markets Surveillance programme.
* Surveillance Models & Scenario Optimisation: Strong understanding of surveillance scenarios, model performance, alert generation, scenario testing and optimisation techniques.
* Market Abuse Risk & Trading Data: Strong knowledge of market surveillance risks and typologies, including market manipulation and insider trading, with an understanding of how these risks appear within transaction, order and trading data.
* Data & Analytics: Good understanding of how data analysis and analytics can be used to assess surveillance effectiveness, improve risk coverage and reduce unproductive alerts.
* Regulatory Knowledge: Detailed understanding of relevant market conduct and surveillance regulations, including MiFID II and MAR, and how regulatory requirements influence surveillance programmes.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Relevant experience within Market Surveillance, Trade Surveillance, Compliance Surveillance, Market Conduct Risk or a related Compliance/Financial Crime function.
* Experience working with surveillance scenarios, alerts, trading or transaction data and surveillance controls.
* Understanding of financial markets, traded products, order flows and market conduct risks.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret surveillance data and scenario performance.
* Ability to document findings clearly and communicate recommendations to Compliance, Technology and business stakeholders.

Critical Skills
  
  
You will be assessed on key critical skills required for this role such as, Market Surveillance, Scenario Optimisation, Surveillance Model Testing, Market Abuse Risk, Trade & Transaction Data, Data Analytics, MiFID II / MAR, Risk & Controls, and Stakeholder Management.
  
  
This role is based out of Pune
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To monitor and analyse market activity for potential signs of abuse or manipulation, verifying that there is adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies and taking action to mitigate market misconduct.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Monitoring market activities continuously, including order flows, prices, trading volumes and communications to identify potential irregularities or market misconduct.
* Conducting in-depth investigations to gather evidence and assess the risk of market manipulation, insider trading, or other misconduct.
* Business support in projects related to the firm’s market surveillance framework.
* Regulatory query and internal/external audit support.
* Provision of accurate and timely reports to regulatory authorities, internal stakeholders, and management regarding market surveillance activities, incidents, and trends.
* Execution of appropriate controls aligned to the Barclays control framework and related firm-wide standards.
* Control environment support in relation to data quality, model effectiveness and efficiency.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Associate Implementation Engineer
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Associate Implementation Engineer works directly with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning both the product configuration and the underlying data migration that make each implementation successful. This role confirms requirements, configures and tests the platform, migrates and validates customer data, and trains users, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and strong data and database expertise, the Associate Implementation Engineer understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including database schema management, ETL configuration, and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach, and partners across teams to ensure a smooth, high-quality implementation that maximizes the value customers realize from OpenGov.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and test OpenGov cloud software to meet the documented implementation requirements of governments across the United States
* Own customer data migration end to end, including database schema management, ETL tool configuration, and scripting as required, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated customer data
* Confirm customer requirements across both configuration and data, and provide guidance, assistance, and support throughout the platform configuration and integration process
* Ensure receipt of appropriate data from customers, map it to OpenGov requirements, and upload, transform, and manipulate it to generate the desired application behaviors
* Build and execute test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live
* Interact directly with government Finance staff, Budget Directors, IT personnel etc, and decision-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate existing processes that improve customer workflows
* Troubleshoot configuration and data issues throughout the implementation and drive them to timely resolution
* Work closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to facilitate a consistent customer experience and ensure successful projects for customers

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 0 to 1 year of SQL scripting experience
* 0 to 1 year of Python, or similar, scripting experience
* Strong Microsoft Excel and Word skills, including using functions/formulas to format data such as v-lookup, pivot tables, error-checking, and developing properly formatted reports
* Experience with database technologies and with ETL or data-migration concepts and tools will be an advantage
* Excellent interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication skills, teamwork, and customer service mentality
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to customer needs
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to validate and reconcile data for accuracy

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Procurement FP&A Lead
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
  
  
We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
The role As Procurement FP&A Lead, you will own the end‑to‑end Procurement Finance forecasting process and supporting governance across RM, PM and 3PM, from data preparation to price forecasting, evaluation, and uplift. Ensure accurate actualization, driver-based forecasts, fact-based directional views, robust variance management, and timely sign‑offs in close partnership with Procurement, SC FP&A, Central PFET, and Market PFET teams. Act as the process integrator across systems (Anaplan, Predikt, S4 HANA, Power BI) and data objects (FX, RMX, product logic, volumes), delivering insight, control, and actionable recommendations. What you'll be responsible for Data Preparation: Coordinate pre-cycle set-up, actualization, currency exposure updates, volume forecast collection for all regions, contract price and data loads, validations; liaise with buyers and ensure Predikt system hygiene and timeliness. Price Forecasting: Orchestrate economic assumptions release, what‑If runs, Procurement Leadership team pre‑alignment (incl. directional view, Commodity Risk Management inputs), pricing signal model review, buyers’ inputs, Sustainability Sourcing reporting and query resolution. Central Evaluation: Validate impacts (FX/NMCI – Net Material Cost Impact/CoC – Cycle on cycle and YoY- year on year), manage adjustment templates, category allocations, and bridge gap validation; lead network and market reviews; prepare and validate Procurement Leadership team content (decks, pricing signal, fact loads, comms). DDP Uplift (WAPR): Review transfer prices vs Predikt, drive corrections with Supply Chain Finance Services (SCFS) - GBS and sign off forecast and pricing impacts. Business Partnering & Governance: Serve as the central interface among Procurement, SCFS, FP&A, Central/Market Procurement FET; drive accuracy, compliance, and on‑time delivery; communicate insights to leadership and secure decisions/sign‑offs. Key Procurement interfaces: Buyers (local/global), Procurement Directors (network/market) and global CPRM (Commodity Price Risk Management). Team management: lead Procurement Finance Forecasting, ensure full interchangeability by continuous training, development and timely set up of the team. We're looking for someone who Bachelor’s degree in finance/accounting/economics; CIMA/ACCA qualifications are a plus. 10+ years in Procurement/Supply Chain Finance or FP&A with forecasting and variance analysis. Strong grasp of FX, commodities, RM/PM/3PM cost drivers, PPV, and procurement pricing mechanics. Advanced Excel; SAP ECC or S4H; Power BI experience Financial Accounting, management accounting and Reporting knowledge Effective Communication: Fluent in English, oral and written. Stakeholder influence and Multiple Stakeholders Management Forward looking approach and ability to provide “what if” analysis IT skills – excellent level of computer literacy Team working – demonstrate commitment to the team in helping to achieve goals; proactively share best practice, ideas and insights with colleagues Data-driven mindset, Process Governance, leveraging analytics to measure, predict and improve performance. Self-driven and analytical professional with strong prioritization, problem-solving, and adaptability skills, adept at managing relationships, handling conflicts, and building trust Analytical and customer-focused professional with strong attention to detail, a hands-on approach, and ability to perform under pressure, driven by continuous improvement and digital awareness What you'll get Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards Flexible ways of working Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work Time off to rest and recharge Ongoing learning and development opportunities Specific benefits vary by location
  
  
**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Business Strategist Senior II
description:
Research, plan, organize and develop recommendations for leadership and key stakeholders by analyzing and predicting industry & market trends, consumer & shipper behavior, customer segments and competitive strategy. Propose solutions on key strategic issues across major dimensions of the business and act as an internal consultant to senior management.
  
  
Acts as a technical expert on complex and specialist subject(s). Supports management with the analysis, interpretation and application of complex information, contributing to the achievement of divisional and corporate goals. Supports or leads projects by applying area of expertise.
  
  
FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Analyst Financial
description:
****Job Summary****
Under supervision, analyze and investigate information reported in the internal financial statements and other periodic financial reports.
  
  
Provide financial decision support with business partners and research and recommend options and solutions for improved business results to senior management.
  
  
Provide and lead financial reviews process with business partners.
  
  
****Job Description****
**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Analyze financial results, trends and metrics on a monthly basis and meet with Division Presidents to communicate their net results. Communicate key drivers in regards to the full financial profit and loss statement (sales, AGM, customer drivers, adjustments, etc).
* Review expenses and operating statements including COGS (Cost of Goods Sold), product and overhead costs.
* Post a specified list of journal entries at month end.

title: Implementation Engineer II
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Implementation Engineer II is a senior technical person who partners with government
  
  
customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product
  
  
configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team. Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the
  
  
most complex government implementations across the United States
  
  
Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with
  
  
documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before
  
  
go-live
  
  
Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity,
  
  
and reconciling source-to-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit-ready
  
  
customer data
  
  
Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping,
  
  
ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with
  
  
accurate, validated data
  
  
Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data,
  
  
resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
  
  
Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and
  
  
migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live
  
  
Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder
  
  
like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the
  
  
deployment and integration process
  
  
Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to
  
  
simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and
  
  
delivery efficiency
  
  
Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their
  
  
configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
  
  
Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable
  
  
tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
  
  
Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management,
  
  
Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and
  
  
channel field feedback into the product roadmap
  
  
**Requirements And Preferred Experience**
3 to 5 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical
  
  
consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
  
  
3+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data
  
  
transformation, and reconciliation
  
  
2+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
  
  
Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts
  
  
and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
  
  
Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and
  
  
data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
  
  
Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or
  
  
provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
  
  
Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork
  
  
and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
  
  
Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on
  
  
data and configuration for accuracy
  
  
Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving
  
  
customer needs
  
  
Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field
  
  
**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Digital Shelf Manager
description:
**About the Role:**
The Digital Shelf Manager is responsible for maximizing product visibility, discoverability, content quality and conversion across marketplaces, quick commerce and eB2B platforms. The role will own digital shelf excellence by ensuring accurate and compelling product content, high availability, strong search performance, pricing compliance and competitive visibility. This position will work closely with internal cross-functional teams, platform partners and external agencies to drive best-in-class online shopper experiences and support sustainable e-commerce growth.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities:**
Digital Shelf Management
  
  

* Own and manage digital shelf health across marketplaces, quick commerce and eB2B platforms.
* Ensure complete and accurate product content across all online channels, maintaining high standards of digital shelf excellence.
* Drive continuous improvements in product page quality, visibility and shopper experience.

**Product Content & Catalog Management**

* Manage end-to-end product listings, including titles, descriptions, images, videos, A+ content, keywords, attributes and product page optimization.
* Ensure all product content aligns with brand guidelines and platform requirements.
* Identify and address gaps in hero images, pack shots, product claims, benefit communication and conversion-driving content.

**Search & Discoverability Optimization**

* Improve organic search rankings and product discoverability across platforms.
* Optimize keyword strategies and content to increase share of shelf for priority SKUs.
* Monitor and enhance product visibility through ongoing search performance analysis.

**Availability, Pricing & Compliance Monitoring**

* Track product availability, out-of-stock levels and assortment performance across platforms.
* Ensure pricing hygiene and compliance with platform-specific pricing policies.
* Monitor content compliance, ratings, reviews and platform standards to maintain brand consistency.

**Competitive Intelligence**

* Monitor competitor listings, content quality, pricing, assortment, promotions, ratings, reviews and search visibility.
* Identify marketplace trends, emerging opportunities and competitive threats.
* Translate competitive insights into actionable recommendations for business growth.

**New Product Launch Support**

* Support new product introductions through timely listing creation, content readiness, keyword mapping and platform asset deployment.
* Ensure seamless execution of launch plans across digital commerce platforms.
* Track launch performance and provide recommendations to improve visibility and sales outcomes.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Brand, Category, E-Commerce, Media, Supply Chain and Agency teams to execute digital shelf initiatives.
* Work with platform teams and account managers to resolve catalog, content, listing and visibility issues.
* Coordinate stakeholder alignment to ensure timely implementation of content and visibility enhancements.

**Review & Consumer Insights Management**

* Monitor consumer ratings and reviews across platforms.
* Identify recurring product, content and service-related improvement opportunities based on shopper feedback.
* Collaborate with relevant teams to address consumer concerns and improve overall customer experience.

**Performance Tracking & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain digital shelf scorecards covering content quality, search performance, availability, pricing, ratings and competitive benchmarks.
* Analyze digital shelf performance metrics and identify areas for improvement.
* Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly business reports with insights, action plans and accountability tracking.

**About You:**

* 5-8 years of experience in E-Commerce, Digital Commerce, Digital Shelf Management, Category Management or Online Marketplace Operations
* Experience working with major marketplaces, quick commerce platforms and eB2B channels
* Strong understanding of digital shelf analytics, marketplace algorithms and content optimization practices

* Support change management activities including stakeholder communication, training material development, and end-user training delivery

* Understanding of data governance, data quality standards, and reporting best practices within Salesforce
* Experience in the healthcare, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industry
* Proven experience supporting large-scale, enterprise Salesforce implementations with multiple concurrent workstreams
