title: Consultant — Analytics
description:
**Consultant — Analytics
  
  
Level:**
4–6 year's experience
**Location:**
Gurgaon/ Pune
  
  
Blue Matter Consulting (BMI) is a rapidly growing management consultancy focused on the biopharmaceutical industry. We partner with life sciences companies to commercialize therapies that extend and improve human life — translating data and insights into strategies that matter.
  
  
We operate across seven global offices with an entrepreneurial culture built on curiosity, integrity, and collective excellence. Consultants at BMI are trusted leaders — the engine of client relationships, the architects of analytical frameworks, and the coaches who develop the next generation of BMI talent.
  
  
**Our Core Values — The Foundation Of How We Work**
At BMI, values are the operating system behind every deliverable, every client conversation, and every promotion decision. As a consultant, you are not only expected to live these values — you are expected to model and multiply them across your team.
  
  
**Speak the TRUTH —**
*"True to the data; true to the client"*
We let the data lead. Our recommendations are grounded in evidence, and when analysis contradicts expectations, we say so with clarity and respect.
**Solve for SO WHAT —**
*"Be the client, own the impact"*
Every analysis we deliver connects to a real business need. We dig past the technical ask to understand the underlying question — and hold ourselves to delivering meaningful impact, not just outputs.
**Stay CURIOUS —**
*"Dig deeper, see further to innovate"*
Curiosity is our superpower. We ask 'why' continuously, build T-shaped expertise across data, analytics, and business context, and embrace new tools and methods to solve old problems in better ways.
**Win TOGETHER —**
*"Individually experts; collectively transformative"*
We encourage every voice regardless of level, hold each other accountable, and step up when it counts — across time zones and across teams.
  
  
***The Role***
As a Consultant at Blue Matter, you are the connective tissue between data and decision. You lead client-facing analytical engagements end-to-end, own the quality and strategic coherence of every deliverable on your projects, and serve as a trusted advisor to pharma and biotech clients navigating critical commercial challenges.
  
  
This is a role for someone who has moved well beyond execution. You shape the analytical approach, challenge the brief when necessary, mentor junior colleagues, and ensure BMI's four core values are embedded in how your team works — not just what it produces.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
You will lead end-to-end delivery of analytics engagements while building lasting client relationships and developing your team. Your responsibilities span client leadership, analytical excellence, and people development:
  
  
**Lead with intellectual depth**

* Set the research and analytical agenda for engagements: define which questions matter most and the most rigorous methods to answer them
* Stay at the forefront of life sciences commercial trends, data ecosystems, and emerging analytical tools — and actively bring that knowledge into client engagements
* Challenge assumptions in the brief, push past the obvious, and look around corners to surface insights clients haven't yet asked for but need
* Foster a culture of curiosity on your team — coach analysts and associate consultants to ask better questions before they build models

**Be the voice clients trust**

* Own the integrity of all analytical outputs on your engagements — ensure every recommendation is backed by rigorous evidence, not narrative convenience
* Deliver difficult findings to senior client stakeholders with confidence, clarity, and respect — including when data contradicts the client's hypothesis or internal position
* Model radical candor internally: give direct, constructive feedback to junior colleagues and create an environment where concerns surface early
* Do the right thing — flag risks, escalate issues, and never sell a project you know won't add value to the client

**Architect impact, not just analysis**

* Lead the design of analytical frameworks and custom solutions that address clients' underlying commercial challenges — not just their stated technical ask
* Before scoping any engagement, ask: 'How will this analysis change the client's strategy?' Ensure scope serves impact, not the other way around
* Develop and apply advanced statistical models, forecasting frameworks, segmentation analyses, and market models using Excel/VBA, Python, R, SQL, Alteryx, and visualization platforms (Tableau, Qlik, PowerPoint)
* Translate complex quantitative outputs into crisp executive narratives — from model to boardroom in one coherent story
* Mentor associates on moving from technical execution to strategic thinking: coaching them to ask 'So what does this mean for the client?' at every step

**Lead the team, build the partnership**

* Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact: build trusted relationships across functional levels and ensure BMI is experienced as a strategic partner, not a vendor
* Lead cross-functional, globally distributed project teams - actively bridge onshore and offshore colleagues so every team member is a full contributor, not just an executor
* Invest in junior talent: coach analysts and associate consultants through regular feedback, stretch assignments, and honest conversations about their growth
* Invite dissent and junior voices into project reviews — the best idea wins, regardless of who had it
* Step in for teammates when the team needs it; never let a deliverable fail for lack of support

**Required**
***What You'll Bring***

* 4-6 years of experience in analytics, data science, or management consulting - ideally with direct exposure to pharma or biotech commercial challenges
* Advanced proficiency across multiple analytical tools: SQL, Python/R, Excel/VBA, Alteryx, or equivalent
* Demonstrated ability to lead analytical engagements independently - from scoping and methodology design through to client delivery
* Track record of translating complex quantitative analysis into clear, high-impact recommendations for senior stakeholders
* Experience managing or mentoring junior team members in a professional setting
* Excellent communication and client relationship skills; comfortable leading conversations with leadership level client contacts
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and deliver quality work

**Preferred**

* Deep expertise in one or more life sciences commercial domains: launch analytics, patient analytics, market forecasting, field force optimization, pricing and access, or medical affairs analytics
* Experience with secondary data sources common in pharma (IQVIA, Symphony Health, Komodo, APLD, or equivalent)
* Advanced proficiency in Tableau, Qlik, or Power BI for client-facing dashboards and tools
* BE/BTech/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* MTech/MS in Statistics, Data Science, or MBA from a reputable institution is a strong plus

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
A strong Consultant at BMI will:
  
  

* Be trusted by clients to lead the analytical conversation - and by BMI leadership to scope, staff, and deliver engagements with minimal oversight
* Consistently deliver findings that challenge comfortable assumptions and earn client respect for the quality and integrity of BMI's work
* Be known internally as someone who elevates the analytical bar - always asking the next question, always pushing for a deeper answer
* Have a direct, positive impact on at least one junior team member's growth — measured not by output volume, but by the quality of their thinking

***Why Blue Matter***

* Lead high-stakes analytics engagements that directly influence commercialization decisions for therapies in oncology, rare diseases, immunology, and beyond
* Operate as a trusted partner. BMI's client relationships are deep, long-term, and built on the quality of our thinking
* Shape the next generation of BMI talent: Consultants are coaches, not just contributors
* Clear path to Lead and Partner — merit-driven, transparent, and fast for those who exemplify the BMI values.

title: Associate Consultant — Analytics
description:
**Level:**
2–4 years experience
**Location:**
Gurgaon/ Pune
  
  
Blue Matter Consulting is a rapidly growing management consultancy focused on the biopharmaceutical industry. We partner with life sciences companies to commercialize therapies that extend and improve human life — translating data and insights into strategies that matter.
  
  
We operate across seven global offices with an entrepreneurial culture built on curiosity, integrity, and collective excellence. At Blue Matter Insights, Associate Consultants are core contributors who own work, shape recommendations, and grow into tomorrow's leads.
  
  
**Our Core Values — The Foundation Of How We Work**
At BMI values are the operating system behind every deliverable, every client conversation, and every promotion decision.
  
  
**Speak the TRUTH —**
*"True to the data; true to the client"*
We let the data lead. Our recommendations are grounded in evidence, and when analysis contradicts expectations, we say so with clarity and respect.
**Solve for SO WHAT —**
*"Be the client, own the impact"*
Every analysis we deliver connects to a real business need. We dig past the technical ask to understand the underlying question — and hold ourselves to delivering meaningful impact, not just outputs.
**Stay CURIOUS —**
*"Dig deeper, see further to innovate"*
Curiosity is our superpower. We ask 'why' continuously, build T-shaped expertise across data, analytics, and business context, and embrace new tools and methods to solve old problems in better ways.
**Win TOGETHER —**
*"Individually experts; collectively transformative"*
We encourage every voice regardless of level, hold each other accountable, and step up when it counts — across time zones and across teams.
  
  
***The Role***
As an Associate Consultant at Blue Matter, you are stepping into ownership. You will independently drive analytical workstreams on live client engagements, translate complex data into crisp strategic insights, and begin mentoring junior analysts. This role is for someone who does not just execute tasks — they interrogate them, improve them, and connect them to the bigger picture.
  
  
You will be expected to embody all four BMI core values in practice: staying curious about every client's business, speaking the truth to the data, ensuring every output has a clear 'So What?', and winning alongside your team every step of the way.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
You will own analytical modules end-to-end on active client projects. Your responsibilities span the full arc from data to decision:
  
  
**Develop deep expertise, explore new frontiers**

* Research therapy areas, pipeline landscapes, and competitor dynamics with the goal of knowing more than the client about their own market
* Independently investigate data anomalies and unexpected findings until you understand the story behind them — never accept outputs at face value
* Proactively bring emerging analytical methodologies, AI-driven tools, and best practices to the team; help elevate how BMI does its work

**Deliver evidence-grounded insights with confidence**

* Own the integrity of your analysis — ensure every recommendation is backed by data, not narrative convenience
* Clearly communicate findings that challenge client assumptions when the evidence calls for it, framing difficult messages with professionalism and precision
* Raise risks, blockers, and quality issues proactively; create a culture on your team where problems surface fast and get solved faster

**Move from analysis to impact**

* Translate quantitative outputs into strategic recommendations that connect directly to the client's commercial challenge — every chart, every model, every slide must earn its place
* Ask 'How will this analysis change the client's decision?' before designing an approach; suggest a simpler, higher-impact methodology when it better serves the need
* Design and build polished, client-ready deliverables: dashboards, forecasting models, segmentation analyses, and executive presentations using Excel, Python/R, Tableau, Qlik, or PowerPoint
* Mentor junior analysts on framing insights and connecting analytical work to business outcomes

**Lead from within, lift others up**

* Actively bridge onshore and offshore teams — share context generously so that the full team can contribute, not just execute
* Invite junior colleagues into internal reviews; create space for their voices and incorporate their perspectives
* Step in to support teammates when capacity is tight — a deliverable belongs to the team, not just to the person whose name is on it
* Build trusted client relationships as a day-to-day point of contact, representing BMI's values in every interaction

**Required**
***What You'll Bring***

* 2–4 years of experience in analytics, data science, or management consulting (life sciences exposure is a strong plus)
* Advanced proficiency in at least two analytical tools: SQL, Python, R, Excel/VBA, or Alteryx
* Demonstrated ability to translate data into clear, decision-ready insights — not just technically accurate outputs
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders
* Proven experience working across global, cross-functional teams

**Preferred**

* Experience in pharma/biotech commercial analytics: forecasting, patient analytics, market segmentation, or launch readiness
* Proficiency in visualization tools such as Tableau, Qlik, or Power BI
* BE/BTech/BS in Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
* MTech/MS (Statistics or Data Science) is a plus

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
A strong Associate Consultant at BMI will:
  
  

* Own and deliver full analytical workstreams independently - on time, with a clear 'So What?' in every output
* Be trusted by the engagement lead to interface directly with clients and represent BMI's analytical rigor
* Proactively identify gaps in the analytical approach and propose improvements before being asked
* Be the teammate others want on their project — reliable, generous with knowledge, and never leaving anyone to fail alone

***Why Blue Matter***

* Shape how life-saving therapies reach patients - your models and recommendations influence real commercial decisions in oncology, rare disease, immunology, and more
* Accelerated growth: BMI's flat hierarchy means your ideas get heard at every level, and strong performers move fast
* T-shaped development: deepen your analytics expertise while building strategic business acumen across the full life sciences commercial lifecycle
* Global team, flat hierarchy: your ideas are heard at every level, regardless of tenure

title: GTM Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Senior Analytics Engineer, GTM

Role Overview

Zywave is seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer, GTM to own and improve the revenue data foundation across Salesforce, Snowflake, and other GTM systems. This role focuses on data cleanliness, source-of-truth alignment, hierarchy integrity, metric logic, reconciliation, and reportable data models.

This senior individual contributor will work deeply in Snowflake and SQL, understand Salesforce data structures, consolidate data from multiple systems, and create trusted datasets for reporting and analytics. The role is distinct from a reporting analyst: it owns the underlying data layer that makes reporting accurate, scalable, and trusted.

Reporting Relationship

This role will report to the VP, Revenue Operations

•

Key partners include Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Client Success Operations, Finance, Marketing Operations, Business Applications, Data / BI, Sales and CS leadership

Primary Responsibilities

GTM Source-of-Truth Data Model

•

Build and maintain trusted GTM data models in Snowflake that support reporting across Sales, CS, Finance, Marketing Operations, and Revenue Operations.

•

Consolidate Salesforce and other GTM system data into a single, reportable source of truth.

•

Create governed datasets for pipeline, bookings, forecast, renewals, expansion, churn, hierarchy, product, territory, and sales performance reporting.

•

Define transformation logic, business rules, joins, filters, exclusions, and documentation needed to make data usable and repeatable.

Salesforce and Snowflake Reconciliation

•

Reconcile Salesforce and Snowflake data so core revenue metrics match across systems.

•

Investigate differences between Salesforce reports, Snowflake tables, BI dashboards, and Finance reporting.

•

Identify whether discrepancies stem from source-system issues, integration failures, transformation logic, timing differences, field mapping, hierarchy logic, or reporting filters.

Build QA checks and reconciliation processes that proactively flag mismatches before they reach leadership reporting.

Data Cleanliness, Standardization, and Governance

•

Lead data cleanup and standardization across GTM systems and reporting layers.

•

Identify duplicate, incomplete, inconsistent, stale, or misclassified revenue data.

•

Create repeatable rules for data normalization, account hierarchy, territory assignment, product mapping, opportunity classification, renewal logic, and lifecycle status.

•

Maintain mapping tables, data dictionaries, metric definitions, lineage documentation, and QA logic.

Multi-System Consolidation

Consolidate data from Salesforce and GTM sources such as marketing automation, customer success, sales engagement, forecasting, product usage, enrichment, quote/order, or finance platforms.

•

Understand ingestion pipelines, sync timing, API limitations, and transformation dependencies in partnership with technical teams.

•

Turn raw and inconsistent source data into reliable analytical datasets with clear lineage from source systems to final reporting tables.

•

Reduce manual pulls, spreadsheet workarounds, and conflicting reports by improving the trusted data foundation.

Build datasets, semantic layers, and curated views that allow analysts and business users to create trusted dashboards.

Validate that reporting outputs match approved source-of-truth logic before dashboards are published.

Use AI tools to accelerate SQL development, QA checks, documentation, anomaly detection, data mapping, and automation.

•

Support U.S.-based stakeholders during U.S. business hours and translate technical data issues into clear business language.

•

Proactively flag risks, gaps, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs before they impact reporting.

What Success Looks Like

•

Better alignment between Salesforce, Snowflake, BI dashboards, and Finance reporting.

Zywave | Confidential

•

A clearer GTM source of truth for pipeline, bookings, forecast, renewals, expansion, churn, territory, hierarchy, and customer reporting.

•

Fewer conflicting reports and fewer manual reconciliation exercises.

•

Cleaner account hierarchy, ownership, product, territory, and opportunity classification logic.

•

Better documentation of lineage, metric definitions, transformation rules, caveats, and automated data-quality checks.

•

Improved trust in leadership reporting and operating cadences.

Required Qualifications

•

5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, data operations, BI engineering, RevOps analytics, or a related data role.

•

Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience in Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse.

•

Experience building curated reporting tables, analytical datasets, data models, semantic layers, or BI-ready views.

•

Strong understanding of Salesforce data structures, including accounts, leads, contacts, opportunities, products, quotes, activities, users, roles, and hierarchy-related data.

•

Experience reconciling data across multiple systems and resolving source-of-truth conflicts.

•

Experience with data quality, governance, lineage, documentation, metric definition, QA, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.

•

Ability to translate business requirements into technical data logic

•

Ability to work U.S. business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in B2B SaaS, insurtech, fintech, HR tech, benefits technology, broker technology, carrier technology, or another workflow-heavy software environment.

Experience with transformation frameworks and BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, Looker, Domo, or similar platforms.

Experience supporting pipeline, bookings, renewal, churn, customer lifecycle, territory, account hierarchy, or revenue performance reporting.

title: Associate Director - Customer Behaviour Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
**Associate Director – Customer Behaviour Analytics**
**The Opportunity**
This role sits within the Customer Knowledge & Measurement (CK&M) vertical of Digital Human Health (DHH). The Associate Director, Customer Behavior Analytics owns the "know the customer" of CK&M the model-build and insight-generation layer that produces the customer understanding the rest of CK&M (Field & CRM Engagement) acts on and measures.
  
  
The Associate Director will be responsible for leading the analytics that define who matter and why HCP / account / consumer segmentation, micro-segmentation, propensity and risk-stratification modelling, integrated customer profiling, KOL identification, content-affinity modelling, campaign analytics and the data-product spine that powers downstream activation. The team supports the US Commercial Organization, informing customer engagement strategy.
  
  
The role is a key node in evolving the India Hub from delivery support to strategic analytics partner across the customer-insight value chain.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Associate Director will lead a team of 15+ covering capability domains under Customer Behavior Analytics. The candidate must be able to lead direct teams and orchestrate cross-functional insights pods spanning DHH, Data Strategy & Solutions, IT and the broader DHH organization. The individual will demonstrate consistently strong leadership, the ability to work objectively in ambiguity, strong partnership skills, and a culture of continual learning.
  
  
The preferred candidate will have an entrepreneurial spirit, a consultative and strategic mindset, deep customer-analytics experience in pharma / biotech (segmentation, micro-segmentation, campaign analytics, productized customer-data offerings), fluency in technology (AI, agentic, GenAI), and a demonstrated record of producing actionable insights from analytics. The individual should have a strong understanding of the US data landscape (claims, EMR / EHR, Rx, activity, promotional data, content-engagement data) and the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into advanced, scalable analytical solutions.
  
  
**What Will You Do In This Role**

* Customer model-build Lead the development of customer-understanding models that drive downstream activation and measurement HCP segmentation (personal / non-personal), account / IDN segmentation, patient segmentation and profiling, propensity models (writer / non-writer), patient risk-stratification (initial model build with analog / business rules, progressing to ML), and early adopter / follower analysis.
* Integrated Customer Profile (ICP) and KOL build Own the analytics build for ICP and the KOL-identification capability. Define data inputs, model logic, refresh cadence and validation criteria.
* Patient Insights Engine (PIE) and consumer extensions Lead the build and evolution of the customer-data spine across PIE phases (CDM, Business Rules, Data Augmentation including EMR, and Predictive Models) and the consumer extension (PIECON) where applicable.
* Content Affinity Drive micro-segmentation analytics to enable targeted content recommendations and quantify which content resonates with distinct segments, informing both brand strategy and Field & CRM execution.
* Team leadership and cross-functional orchestration Lead and mentor Senior Managers (and the specialists / interns reporting into them), providing guidance on best practices in data analytics, modelling, validation and insight synthesis. Manage team workload proactively and ensure optimal resource utilization. Lead cross-functional insights pods in addition to direct teams.
* Prioritization and value tracking Understand the full book of work underway and planned for each disease area or business unit. Work with BU LT to prioritize against the team’s capacity. For prioritized work, engage cross-functional teams to articulate the value and impact of each piece. Encourage the mindset to articulate the "so what" and "now what" and to track realized business value.
* Stakeholder collaboration Drive proactive, transparent engagement with cross-functional partners to co-create solutions, align on organizational priorities, and set clear expectations. Provide internal and business stakeholders with forward-looking visibility into key programs to inform milestones, prioritization, risk mitigation, and aligned decision-making.
* Pharma data-ecosystem analytics Analyze data across disparate data sources (claims, EMR, Rx, activity, promotional, consumer, content) to develop insights that inform commercial business strategies.
* Advanced analytics and modelling Leverage advanced statistical methods and ML/AI modelling with strong validation practices; deliver regression and time-series models, and segmentation/clustering approaches (k-means, hierarchical) to generate actionable insights.
* Innovation and GenAI experimentation Contribute to and lead innovation experiments (idea generation, idea incubation, experimentation), including responsible application of GenAI and agentic AI. Identify tangible, measurable criteria to make meaningful improvements to business processes.

**Primary Skills (must-have)**

* 8+ years in pharma/biotech across commercial analytics and strategy, with deep pharmaceutical commercialization experience and delivery of complex analytical initiatives.
* 4+ years leading high-performing teams; proven ability to coach talent, build an inclusive culture, and lead cross-functional pods in a matrixed setup.
* Strong consultative mindset with demonstrated ability to translate brand and commercial strategies into actionable analytics and insight plans.
* Executive presence with ability to influence senior leaders, align US Marketing & DHH stakeholders, and communicate clear, data-driven narratives.
* Extensive experience working with real-world datasets (claims, Rx, CRM, promotional and sales data), leveraging SQL, Python, and AI-driven tools; familiarity with modern data platforms including Snowflake, Databricks, and AWS/GCP.
* Experience leveraging advanced statistical methods, Machine Learning / AI and Natural Language Processing (NLP) modelling and model evaluation, including segmentation & clustering (k-means, hierarchical).
* Self-motivated, proactive mindset, and ability to work independently.

**Who We Are**
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
**What We Look For**
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

title: Employee Listening Lead, People Analytics and Insights
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
**Employee listening strategy**

* Own the global employee listening calendar across the annual census, pulse surveys, and lifecycle surveys (onboarding, exit, internal mobility), balancing insight needs against survey fatigue.
* Recommend when to survey, when to use existing data instead, and when to retire survey instruments that no longer earn their place.

**Listening portfolio expansion**

* Build a phased roadmap that extends listening beyond the annual Employee Engagement Survey, prioritized by business need and data readiness.
* Design and launch onboarding and exit (offboarding) surveys, triggered from HR system events.
* Extend into lifecycle listening at key moments such as internal moves, promotions, and return from leave.
* Introduce targeted pulse surveys to track priority themes and change programs between annual cycles.
* Develop a 360 feedback offering for leaders and managers, with clear rules on confidentiality and use.
* Connect insight across survey instruments so leaders see a single employee experience view, not separate survey reports.

**Survey design**

* Design and maintain survey instruments: item writing, scale design, and question libraries that protect year-over-year trend comparability.
* Manage translation and cultural equivalence across countries and languages.
* Define sampling approaches for pulse surveys and targeted listening activity.

**Analysis and insight**

* Run driver analysis, significance testing, and segmentation across the organization, including small-team reporting within anonymity rules.
* Analyze open-text comments at scale using Qualtrics Text iQ and AI-assisted methods.
* Link listening data to business outcomes such as attrition, performance, and utilization, working with the wider PA&I team.

**Executive communication**

* Translate results into concise narratives for the Senior Leadership Team, regional leaders, and People & Culture business partners.
* Present findings directly to senior audiences and defend your methodology and results under questioning.

**Manager enablement and action**

* Run the Employee Engagement Survey action-planning cadence and track whether actions are taken and whether they move outcomes.
* Shape the content and roadmap of AI-enabled manager tools with the AI & Projects team, including what data it surfaces and how adoption is measured.
* Produce practical guidance that helps managers interpret results and act.

**Platform and governance**

* Specify, review, and quality-assure Qualtrics configuration: hierarchies, metadata, dashboards, role-based access, and anonymity thresholds.
* Ensure listening activity meets GDPR and local data protection requirements, including works council consultation where required.
* Manage the day-to-day relationship with Qualtrics as a vendor.

**What You'll Bring**

* 10-12 years in employee listening, people analytics, organizational research, or survey research, with at least 4 years running employee surveys at scale in a large or multinational organization.
* Experience building a listening portfolio beyond an annual survey, such as onboarding, exit, lifecycle, or pulse programs.
* Strong survey methodology: item and scale design, validity, trend management, sampling, and cross-cultural survey administration.
* Working knowledge of Qualtrics EmployeeXM, deep enough to specify and quality-assure hierarchies, metadata, dashboards, role-based access, and anonymity thresholds.
* Applied statistics: driver analysis, regression, significance testing, and segmentation. Hands-on use of R or Python alongside Qualtrics.
* Text analytics experience, including Qualtrics Text iQ or equivalent, and familiarity with AI-assisted comment analysis.
* A track record of presenting survey insight to senior leaders and influencing decisions.
* Experience turning results into manager action, with evidence of how adoption was driven and measured.
* Ability to deliver through colleagues and stakeholders you don't manage, across regions and time zones.
* Sound understanding of confidentiality, GDPR, and ethical use of employee data.
* Bachelor's degree in psychology, statistics, social sciences, economics, or a related field.
* Fluent professional English, written and spoken.

Nice to have
  
  

* Master's degree in industrial-organizational psychology, organizational behavior, or quantitative social science.
* Qualtrics EX certification, or experience as a Qualtrics EX administrator.
* Experience consolidating survey platforms or programs across entities, for example after a merger.
* Experience designing or running 360 feedback programs.
* Experience with AI assistants or chat-based tools that surface survey data to managers.
* Qualtrics API or HRIS integration experience (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar).
* Experience with works councils and European employee consultation requirements.

The various Content teams report to the Chief Content Officer and have strategy, product management, operations and support responsibilities for each of the Content verticals- Research, Web Curation, Company Documents, and Structured Data. We have been experiencing a rapid growth cycle across all content sets. **About The Role**
The Business Analyst II will be part of a newly formed Content Strategy, Planning and Analysis team- a horizontal function working across all the lanes within the Content Organization. As a Content Analyst, you will work closely with the Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Operations and Revenue teams and contribute to the ideation, integration, and support of a variety of in-demand structured and unstructured content within our industry-leading AI platform (SaaS and Enterprise) and content strategy, and ultimately ensure we are successfully and continuously driving value for our users. The Content Analyst candidate we seek has experience in consulting, B2B SaaS and/or enterprise software application companies, with ideally a background in financial and corporate industries.
  
  
This role will report into the Director, Content Strategy, Planning & Analysis.
  
  
**Required**
Who You Are:
  
  

* Minimum 3 or more years experience in business intelligence, data analysis and due diligence, having worked in consulting management, financial and corporate services industries.
* A critical thinker, with attention to detail and effective organizational skills, who is able to manage diverse data and build effective presentations for product and content leaders with actionable suggestions to improve or influence operational decision making.
* Strong analytical skills, and ability to identify patterns from complex data, produce accurate conclusions, and report critical information or recommendations.
* Ideally some experience with data manipulation in SQL/Python/R, and Data visualization using Tableau/PowerBI/Looker.
* Possess the ability to multitask and work effectively under time pressure; a willingness to contribute independently; an eagerness to continue learning new skills; and a drive to deliver tangible results.
* Exceptional Excel/Word/PowerPoint/Google Sheets/Google Docs/Google Slides experience

**Strongly Preferred**

* Excellent domain knowledge, and familiarity with functions and user workflows across-buy-side/sell-side, investment banking/private Equity/Venture capital, Corporate and Consulting
* Subject-matter expertise with content feeds, metadata, assorted document and data delivery types
* A proactive self-starter who is able to develop and maintain effective working relationships with the wider team across different global locations, and stays focused to meet deadlines
* Strong presentation and effective communication skills - both written and verbal in English
* Bachelor's Degree in the information systems, statistics, computer science, business administration or a related field
* Experience with Product Development frameworks such as Agile, Kanban, etc., or process improvement methodologies such as SAFE or Six Sigma

**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct due diligence and comparative analysis of existing and prospective content sources, and partnerships with the aim to support the build out of business cases/proposals/cost-benefit analysis scenarios
* Address ad hoc requests for data analysis and reporting, including usage, readership, coverage details across the AlphaSense content landscape and product offerings
* Provide support in investigating and/or addressing inquiries from internal and external stakeholders, including clients, vendors
* Run detailed data analysis to build dashboards and reporting in support of projects/programs, collaborating with Content Team and Business Intelligence functions

**Preferred Skills:**

**Job Description**

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, Finance, or an equivalent field.
* 3+ years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, or in a similar role within banking or financial services.

* Familiarity with developing user stories and use cases

title: Analyst, SIOP
description:
**The Impact You'll Make**
As an Analyst, SIOP, you will play a key role in driving the global demand planning process for the Industrial Division. By developing accurate demand forecasts and facilitating cross-functional collaboration, you will help ensure the business can meet customer demand while optimizing inventory, operational efficiency, and financial performance.
  
  
Working closely with Sales, Product Management, Operations, and Supply Chain teams, you will translate market intelligence, customer insights, and business trends into actionable demand plans. Your analytical expertise and commitment to continuous improvement will contribute directly to forecast accuracy, effective decision-making, and the success of the monthly SIOP process.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Develop and maintain unconstrained demand forecasts at material, customer, and location levels using SAP IBP and multiple demand signals.
* Lead demand review discussions with Sales and Account Managers to build an aligned and accurate consensus demand plan.
* Analyze forecast performance, including accuracy, bias, and forecast value-add metrics, while identifying root causes and improvement opportunities.
* Facilitate demand planning activities within the monthly SIOP cycle and ensure timely completion of key deliverables.
* Create and maintain dashboards, KPI reporting, and analytics that provide insight and support business decision-making.

You'll also provide guidance and training to stakeholders, promote forecast ownership across the business, and help strengthen global demand planning processes through continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**

* 3-5 years of experience in Demand Planning, S&OP/SIOP, or Supply Chain Planning, working across multiple planning horizons and levels of data aggregation.
* Experience with SAP ERP systems and SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into actions.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and data analysis tools.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience collaborating across global teams and time zones.

Preferred qualifications include experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Databricks, or similar analytics platforms, knowledge of statistical forecasting and demand segmentation methodologies, and APICS CPIM, CSCP, or equivalent supply chain certifications.
  
  
**What You'll Get From Us**

* We promote from within and support your learning with mentoring, training, and access to global opportunities.
* You’ll have flexibility, autonomy, and support to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Your well-being matters to us.

description:

**Senior, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market

* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. title: Demand and Supply Planner
description:
**Take the lead as Demand and Supply Planner in a global planning environment**
Are you a proactive and analytical professional ready to shape how demand meets supply on a global scale? Join a dynamic Sales and Operations Planning function where you lead demand and supply planning for the Tissue Business. You work at the sales, engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain to balance capacity, cost, and delivery performance. You turn complex data into clear plans, enabling efficient operations and strong customer outcomes.
  
  
This is your opportunity to influence strategic decisions, drive collaboration across teams, and contribute to a high impact, international business environment.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* You prepare and maintain manufacturing demand forecasts using inputs from capital and service sales.
* You create and manage sales schedules during the sales phase, balancing demand with production, procurement, engineering, logistics, and capacity.
* You assess manufacturability and review material requirements together with manufacturing teams.
* You build production and capacity scenarios, including cost and financial impact, based on forecasts.
* You analyze risks, identify bottlenecks, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize delivery plans and performance.

**What We Expect From You**

* You have experience in S&OP (Sales and Operation Planning) in industrial machinery, or project‑based (ETO) environments.
* You bring strong analytical skills and you have proficiency in planning and analysis tools (e.g., Workflow automation solutions, Power BI).
* You have experience supporting sales phase planning, including cost, capacity, and scenario analyses.
* You understand capacity and resource planning across engineering and production.
* You communicate clearly in English, both written and spoken.
* Engineering background is considered as an advantage.

**To succeed in this role, you will require the following:**
You bring a structured and proactive mindset and enjoy turning data into actionable plans.
  
  
You collaborate effectively across teams and communicate insights that influence decisions.
  
  
You thrive in a fast-moving, global business environment and enjoy turning change and complexity into opportunities.
  
  
  
  
We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles - practical behaviors that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:
  
  

* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
* Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value

**We offer**
Join a Sales and Operations Planning team that works closely with sales, engineering, manufacturing, and supply chains to align demand and supply across the Business. The team focuses on balancing production capacity, improving forecasting accuracy, and enabling efficient project delivery. You will work in a collaborative, international environment where your insights directly impact business performance and customer satisfaction.
  
  
Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with opportunities for growth and development in a global network. You will benefit from a supportive team environment, modern tools, and flexible ways of working that support both your professional and personal development.
  
  
**Want to know more?**
Did we catch your interest? For further information, please contact Andrea Pieri, Director, Sales and Operation Planning, at andrea.pieri@valmet.com. Please not that we do not accept applications via e-mail.
  
  
  
  
Send us your application by
**November 10, 2026,**
by filling in our online application form.  Please also attach your CV to the application.
  
  
  
  
We will start interviews before the application deadline, so please submit your interest at your earliest convenience.
  
  
We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.
  
  
We kindly decline any assistance from recruitment and staffing agencies.
  
  
***When everything works together***
***Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 18,500 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.***
***At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.***
***Join the team – and lead the way with us!***
***www.valmet.com/careers***

title: Central Monitor-India
description:
Centralized monitoring is an integral part of a risk-based monitoring strategy, defined as the timely, remote review of accumulating subject and operational data to help distinguish between reliable and unreliable data, trends, outliers, and unusual variability using analytics and statistical methods.
  
  
The central monitor is responsible for conducting a holistic and centralized statistical review of study data from study start through to study database lock according to the centralized monitoring plan, using analytical tools to identify emerging and existing risks to critical study data and process. The central monitor enables proactive identification, communication, escalation and management of risks at the study/country/site level.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Follow established procedures for the review of clinical trial data (Operational and Subject data) using a variety of tools and systems in alignment with the centralized monitoring plan and with support from the senior team members.
* Identify data quality trends indicative of systematic errors and potential performance issues at study/country/site and track the evidence of issues and potential risks with support from senior team members.
* Ensure results of reviews are appropriately documented per procedures.
* Support Central Monitoring teams with performance of assigned reviews with high quality, on-time results.
* Provide input to senior team member as needed to support development of risk characterization and reporting.
* Support review set-up as directed by assigned lead including updating department database, pulling reports, etc. as assigned.
* Share the responsibility for data quality at the study, country and site levels.

Requirements:
  
  
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research.

**Experience**

* Minimum of 1 year of experience in central statistical monitoring with overall 6 years of experience in two or more operational areas such as clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety, medical monitoring, biometrics, or project management.
* Basic understanding of statistical monitoring and Risk Based Quality Management (RBQM) and their impact on data integrity.
* Thorough understanding of the processes associated with clinical study management, data management, and regulatory operations.
* Knowledge of clinical trial database systems (EDC, IRT, CTMS, etc.).
* Good computer skills, with knowledge of advanced MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and the ability to learn and use interactive computer systems and tools.
* Ideally a basic level of understanding of descriptive analysis e.g. means, medians, significance, confidence intervals.
* Must have been involved in the analysis and review of clinical data, ability to extract pertinent information from standard study documentation, such as protocols, electronic study data systems with the ability to learn to identify trending of site/study data.
* Must be able to work in non-traditional work environments.

**Attributes**

* Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).
* Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels in an organization and with external customers.
* Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.
* Prioritization skills with ability to plan, monitor and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.
* Satisfactory understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
* Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.
* Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
* Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems.
* Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

description:

Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.
  
  
**Who We Are Looking For**
Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the OPTI (Office of Product and Technology Innovation) AI Platform team in Pune. You will build, deliver, and maintain the data pipelines, analytics, dashboards, and reporting that run on the Databricks platform of the OPTI AI team, and you will own their data quality and monitoring.
  
  
You are a strong individual contributor who takes ownership of complex technical problems, brings opinions to design discussions, and raises the quality bar of everything you touch. You won't just execute tickets: you'll help shape how data moves, transforms, and gets consumed. You will work day to day with the Pune and US, AI Platform team and the team supports what it builds in production.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that move and transform data across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers in a Medallion Architecture
* Develop and optimize data workflows in Databricks, Databricks Workflows, and Unity Catalog
* Build dashboards and reports with stakeholders/SMEs, turning their requirements into reliable, well-designed views of the data
* Own data quality and monitoring for your pipelines: checks, alerting, and observability that keep SLAs met consistently
* Take part in design reviews, bringing practical experience and a critical eye to technical decisions
* Use AI coding tools and our AI Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) as part of how you build, test, and ship
* Work with Azure data services for storage, orchestration, security, and infrastructure, alongside the team's DevOps engineer
* Collaborate with stakeholders, AI Platform team in US and India to shape what gets built and why
* And other duties as assigned.

**What To Bring**
**Data engineering fundamentals**

* 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience in a production environment
* Strong Python and SQL, complex joins, and performance tuning
* Solid understanding of pipeline design patterns: incremental loading, schema evolution, and error handling
* Experience with multiple ingestion methods: Batch based, JDBC, API driven, KAFKA etc

**Databricks and Spark**

* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark or other large-scale data processing tools

title: Model Validation- Market Risk & Liquidity Risk
description:
**About Us:**

Solytics Partners is a Global Analytics firm, recognized with multiple industry awards for innovation and excellence. Our team comprises experts with deep domain knowledge in risk, analytics, AI/ML, AML/FCC, and fraud. By converging this expertise with cutting-edge technologies like AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs), we deliver powerful automated platforms and incisive point solutions.

Our offerings enable clients to streamline and future-proof their risk, AML, and analytics processes, comply seamlessly with global regulations, and safeguard financial systems. Whether it’s solving complex challenges or driving operational efficiency, Solytics Partners is committed to empowering organizations with transformative tools to stay ahead in an evolving regulatory landscape.

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced risk professional with a strong background in Enterprise Risk Management and independent model validation, particularly across Market Risk and Liquidity Risk. The candidate will be responsible for assessing the conceptual soundness, performance, limitations, and ongoing effectiveness of risk models used by financial institutions. The role involves reviewing model methodologies, evaluating underlying assumptions, conducting quantitative tests, performing independent benchmarking and back-testing, and documenting validation findings in line with regulatory expectations and internal model risk governance frameworks.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Model Validation:**
  Conduct independent validation of market risk and liquidity risk models, assessing conceptual soundness, theoretical foundations, model assumptions, and implementation.
* **Market Risk Models:**
  Validate models used for market risk measurement, including Value at Risk (VaR), Expected Shortfall (ES), stress testing, sensitivity analysis, and other relevant market risk metrics.
* **Liquidity Risk Models:**
  Validate liquidity risk measurement and forecasting models, including liquidity stress testing, cash flow projections, liquidity coverage analysis, and behavioural assumptions related to deposits and funding, where applicable.
* **Quantitative Analysis:**
  Perform statistical testing, back-testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, and scenario analysis to evaluate model performance and robustness.
* **Model Assumptions & Limitations:**
  Assess data quality, model inputs, assumptions, parameter estimation, limitations, and the appropriateness of methodologies under different market and economic conditions.
* **Regulatory & Governance Compliance:**
  Ensure validation activities align with applicable regulatory guidelines, internal model risk management policies, and established validation standards.
* **Documentation & Reporting:**
  Prepare detailed validation reports covering methodology reviews, testing results, identified limitations, findings, and recommendations.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Collaborate with model developers, risk management teams, treasury teams, and other stakeholders to discuss findings, recommend remediation actions, and monitor issue resolution.
* **Ongoing Monitoring:**
  Support periodic model reviews, performance monitoring, and reassessment of models following material changes in methodologies, portfolios, or market conditions.

**Key Requirements:**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in Enterprise Risk Management, quantitative risk modelling, model validation, or independent risk review within banking, financial services, or consulting.
* Strong hands-on experience in
  **independent model validation**
  , preferably across Market Risk and/or Liquidity Risk.
* Good understanding of market risk methodologies, including VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress testing, and back-testing.
* Experience validating liquidity risk models, including liquidity stress testing, cash flow forecasting, funding assumptions, or behavioural modelling.
* Strong knowledge of statistical modelling, quantitative analysis, sensitivity testing, and scenario analysis.
* Proficiency in Python, R, SAS, MATLAB, or similar analytical tools; experience with SQL is an advantage.
* Ability to critically evaluate model methodologies, assumptions, data, limitations, and performance.
* Strong documentation, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Preferred Qualification:**

* Postgraduate degree in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related discipline.
* Experience working with banking risk frameworks and model risk management governance.
* Familiarity with regulatory expectations relating to market risk, liquidity risk, and model validation.
* Exposure to treasury and balance sheet risk models is an advantage.

title: FinCrime Agile Testing Data Analyst
description:
Join us as a
**FinCrime Agile Testing Data Analyst**
at Barclays, where you'll help shape the future of Financial Crime risk management through data-driven testing, analytics, and insight generation. You will leverage data, technology, and analytical techniques to assess the effectiveness of Financial Crime controls, identify emerging risks, and support agile testing activities across key Financial Crime domains. Working closely with Compliance, Operations, Technology, and Risk stakeholders, you will deliver actionable insights that strengthen Barclays' control environment and support regulatory compliance. The role forms part of Barclays’ evolving agile testing capability within Financial Crime, focused on providing timely, risk-based assurance through the intelligent use of data and analytics.
  
  
Purpose of the role
  
  
To enable data-driven strategic and operational decision making through extracting actionable insights from large datasets, performing statistical and advanced analytics to uncover trends and patterns, and presenting findings through clear visualisations and reports.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  
  

* Perform data-driven testing and analytics to assess the effectiveness of Financial Crime controls and processes.
* Develop and execute analytical test scripts using DA programming languages like SQL, Python & SAS to identify potential control gaps, anomalies, and emerging risks.
* Analyse large datasets from multiple sources including performing data cleaning, wrangling and transformation to support agile testing reviews and thematic investigations.
* Design and create interactive dashboards, visualisations, and reports that provide meaningful management insights and support decision-making.
* Partner with Compliance, Operations, Technology, and Risk stakeholders to understand business processes and testing requirements.
* Provide guidance to stakeholders on the remediation of control weaknesses and outcome risks by participating in discussions and using technical knowledge for effective remediation. Propose action plans to address root causes of issues identified in testing.
* Support the development of automated testing approaches and reusable analytical solutions.
* Document testing methodologies, analytical logic, findings, and recommendations to a high standard.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to leverage analytics, automation, and emerging technologies to improve testing efficiency and insight generation

**Essential Qualifications**

* Experience in Data Analytics, Financial Crime, Compliance, Risk, Audit, or a related field.
* Strong SQL, Python and SAS skills with experience analysing large and complex datasets from Financial Crime Disciplines like KYC Onboarding, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions etc.
* Knowledge of statistical analysis, data mining, NLP, and AI-enabled analytics and experience using data visualization tools such as Tableau, or equivalent.
* Experience performing data-driven control testing, quality assurance, risk assessments, or investigative analysis
* Understanding of Financial Crime domains, including AML, Sanctions, Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC), Fraud, or Transaction Monitoring.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and control weaknesses.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex analytical findings in a clear, concise, and meaningful manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Desirable Skillsets**

* Stakeholder management skills with the ability to build effective working relationships across Compliance, Financial Crime Operations, Technology, Data, Risk and Business teams.
* Knowledge of advanced statistical and machine learning models to analyse patterns, trends, and relationships in the data.
* Ability to develop and implement predictive models to forecast future outcomes and identify potential risks and opportunities.
* Working knowledge of AWS cloud services, Amazon Bedrock, and LLM architectures, with an understanding of AI/GenAI solution design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), model orchestration, prompt engineering, and responsible AI principles.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in the role, such as experience with data analytics, SQL, SAS, Python, AI, control testing along with domain knowledge of Financial Crime processes, as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
This role will be based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To provide data-led expert oversight and check and challenge on business and compliance matters to evidence that the organisation is operating in a compliance with Barclays legal, regulatory and ethical responsibilities.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification and assessment of compliance risks through thorough reviews of business activities, changes, processes, testing and systems to.
* Identification and investigation of potential market abuse, including but not limited to, Insider Dealing, Unlawful Disclosure, Market Manipulation or Anti-Competitive Conduct.
* Conduct investigation of compliance risk events or breaches. Oversight and check and challenge of corrective actions and preventative measures to avoid future occurrences.
* Implementation of compliance policies and procedures in line with regulatory requirements and ensuring that the bank’s internal policies are aligned with international standards, including jurisdictional requirements.
* Collaboration with 1LOD, other relevant Compliance teams and legal, and relevant risk management functions to facilitate a comprehensive approach to compliance and risk management.
* Identification, investigation and oversight of potential money laundering, terrorist financing or other financial crime.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
