Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.
  
  
Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Business and Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you'll be the analytical engine between a client's business need and the data solution that delivers it. You'll turn business questions into precise, testable requirements, then use the data itself to prove out what's possible: profiling sources, validating assumptions, and shaping designs that are clean, buildable, and grounded in evidence rather than opinion. You'll own the requirements and analysis for your use cases and workstreams, working in close partnership with Business Solution Managers who hold the broader engagement.
  
  
Doing that well takes two things at once: command of healthcare business context, and deep, hands-on fluency in the data. This is a client-facing role. You'll translate complex healthcare challenges into rigorous requirements, and you'll use SQL and analytical judgment to show clients and delivery teams what the data actually says, where it falls short, and what that means for the design.
  
  
No engagement lives in isolation. A data model built for one client's use case can share structure with a completely different client's need; a transformation rule written for one state's requirements often anticipates the next state's. You'll learn to see each requirement as part of a larger system of clients, states, use cases, and data flows, and to flag where a design can be reused or where it could collide with other work.
  
  
Our clients are US health plans and the partners who serve them, and the engagements span everything it takes to make their data usable. That can mean standardizing and migrating data onto a new platform, meeting evolving regulatory and compliance mandates, or powering the broader analytics and reporting programs that drive payer performance across Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial lines of business.
  
  
**Your day to day**
**Analyze the Data and Build the Evidence**

* Write and execute SQL daily to profile source data, test assumptions, quantify data quality (completeness, validity, uniqueness, consistency, timeliness), and prototype logic before it reaches the build team.
* Analyze source data to establish what is actually available and reliable: field population and distributions, key integrity, duplicates, outliers, and gaps against what the business use case needs.
* Reconcile and validate outputs against source systems and client-provided benchmarks (claim counts, member months, paid amounts, enrollment spans, provider rosters), investigating variances to root cause and documenting findings.
* Define and document business metrics and KPIs precisely: numerator, denominator, inclusion and exclusion logic, time basis, and grain, so every consumer of the data calculates and reads them the same way.
* Perform exploratory and root-cause analysis on client questions and data anomalies, and turn findings into clear, quantified recommendations for client and internal audiences.
* Summarize findings through data profiling reports, analysis readouts, and visualizations that make the story clear to non-technical stakeholders.

**Drive Requirements And Design For Your Use Cases**

* Lead discovery sessions for your use cases, and support broader engagement-level sessions alongside the Business Solution Manager, to understand the why and what behind each use case: the business context, pain points, expected outcomes, and success criteria, rather than just the surface-level data ask.
* Translate each use case into clear, testable requirements, including success criteria and non-functional requirements, and maintain traceability from business need to requirement to design to test.
* Use data analysis to sharpen and challenge requirements: confirm that what the client is asking for is supported by the data they have, and surface gaps early.
* Document source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, and business rules that developers can build from, and define the test conditions and expected results QA will use to validate them.
* Recommend the appropriate grain and structure of a dataset given the business context, and analyze how that grain decision ripples into the downstream reports, models, or programs that consume the data.
* Identify dependencies before a design is finalized: which other workstreams, reports, or client use cases touch this same data, and how a change here could break or benefit them, escalating cross-workstream impacts to the Business Solution Manager.
* Apply systems thinking: recognize when a design built for one client, state, or use case can become a reusable pattern, and raise and shape that reuse rather than discovering it in hindsight.

**Be a Trusted Client-Facing Partner**

* Drive requirements-gathering and clarification conversations with client SMEs for your use cases, since incomplete or poorly elicited requirements undermine everything built downstream.
* Present analysis results, data quality findings, and recommendations to client stakeholders with clarity and confidence, and guide decisions with evidence.
* Represent client intent for your use cases through delivery and serve as a day-to-day point of contact, with the Business Solution Manager owning the overall client relationship.
* Translate fluently between business and technical audiences, so both sides share the same understanding.

**Collaborate Across Delivery**

* Connect the client and the internal team on your workstreams, holding the business context, data findings, and design drivers that shape the build.
* Act as the business and data analysis SME for Solution Architects, Product, QA, Account Management, and Program Management, giving them clean hand-offs with the context, business rules, and analysis they need to execute without rework or reinterpretation.
* Support QA and UAT by supplying validation queries, expected results, and variance analysis, and by helping triage defects to business rule, mapping, or source data causes.
* Maintain awareness of the wider engagement: understand how a decision made for one workstream affects the others, and flag those ripple effects before they surface as rework.

**What You Bring To The Team**

* Bachelor's degree, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5+ years working in the US healthcare domain and with healthcare data (claims, provider, membership/eligibility, benefits, prior authorization, or PBM).
* Payer experience required: direct experience working with or for a US health plan (Medicare, Medicaid, or Commercial), whether in-house or through healthcare consulting.
* Working command of core payer concepts such as membership/enrollment, provider, claims, and authorizations, enough to reason about business context rather than specialize narrowly in any one area.
* Strong, hands-on SQL: comfortable with joins across large, multi-table datasets, window functions, CTEs, aggregations, and date/span logic, used regularly to profile, validate, reconcile, and analyze data.
* Demonstrated analytical rigor: a track record of profiling data, assessing data quality, investigating anomalies to root cause, and communicating quantified findings that drove a decision.
* Experience defining metrics, mentoring junior analysts, and eliciting and authoring business requirements in complex, data-driven environments.
* Confident client-facing communication; able to drive a conversation, elicit requirements clearly, and present analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Comfort operating with ambiguity and re-prioritizing frequently while managing multiple use cases within a larger engagement.
* Developing systems thinking: experience designing for reuse and scale across states, clients, or use cases rather than solving each case in isolation, and the ability to trace how a requirement or data model decision affects other parts of a larger data ecosystem.

**What We Would Like To See, But Not Required**

* Exposure to Databricks or Snowflake
* Experience with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to communicate analysis.
* Familiarity with HEDIS and Stars quality reporting, risk adjustment, payment integrity, value-based care analytics, provider data management, or CMS interoperability (CMS-0057).
* Working knowledge of data modeling concepts, including how the grain and structure of a dataset shape its downstream use.
* Familiarity with Python or similar for analysis and automation.

**Compensation**
Compensation for this role is based on experience, skills, and location, and includes base salary plus eligibility for performance bonuses and equity grants.
  
  
**What You’ll Get In Return**

* Competitive Leave & Benefits
* Comprehensive health coverage
* Equity for every employee – share in our success
* Growth-focused environment – your development matters here

**Work arrangements**

* Standard hours: 9 hours/day, 5 days/week
* Location: Pune, Onsite (1 PM - 10 PM IST)
* Shift: Your standard working hours will be nine (9) hours per day within the Company’s standard working hours. Specific working hours may vary based on business needs.

**Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer**
As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. Therefore, we dedicate resources to building diverse teams and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. Abacus prohibits discrimination and harassment regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

**Experience:**

Must have substantial experience in:
  
  

* Strong proficiency in Python (async/concurrency, FastAPI/Pydantic, pytest) and standard data analysis stacks (Pandas, NumPy).

* Experience building structured dataset curation pipelines, data cleansing, versioning (like S3), and synthetic data generation techniques.
* Observability: application monitoring, centralized logging, tracing; strong debugging and problem‑resolution skills.
* AI Governance

* Prior experience in financial services, healthcare, or heavily regulated enterprise environments, particularly with Model Risk Governance
* Experience evaluating complex multi-step reasoning, tool-calling agents, memory systems, and Multi-Agent Orchestration frameworks.
* Knowledge of data privacy and responsible AI practices; experience implementing audit and guardrail tooling.

**Education:**

description:

Responsible for conducting advanced data research, financial analysis, and strategic evaluations to support business objectives and decision-making processes. This role involves analyzing internal and external data, understanding market and economic trends, and developing actionable recommendations to improve business performance.
  
  
Work closely with senior management, project leaders, and cross-functional teams to drive key business initiatives and investments.
  
  
****Job Description****
**MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Identify data and reporting tools necessary to/and perform business, financial and data analysis. Communicate the results of the business, financial and data analysis. Plan and prepare financial and operational analysis resulting in information used in planning and decision making.

* Develop and analyze scorecards, providing insight into trends or unusual performance. Analyze competitive market strategies through analysis of related product, market or share trends. Perform market trend analysis, develop measurement tools to identify changing market trends.

* Experience using time management skills such as prioritizing/organizing and tracking details and meeting deadlines of multiple projects with varying completion dates.

****Education:****

* None

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The AVP, H&W Business Analyst will directly contribute to the Health & Wellness strategic initiatives, by translating business needs into clear technical requirements, partnering with Data & Analytics and technology teams to deliver process improvements and automation, and enabling effective data visualization and reporting insights. This role bridges business and technical stakeholders, supports Agile delivery, and ensures high-quality documentation, testing, and adoption of solutions. This position will report to the VP, H&W Product Manager.

* Partner with the Product Owner to develop user stories and define reporting and process improvement capabilities for development teams.

* Own the integrity and accuracy of the documentation repository, including current/future state process maps, use cases, and key decisions.
* Build strong working knowledge of the CareCredit and Enterprise Health Systems data and analytics foundation, including how data is used for reporting and operations.
* Support projects by clarifying requirements, helping set timelines, validating outcomes, tracking progress, and communicating updates to stakeholders.
* Assist in the development of dashboard communications and reporting artifacts.
* Maintain working knowledge of CareCredit data sources and definitions used for analytics and reporting.
* Lead analysts and/or initiatives as needed.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor's degree with minimum 5+ years of experience in Financial Services Industry in a technology liaison-type position and at least 3 years as Business Analyst, Project Manager or similar level role in Technology or Operations or in lieu of a degree 7+ years experience in Financial Services Industry in a technology liaison-type position and at least 3 years as Business Analyst, Project Manager or similar level role in Technology or Operations
* Self-starter with strong work ethic and ability to work independently.
* Strong project management skills with demonstrated ability to lead multiple initiatives.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and influence across teams.
* Strategic, action-oriented thinker with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Collaborative skill set with demonstrated ability to influence outcomes in a cross-functional, matrixed organization.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience using requirements tools such as Jira.
* Experience working with Agile teams (writing stories, managing sprints, translating business needs).
* Strong presentation and communication skills across multiple organizational levels.
* Experience with the CareCredit platform.
* Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn, question, and challenge the status quo
* Must be able to travel up to 10% of the time, as required..

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor's degree with minimum 5+ years of experience in Financial Services Industry in a technology liaison-type position and at least 3 years as Business Analyst, Project Manager or similar level role in Technology or Operations or in lieu of a degree 7+ years experience in Financial Services Industry in a technology liaison-type position and at least 3 years as Business Analyst, Project Manager or similar level role in Technology or Operations

**Work Timings**
05:30 AM Eastern Time – 2:30 PM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. Exceptions may apply periodically
  
  
due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details.

Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events

title: Data Analyst
description:
Comscore is looking for Data Analyst, who will be responsible to extract, transform, and analyze data, finding insights and answering questions about the content of the data. They will perform analytical hypothesis testing and modeling to provide key insight to internal and external clients.
  
  
Supports sales function by providing data expertise, feasibility reviews, and detailed analysis of questions raised by internal and external stakeholders. Some roles create and maintain internal and external user interface and reporting tools. These roles cross all Comscore product areas, including digital, mobile, OTT, and TV.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Leads data investigations; owns solutions and delivery
* Collaborates with Sr. Data Analyst, Managers, Leads, Client Insights team members, and other client facing teams to accomplish on-time and on-budget execution of requested analysis
* Takes full responsibility for analytic research
* Provides sales support through feasibility reviews and analysis; uses insight to contribute ideas
* Escalates issues when appropriate; navigates through internal teams easily
* Shows initiative outside assigned task
* Assists in the development of automating and streamlining custom work
* Formulates technical paths that make business sense to open-ended client problems

**What You’ll Need**

* 2-4+ years of related experience
* Strong proficiency with SQL and at least one programming language (Python or R)
* Translate SQL queries into shell scripts for use in automation & execution
* Working knowledge of ETL software (Preferably Airflow )
* Experience with AWS and cloud-based technologies is a plus
* Experience with either panel data, internet behavior data, television data, or other relevant data sources or Media measurement space in general is a plus.
* Ability to research new tools and methods to improve functionality and enhance productivity including AI tools.
* Advanced Excel knowledge and skills
* Ability to partner and collaborate across multiple teams
* Ability to research new tools and methods to improve functionality and enhance productivity
* Willingness to seek and provide constructive feedback

**Shift Timing**
The regular hours for this position will cover a combination of business hours in the US and India – typically 2PM-11PM IST. Occasionally, later hours may be required for meetings with teams in other parts of the world. Additionally, for the first 4-6 weeks of onboarding and training, US Eastern time hours (IST -9:30) may be required.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Medical: Comscore offers a collective Private Medical Insurance scheme which is 100% covered by Comscore.
* The benefit is applicable to employees, an employee’s spouse, up to two children and parents.
* Pension: Provident Fund: Comscore bears both the employee and employer contribution.
* Time Off Annual Leave: Comscore offers market competitive annual leave of 26 Annual Leave
* Days (8 Casual and 18 Privilege), following local guidelines and practices.
* National Holidays and Festival Holidays: 10 Days.
* Sick Leave: 10 Days.
* Additional Leave: Paternity, Bereavement, Marriage, Maternity, Additional Pregnancy / Birth
* Related Leave
* Christmas / New Year Paid Leave, Comscore offers a week of Company paid leave over the Christmas / New Year period.
* Summer Hours: Comscore has a culture that rewards employees for their hard work. When you work hard, you need time to recharge and refresh. Early releases on Fridays are subject to manager approval.
* Internal Career Development Opportunities (minimum of 6 months tenure in the current position and in discussion with supervisors)
* Access to hundreds of professional e-learning courses, specifically created for Comscore
* Be creative: You don’t have to follow the norm to be successful – we encourage you to think outside the box. Our culture is built on encouraging innovative ideas, communication and joint success.
* Informal Work Atmosphere: We believe in getting the job done in a comfortable, casual environment!
* The ability to become a truly global engineer, with exposure to markets across the world. With more than 30 offices around the world, many Comscore teams work together across locations.

**About Comscore**
At Comscore, we’re pioneering the future of cross-platform media measurement, arming organizations with the insights they need to make decisions with confidence. Central to this aim are our people who work together to simplify the complex on behalf of our clients & partners. Though our roles and skills are varied, we’re united by our commitment to five underlying values: Integrity, Velocity, Accountability, Teamwork, and Servant Leadership. If you’re motivated by big challenges and interested in helping some of the largest and most important media properties and brands navigate the future of media, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Comscore (NASDAQ: SCOR) is a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms. With a data footprint that combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence with advanced audience insights, Comscore allows media buyers and sellers to quantify their multiscreen behavior and make business decisions with confidence. A proven leader in measuring digital and set-top box audiences and advertising at scale, Comscore is the industry’s emerging, third-party source for reliable and comprehensive cross-platform measurement. To learn more about Comscore, please visit Comscore.com.
  
  
Comscore is committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity.

title: Sales Compensation & Performance Analytics Manager
description:
**About the role**

Pelsis Group is a global manufacturer and supplier of pest control, garden care and environmental solutions.

We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially minded
**Sales Compensation & Performance Analytics Manager**
, based in Pune and reporting into Sales Excellence, to help shape our global sales incentive programmes and provide insights that improve commercial performance.

Supporting approximately 90 sales professionals, alongside sales managers and directors, you will combine sales compensation expertise with commercial analytics. You will work closely with Sales, Finance, HR, Payroll and Business Operations across international markets, ensuring incentives reward the right behaviours and leaders have the information they need to make informed decisions.

This is a hands-on, highly visible role for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, challenging assumptions and turning data into practical action.

**What you’ll be doing**

* **Shaping effective sales incentives:**
  Review and simplify existing commission plans, contributing to globally aligned frameworks covering targets, commission rates, accelerators, thresholds, eligibility and management incentives, while accommodating local requirements.
* **Managing commission administration:**
  Own the end-to-end calculation process, validate sales data, resolve queries and prepare approval packs to support accurate and timely payments through regional payroll teams.
* **Supporting target setting:**
  Partner with commercial leaders on annual budgets and sales targets, using territory potential, growth plans and business priorities to inform recommendations.
* **Improving sales performance:**
  Analyse target attainment, commercial KPIs and regional performance to identify opportunities, diagnose challenges and recommend corrective actions.
* **Strengthening pipeline and forecasting insight:**
  Use CRM data to understand opportunity progression, identify stalled deals and highlight where management intervention could improve results.
* **Delivering executive reporting:**
  Provide clear insights into incentive expenditure, sales performance, pipeline health, forecast accuracy and return on incentive investment.
* **Maintaining strong governance:**
  Keep compensation plans, eligibility criteria, performance records and historical payouts accurate, ensuring effective reconciliation with Finance and Payroll.
* **Improving systems and processes:**
  Introduce automation, standardise ways of working and strengthen data quality, reporting accuracy and efficiency.
* **Building global partnerships:**
  Act as the global point of contact for sales compensation, communicating plans, calculations and performance information clearly across functions and regions.

**What we’re looking for**

You are naturally curious, commercially aware and comfortable moving between detailed analysis and discussions with senior leaders. You bring structure to complex information and can explain what the data means, why it matters and what action should follow.

**Essential experience and skills**

* Experience in Sales Compensation, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Finance or a related analytical role.
* Experience administering sales incentive plans, commissions or variable pay programmes.
* Strong analytical and financial modelling capability.
* Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with large, complex datasets.
* Strong CRM reporting and sales analytics experience.
* Experience analysing sales pipelines, forecasting performance and commercial KPIs.
* The ability to identify trends, investigate discrepancies and recommend practical solutions.
* Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and confidentiality.
* Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain complex information clearly to an international audience.
* Effective communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to influence colleagues across teams and regions.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and reporting deadlines.
* The ability to work independently while collaborating with international colleagues across time zones.

**Desirable**

* Experience designing sales compensation plans and governance frameworks.
* Experience within a global or multi-region sales organisation.
* Experience working with multiple currencies and coordinating commission inputs across regional payroll teams.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics CRM.
* Experience using Power BI or equivalent business intelligence tools.
* Knowledge of sales forecasting and pipeline-management methodologies.
* Experience delivering process improvements and automation.
* Experience within manufacturing or a product-based business.

**What we offer**

* A highly visible global role, based in Pune and reporting into Sales Excellence.
* The opportunity to combine compensation expertise, commercial analytics and sales operations in one position.
* Close collaboration with international sales leaders and colleagues across Finance, HR, Payroll and Business Operations.
* Scope to shape processes, improve reporting and introduce more effective ways of working.
* The opportunity to make a measurable contribution to sales effectiveness and business growth.

**If you enjoy turning complex data into clear insight and practical action, we would love to hear from you. Apply with your CV.**

title: Senior AI/DS Engineer
description:
**Designation :**
Senior AI/DS Engineer

**Required Experience:**

5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership.

**Job Description:**

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production.

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

:

**1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -**

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria.

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs.

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach.

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications.

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement.

**2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership**

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring.

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern.

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices.

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimisation while enabling the team to execute independently.

**3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows**

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate.

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation.

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior.

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed.

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops.

**4. Applied machine learning and data science**

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization.

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly.

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data.

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role.

**5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps**

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation.

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture.

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover.

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable.

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities.

**6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment**

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support.

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers.

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts.

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

**7. Team leadership, governance and responsible AI**

● Coach and mentor AI engineers and data scientists; support work allocation, technical growth, feedback, code/model reviews and consistent quality standards.

●Apply appropriate data governance, privacy, access control, PII handling, audit logging, human review and responsible-AI safeguards based on use-case risk.

●Identify GenAI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool access, unintended data exposure, unsupported outputs and misuse; document mitigations and residual risks.

●Build reusable patterns, documentation and team practices that improve delivery predictability across multiple customer engagements

**Required Qualifications and experience:**

●5-6 years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, data science or applied                        

AI experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on delivery experience.

●At least 2 years leading a technical team, delivery workstream or project; demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and outcomes.

●At least 2 years in customer-facing or stakeholder-facing delivery, with evidence of running discovery workshops, clarifying requirements, presenting options and managing expectations.

●Strong Python engineering and practical SQL/data skills; understanding of testing, APIs, code quality and software engineering fundamentals.

●Strong applied ML/statistical reasoning and model evaluation skills, including the ability to choose baselines, validate results and explain limitations.

●At least 2 years building GenAI/LLM applications, including practical RAG experience; able to explain architecture, evaluation, failure modes and production trade-offs. At least one production deployment is strongly preferred.

●Working experience with AWS or the target cloud platform, and with model/application deployment, CI/CD, observability and production support.

●Experience with REST APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent Python web framework, and with at least one vector database or semantic-search technology when RAG is in scope.

●Strong communication, facilitation, documentation, mentoring and problem-solving skills.

●Hands-on experience with agentic/tool-using workflows, multimodal LLMs, VLMs, or more than one model provider.

●Computer vision, OCR, intelligent document processing, object detection, image segmentation or document-understanding experience where relevant to the client pipeline.

●Experience with model fine-tuning, embedding adaptation, open-source model serving or GPU/inference optimization.

●Familiarity with evaluation and tracing tools such as LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, Phoenix or equivalent; equivalent tools are acceptable.

●Experience in consulting, professional services or multi-client delivery environments.

●Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered.

title: Manager - Financial Planning and Analysis
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit : www.skf.com /in

****About Industrial Markets****

The industrial market in India is a dynamic and rapidly evolving sector that plays a crucial role in a company’s economic growth, with the manufacturing sector being the most diverse and promising. Industrial customers aim to improve operational efficiency while prioritising quality, reliability, and value collaborations that demonstrate a commitment to customer satisfaction and address their evolving needs.

At SKF, we provide industry-leading engineering solutions and technologies to industrial market that consistently deliver reliability and efficiency in their day-to-day operations. We cater to a range of industrial sectors, including heavy industries, wind, metals, railways, and general machinery, and help customers achieve their key objectives, depending on their specific application needs and challenges around the machines and equipment.

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB DESCRIPTION****

**Position Title:**
Manager – FP&A

**Reports To:**
India Industrial Controller

**Role Type:**
Team Management

**Location:**
Pune

****Key Responsibilities****

* Business planning, budgeting and forecasting: Prepare the annual business plan and monthly, quarterly, and rolling forecasts. Coordinate the planning and monthly outlook processes for the Industrial Business. Consolidate, review, and analyse forecasts in Anaplan or other approved reporting tools. Provide clear actual-versus-forecast analysis by month and quarter.
* Mid- and long-range planning: Develop the mid- and long-range financial plan. Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate strategic options through scenario modelling and sensitivity analysis.
* Financial performance analysis : Conduct detailed contribution-margin, gross-margin, and PLP analysis. Assess price, mix, and volume movements by segment, SKU, and customer against the prior year, including PS and LPC impacts.
* Customer and order-book analysis: Identify high-, low-, and negative-margin customers and explain the key drivers of performance. Analyse the order book and operating margin by segment.
* Pricing governance: Support the business with pricing and margin analysis and simulations. Track OEM price increases by segment. Maintain a central repository of customer ARCs and monitor price-escalation clauses and related commercial exposure.
* Restatement: Complete the annual restatement process in accordance with SKF requirements and the agreed timetable.
* Inventory management: Monitor OEM inventory and work with KAMs to deliver reduction plans. Review dead and slow-moving stock, assess the adequacy of obsolescence provisions, and coordinate liquidation actions with KAMs and segment heads. Develop and monitor targeted inventory-reduction initiatives.
* Business performance support: Provide structured communications, timelines, and guidance to segment heads. Deliver profitability analysis by segment, product, and customer. Investigate errors affecting India results and coordinate corrective action with the relevant stakeholders. Review revenue, operating margin, and net working capital performance with segment heads, highlighting successes, risks, and required actions.
* Decision support: Perform ad hoc analysis, simulations, and financial modelling to support business decisions.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Annual business plan: Submit the complete business plan by the agreed deadline, with all key assumptions, risks, and supporting schedules documented and approved. Prepare the presentation deck in accordance with management guidelines.
* Forecast accuracy: Submit the monthly forecast by WD5. Maintain revenue and operating-profit forecast variance within ±5% of actual results. Document the causes of material deviations and agree corrective actions with segment heads. Prepare the annual forecast template and circulate it monthly for segment inputs.
* Long-range planning: Complete the mid- and long-range plan according to the annual timetable, including base, upside, and downside scenarios with quantified financial impacts.
* Scenario analysis: Deliver standard what-if analyses within three working days and complex analyses by the agreed deadline. Clearly document assumptions, sensitivities, and financial implications.
* Segment analysis: Complete monthly contribution-margin and PLP analysis for all segments by WD8. Explain at least 90% of material variances against the Business Plan and prior year.
* Margin improvement: Review all negative-margin customers monthly. Assign an owner and due date to every material case, track actions to closure, and quantify the expected margin benefit.
* Business support: Deliver at least 90% of agreed pricing, margin, and ad hoc analyses by the committed deadline, with no material data or calculation errors.
* Pricing governance: Track all approved OEM price increases by segment. Escalate overdue or unimplemented actions within five working days and report realised versus planned impact monthly.
* Contract and restatement controls: Maintain a complete repository of active OEM ARCs and other pricing agreements. Flag relevant clauses before their due dates and complete each restatement review according to the agreed closing timetable.
* Inventory and obsolescence: Coordinate bi-weekly inventory reviews with Logistics, covering month-on-month movements and the drivers of changes in DCD, SRO, and SRO GIT. Issue a bi-weekly status report to segment heads and the Customer Service team. Assess all identified dead- and slow-moving inventory and complete at least 90% of agreed reduction or liquidation actions by the due date.

****Education & Experience****

* Chartered Accountant or Cost and Management Accountant with 12–14 years of relevant experience.
* Strong experience in business controlling, FP&A, and commercial finance.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Power BI, SAP/ERP.
* Strong communication, stakeholder-management, networking, and influencing skills.
* Demonstrates integrity and the courage to challenge constructively.

**Key Competencies**

* Business planning, budgeting and forecasting
* Mid- and long-range planning
* Business performance support
* Inventory management

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Supplier Account Manager
description:
Job Title
  
  
Supplier Account Manager
  
  
**Job Description**
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a proactive and analytical
**Supplier Account Manager**
to drive supplier performance management, supplier portfolio optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives. In this role, you will leverage benchmarking, data analytics, and supplier relationship management to enhance supplier value, optimize costs, mitigate risks, and improve operational efficiency.
  
  
You will collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders to rationalize the supplier base, manage supplier transitions, ensure compliance, and develop strategies aligned with business objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Supplier Performance Management: Develop and implement benchmarking frameworks, performance analytics, KPIs, and targets to systematically evaluate supplier capabilities and performance.
* Supplier Portfolio Optimization: Drive supplier tail management, identify low-value suppliers, and implement supplier consolidation and rationalization strategies to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
* Supplier Phase-Out Management: Lead supplier exit and phase-out activities, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth transitions, business continuity, and risk mitigation.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify performance gaps through data analytics and implement corrective actions and improvement initiatives to maximize supplier value.
* Data-Driven Decision-Making: Analyze supplier performance metrics, market trends, and benchmarking data to generate actionable insights and support informed procurement decisions.
* Cost Optimization: Identify opportunities for cost savings, process improvements, and Design-to-Cost initiatives while balancing quality, service, and business requirements.
* Risk and Compliance Management: Ensure suppliers adhere to applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, safety guidelines, and ethical business practices.
* Supplier Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with key suppliers, foster collaboration, resolve performance issues, and align supplier objectives with business priorities.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Procurement, Supply Chain, Quality, Operations, and other relevant teams to implement supplier strategies and deliver business value.
* Strategic Recommendations: Present supplier performance insights, benchmarking outcomes, and portfolio optimization recommendations to management to support strategic decision-making.
* Innovation and Best Practices: Encourage supplier collaboration, knowledge sharing, and innovative approaches to improve product quality, operational performance, and value creation.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Procurement, Supply Chain Management, or an equivalent discipline.

**Work Experience**

* 10 years of relevant experience.

**Relevant Experience May Include**

* Market analysis and research
* Supplier negotiations and relationship management
* Strategic sourcing or buying
* Supplier performance management
* Business process engineering or process improvement

**Preferred Skills And Competencies**

* Supplier Performance Management and KPI Monitoring
* Supplier Evaluation and Benchmarking Methodologies
* Supplier Relationship Management
* Data Analytics, Performance Reporting, and Market Research
* Cost Optimization and Design-to-Cost
* Continuous Improvement and Process Excellence
* Contract Management and Supplier Negotiations
* Supplier Risk Management and Regulatory Compliance
* Procurement and Supply Chain Business Acumen
* Project Management and Stakeholder Collaboration
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
* Ability to translate data and performance insights into actionable business strategies

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Improved supplier performance, reliability, and accountability.
* Reduced supplier complexity through effective portfolio optimization.
* Measurable cost savings and improved operational efficiency.
* Effective supplier transitions with minimal business disruption.
* Stronger supplier relationships, improved compliance, and reduced risk.
* Sustainable continuous improvement and value creation across the supplier base.

**Join us to drive supplier excellence, optimize procurement performance, and create sustainable business value through data-driven supplier management.**
**How We Work Together**
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
  
  
Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.
  
  
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
  
  
Indicate if this role is an office role.

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
  
  

* Learn more about our business.
* Discover our rich and exciting history.
* Learn more about our purpose.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.

As the Site Controller Flavours, you will provide appropriate financial support to the Head of Operations for the performance management, budget management and internal controls. Sounds interesting? It could well be your perfect opportunity if, like us, you always aim to challenge yourself while being eager to learn every day in order to exceed customer needs and deliver value. You are also skilled at fostering strong relationships.
  
  
**Business Support**
**In this exciting role you will:**
You will support the site management in the development and analysis of business plans, forecasts, cost savings opportunities, etc. associated with the months-end financial close. You will support the management in strategic decision making. In special projects you will give additionally overall financial support.
  
  
The role involves overseeing several manufacturing facilities (Pune, Daman, Roha) and you will be supported by a local cost controller.
  
  
**Planning And Forecasting**
You will perform ad-hoc and pro-active analysis of the monthly KPIs and provide the management with interpretive and predictive information for decision making. Last you will participate in forecasting and mid-to long term planning for the factory.
  
  
**Budget Cycle And Costing**
You will manage annual and periodic requirements of costing activities and analysis of COGS. You will provide detailed product costing analysis and supports management in the evaluation of product costs. Moreover you will manage and coordinate the annual budget process for the site.
  
  
**Business Partnering And Leadership**
You will work closely with the site and area management and help them to improve key performance indicators. You will contribute as an active member in site projects and initiatives that drive process/cost improvements (i.e., Supply Chain, LEAN, BIT). To stay informed of site activities you will attend and actively participate in site operations meetings and provide finance support/action where required.

If so, this is a unique opportunity to make a difference, where your passion will match our business purpose. Why not come join us – and impact your world.

* Minimum 6 to 8 years’ experience in controlling in a manufacturing environment
* Working knowledge of costing processes and procedures
* Proven team leader skill is an advantage
* Excellent communication skills in English. Dutch and French are an advantage.
* Structured analytical thinking
* Strong financial background (budgeting process, reporting, financial analysis, controlling, accounting)
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to integrate in complex teams within a matrix organization
* SAP FI/CO and advanced Excel & Powerpoint skills

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.

Every essence of you enriches our world.

title: Team Lead, Provider Data Operations
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**About The Role**
***We’re hiring an AI-first Operations Team Lead; an operations leader who uses AI to build better workflows, not just talk about its potential.***
As a Provider Data Operations Team Lead, you will lead and coach a team while owning productivity, quality, and SLA performance. You will bring clarity to ambiguous problems, remove workflow bottlenecks, and ensure the team executes consistently against operational goals.
  
  
You will also use AI hands-on in your daily work. You’ll identify repetitive or error-prone tasks, test AI-enabled approaches, balance speed with accuracy and human review, and turn successful experiments into repeatable workflows the broader team can adopt safely and effectively.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of a Provider Data Operations Team Lead:**

* Use AI to Improve Daily Operations: Use AI tools hands-on to analyze problems, accelerate routine work, summarize information, improve data quality, and support better decisions. Regularly ask where a manual workflow can be simplified, automated, or redesigned.
* Identify, Pilot & Scale AI-Enabled Solutions: Spot high-value opportunities to reduce repetitive work or prevent errors. Design practical pilots, define success measures, evaluate results, and partner with AI, Product, Systems, and Operations teams to turn proven ideas into sustainable workflows.
* Balance Speed, Accuracy & Human Review: Apply sound judgment to determine where AI can operate independently and where human validation is required. Monitor output quality, surface risks, and ensure AI-enabled processes remain accurate, explainable, and aligned with established guardrails.
* Lead Team Execution & Daily Operations: Oversee day-to-day operations for a team of 8-10 Researchers, Associates, and Senior Associates. Provide clear direction on case handling, workflow interpretation, and complex troubleshooting to deliver consistently against productivity, quality, and SLA targets.
* Manage Workflows & Drive Throughput: Own workload distribution, proactively identify bottlenecks, and reallocate work to maintain flow and meet operational goals. Independently manage complex workstreams with minimal supervision.
* Ensure Quality & Process Adherence: Provide quality oversight through case reviews, audits, and trend analysis. Ensure consistent application of SOPs and policies, address escalations, and maintain high standards across both human and AI-assisted outputs.
* Coach & Develop Team Members: Deliver coaching tailored to individual strengths and development areas. Support onboarding, training, and continuous skill-building, including helping team members use AI tools confidently, responsibly, and effectively.
* Lead Change & Drive Adoption: Translate new tools and pilots into clear operating guidance. Gather team feedback, address adoption barriers, and reinforce the behaviors needed to make improved workflows stick.
* Partner with Stakeholders in India and the US: Build strong cross-functional relationships, align on priorities and success measures, manage expectations, and escalate appropriately to ensure smooth execution across time zones.
* Navigate Ambiguity & Drive Continuous Improvement: Break ambiguous problems into clear next steps, use data and experimentation to learn quickly, and create repeatable processes from successful solutions.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in data operations, business operations, analytics, research, or customer service. People management experience is preferred; however, strong individual contributors with hands-on AI or automation experience and demonstrated readiness to transition into a leadership role will also be considered.
* An AI-native approach to problem-solving: you naturally explore whether manual work can be improved, automated, or supported by AI.
* Experience using Claude is a plus.
* Hands-on experience in building AI-enabled tools, agents, workflow automations, or data/process automation solutions to solve business or operational problems.
* Ability to evaluate AI output critically, recognize limitations, and design appropriate human-review checks to protect accuracy and data quality.
* Demonstrated ability to turn experiments into documented, measurable, repeatable workflows and coach others through change.
* Strong operations leadership, including workload management, performance coaching, SLA ownership, quality oversight, and escalation handling.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to use data to diagnose problems and measure impact.
* Curious, hands-on, and quick to learn new tools; comfortable experimenting within defined guardrails.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace applications, plus experience with tools such as Salesforce and Confluence and the ability to work with large data sets.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong interpersonal skills and a track record of building engaged, adaptable, and high-performing teams.
* A Bachelor’s degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* Experience in US healthcare or healthcare technology is a plus.
* Experience working across global or cross-time-zone teams, particularly India and the US, is a plus.

**You do not need to be an engineer or an AI researcher.**
You should be excited to learn, willing to experiment hands-on, and motivated to use AI to make operations faster, more accurate, and easier to scale.
  
  
**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026

**About Us**
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
  
  
Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values -
*Together, Not Alone*
, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

title: Manager, Strategy & Corporate Development
description:
**What You’ll Do**
Eaton is seeking a Manager, Strategy & Corporate Development team in driving enterprise growth through rigorous financial analysis, valuation, and business case development. The role will support both organic and inorganic growth initiatives, including portfolio analysis, strategic planning, and deal evaluation, and will work closely with global SCD leadership team.
  
  

* Evaluate enterprise, business-unit, and peer performance through returns, capital allocation, and value creation analyses.
* Perform financial analyses that support strategic initiatives, organic growth, and M&A decisions, isolating the factors that drive or erode growth, profitability, and capital returns.
* Build and maintain valuation models, including DCF, trading comparables, sensitivity analysis, and scenario modeling.
* Develop clear, executive-ready business case presentations that translate analysis into strategic recommendations.
* Support portfolio strategy by evaluating resource allocation, value creation opportunities, and underperforming areas.
* Analyze end-markets, competitors, suppliers, and industry trends to support corporate strategy and deal screening.
* Partner closely with business unit leaders, finance, and corporate development stakeholders to support decision-making and transaction execution.
* Assist in preparing materials for leadership reviews, investment discussions, and strategic planning cycles.

**Qualifications**

* 8-10 years of relevant experience in investment banking, industrial M&A, corporate development, transaction advisory, or a similar finance-intensive role.
* MBA or equivalent finance-focused qualification preferred.

**Skills**

* Strong command of financial modeling, valuation, accounting, and corporate finance.
* CFA Level 3 cleared or equivalent.
* Demonstrated ability to prepare DCF models, valuation analyses, and investment-style business cases.
* Strong understanding of DuPont analysis, return on capital, and value creation frameworks.
* Excellent Excel and PowerPoint skills, with strong attention to detail and model integrity.
* Ability to communicate complex financial insights clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Experience working in industrial, manufacturing, or enterprise environments preferred.
* Exposure to organic growth strategy, M&A, portfolio management, or enterprise capital allocation.
* Experience supporting board or executive-level presentations.
* Strong research capability and comfort working with public and market data.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.

title: Senior Principal Software Engineer - Performance Analytics
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Principal Software Engineer - Performance Analytics within Engineering to build performance intelligence for our advertising platform.
  
  
The role will analyze campaign and platform performance, identify anomalies and opportunities, investigate root causes, and translate data into actions for Engineering, Trading, Product, and Business. This is not primarily a reporting role—the focus is understanding what is happening, why, and what we should do about it.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Analyze performance across campaigns, inventory, audiences, bidding, models, and conversions.
* Monitor and investigate CPA, CPC, CTR, VCR, ROAS, spend, delivery, and revenue.
* Proactively detect performance anomalies and optimization opportunities.
* Perform root-cause analysis across models, inventory, identity, attribution, audience, and data quality.
* Design and analyze A/B tests and experiments.
* Build reusable SQL/Python analyses, metrics, and automated diagnostics.
* Partner with Engineering and Trading to turn insights into measurable improvements.
* Convert recurring investigations into AI-assisted troubleshooting and automation.

**We'd Love for You to Have**

* Strong SQL and Python skills with experience analyzing large-scale datasets.
* Strong analytical, statistical, and experimentation fundamentals.
* Experience with platforms such as Snowflake, Spark, Trino, Databricks, or BigQuery.
* Understanding of data pipelines, data modeling, and data quality.
* Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
* AdTech, marketplace, recommendation, or high-scale platform experience preferred.
* Experience with RTB, bidding, attribution, campaign optimization, or ML-driven systems is a strong plus.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT) or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute or university; advanced degree is a plus but not required given depth of experience.

**What Success Looks Like**
Detect earlier → Diagnose faster → Recommend action → Automate
  
  
The goal is not more dashboards. The goal is to create a performance intelligence capability that improves campaign outcomes, reduces investigation time, guides Engineering/Trading decisions, and becomes the foundation for AI-native troubleshooting.
  
  
**AI-Enabled Engineering Mindset**
We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc.) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high-scale, performance-critical environment.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!

title: Solution Consultant/Business Analyst - Tieto Banktech (m/f/d)
description:
**Job Description**
Do you want to join and support banking products with a focus on customer, business and ITIL processes? We are looking for you who want to work as a Solution Consultant. with us and join our exciting journey to digitize the financial market! If you are working as a Business Analyst or a Solution Consultant today and want to continue your career, this is just right for you!
  
  
What we offer you
  
  
Our goal is understanding our customer business and support them with quality deliverables. With quality-oriented colleagues and interesting multi-level customer relationships, with experienced and professional consultants who handle the interaction between business and IT, we have a big and positive impact on our customers' business activities
  
  
As one of the leading providers of payment technology and software in the Nordics and globally, we focus on supporting digital innovation and real-time transformation with cutting-edge solutions
  
  
Do you want to join the Global Payment and Cash Management (Virtual accounts/AiO) team to enables banks to deliver a real-time liquidity overview to corporate customers, accelerated settlement and benefits of immediate availability of funds? We are looking for professionals who want to work in this domain as Solution Consultants and join our exciting journey to digitize the financial market! If you are working as a Business Analyst or a Solution Consultant, you have the best opportunity to learn the Payment domain & Cash Management and take your career to new heights working with global banks around the world.
  
  
With us, you will be responsible
  
  
For Application Support & Maintenance of world class Global Payment and Cash Management products used by global banks. As a Solution consultant your central task will be working closely with the customer to analyse the reported defects, incidents and request for changes by the customer of the world’s biggest banks. The role requires daily interaction with customer ‘s business and technical experts, service managers, IT teams and other subject matter experts to understand the customer needs and provide the solution to fulfil those. This includes defect analysis during implementation, incident & problem management during maintenance, root cause analysis and preventive action items. Establish a good professional relationship with the customer where the customer trusts you to be their reliable partner to grow their business and meet their client SLAs.
  
  
You will also bring business and domain knowledge to the teams, assisting them in developing the Cash Management and Global Payment solutions for the future. Support and participate in testing the customer defects as and when needed.
  
  
Day to day activities involve
  
  

* Act as the first escalation point for operational issues, level 2 (L2) Support member.
* Technical and functional analysis of the production incidents/problem tickets and test defects.
* For SaaS customers, strategies the monitoring, alerting, configuring the health dashboard and insights with the help of continuous inputs from internal product team.
* Ensuring workarounds to major incidents are given where java technical expertise is required.
* Engaging in frequent bridge calls with customers to provide functional/technical solution to their problems.

Solution consultant (Java Techno-functional expertise)
**4 - 9 years**
of experience in the
**IT/Support industry**
.
  
  
We seek you with previous experience from the role of Techo functional Business Analyst/Solution Consultant in the Financial Sector where you have provided consulting and/or business analysis support in areas related to Global Payment & Cash Management.  Specialists in any of these areas will be preferred and hands on experience with solutions for various products like direct debits, direct credits, payments, virtual accounts, cash management solutions, account solutions, multi-bank payments and ISO based payments.
  
  
We believe you have at least 4 - 9 years of experience from the role or in process. You master English fluently in speech and writing.
  
  
We value that you as a person have the power to improve the financial sector and want to develop in a role where you can run IT and / or business-oriented change projects. You are genuinely interested in seeking new knowledge and experience, are results- and customer-oriented and used to working in Customer Success area. You should be a team player where you learn and share with the team.
  
  
Should also have the skills to work independently and feeling confident in your professional role, where you take great responsibility and ownership of the problem at hand.
  
  
**Required Skills**
**Domain/Application Support Experience (Mandatory):**

* Global Payments
* Cash Management
* Core Banking

**Good-to-Have: Technical Understanding**

* Basic to intermediate understanding of Java technologies including Core Java, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Angular, and RESTful Web Services.
* Knowledge of Oracle, IBM MQ, and WebSphere Application Server (WAS).
* Familiarity with application servers such as WebSphere and JBoss.
* Awareness of cloud platforms including AWS and/or GCP.
* Understanding databases such as Oracle and DB2/SQL.
* Exposure to tools including Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), and ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Maven and Jenkins.
* ITIL certification or knowledge of ITIL processes is preferred.
* Prior experience in Application Production Support is an advantage.

**As a person you are**

* Good communication & collaboration skills
* Solution oriented.
* Possess excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, who can display an ability to deal with complexity.
* Proactive and innovative
* Good communication & collaboration skills
* Having sense of ownership and accountable for your own tasks/activities.

Did we get you inspired?
  
  
We look forward to your application! Interviews will be held continuously, so we encourage you to apply today! For more information or questions, please contact krishna.kumari@tieto.com
  
  
Hope to hear from you soon!
