title: SVP - Salesforce Technical Lead – IB Tech & CRM/Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
About IB Technology:
  
  
IB Tech, CRM & Analytics is a strategic, agile and cross-functional team responsible for leading the firm's global digitalization effort through innovative technology, data science and deep analytics. The team partners with all client-facing business units and corporate functions, as well as industry experts, to build transformational technology impacting investment banking, trading, sales, and research teams to drive revenue, maximize efficiency, and optimize client service.
  
  
We are at the forefront of Jefferies' cloud initiative, leveraging best-in-class cloud-based technologies to replace legacy on-premises solutions to provide intelligent trend insights, actionable opportunities, decision support, and transparency into all client and business-related activities.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As an SVP, Lead Salesforce Engineer, this role leads the Salesforce engineering practice, development team, and platform — multi-system integration patterns, large-scale data model design, and framework level decisions that shape how the entire team builds. Leads a team of engineers — accountable for their delivery, performance, and growth. Demands deep engineering expertise, high-impact decision-making, and the drive to push deliveries across the finish line. Communicates with clarity and conviction across time zones.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Ownership & Delivery: Own workstreams end-to-end — technical approach, patterns, delivery quality, and timeline. Own commitments to senior stakeholders.
* Complex Engineering: Design and build the highest-consequence pieces — parallel integration orchestration, compliance-grade audit architectures, config-driven framework extensions, data models with regulatory correctness requirements.
* Pattern Setting: Define reusable integration adapters, async strategies, error handling, and component architecture standards. Review critical PRs as final technical checkpoint.
* Team Leadership & Global Coordination: Lead engineers across a globally distributed practice. Own delivery cadence, align priorities across time zones. Responsible for team performance, career development, and technical growth.
* Engineering Unblocking: The escalation layer for the engineering team. Resolve ambiguous integration contracts, governor limit constraints, framework conflicts, cross-cutting concerns.
* Innovation & Governance: Evaluate emerging capabilities and drives innovation. Participate in architecture review forums. Evaluate and select engineering tools for the workstream.
* Code Quality & Standards: Set the bar - testing strategy, review standards, deployment guardrails. Hold the team accountable.

Mandatory Qualifications & Skills:
  
  

* LWC framework architecture — config-driven component systems, dynamic metadata rendering, cross-component state patterns, Custom Metadata as application configuration.
* Apex at platform level — async orchestration, bulkification standards, partial failure handling as team-wide convention. Salesforce security architecture — sharing model design, platform encryption.
* Multi-system integration — adapter patterns, error contracts, retry strategies, graceful degradation. Platform Events, CDC, Named Credentials, External Services.
* Audit-grade data architecture & performance profiling — immutable history, point-in-time snapshots, regulatory-defensible design. Large data volume strategies and archival patterns.
* Has led and scaled distributed Salesforce engineering teams across time zones. Owns delivery commitments to senior stakeholders, defends platform architecture trade-offs.
* Good to Have: TypeScript. Test automation. AWS (Lambda, S3, API Gateway).

Education & Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 12+ years of relevant experience, with at least 3 years of owing platform level technical decisions.
* Financial Services background
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
* Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect (strongly preferred).

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
  
  
At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.
  
  
Jefferies is an equal employment opportunity employer, and takes affirmative action to ensure that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, gender, pregnancy, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, genetic information, reproductive health decisions, or any other factor protected by applicable law. We are committed to hiring the most qualified applicants and complying with all federal, state, and local equal employment opportunity laws. As part of this commitment, Jefferies will extend reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities, as required by applicable law.

title: Engineering Manager, Data & Analytics
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager, Data & Analytics to lead a team responsible for operating, scaling, and evolving our large-scale advertising data and analytics ecosystem.
  
  
The team owns business-critical real-time and batch data systems supporting real-time reporting, scheduled reporting, ad-hoc analytics, log-level data, audiences, ad-serving use cases, observability, and machine-learning feedback loops.
  
  
This role requires a strong combination of technical leadership, people management, execution, and stakeholder management. The Engineering Manager will work closely with Engineering, Product, Business, Analytics, and ML teams to evolve the existing ecosystem while maintaining reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Engineering & Technical Leadership**

* Own the technical direction and evolution of large-scale real-time and batch analytics systems.
* Scale streaming workloads built on technologies such as Kafka and Spark Streaming.
* Evolve analytical and data-processing workloads across Snowflake, HDFS, and object storage.
* Support real-time, scheduled, ad-hoc, and log-level reporting at advertising scale.
* Drive improvements in scalability, reliability, performance, data quality, and infrastructure efficiency.
* Modernize components of the existing ecosystem while protecting business-critical workloads.
* Strengthen observability, monitoring, data lineage, SLAs/SLOs, and operational excellence.
* Enable data capabilities supporting audiences, ad serving, experimentation, ML training and feedback loops, and AI-driven use cases.
* Evaluate appropriate adoption of CPU/GPU accelerated computing and emerging data and AI technologies.Drive architecture reviews and establish strong engineering standards across the team.

**People & Execution Leadership**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team.
* Hire and develop engineers and create strong technical leaders within the organization.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability across critical systems.
* Own roadmap planning, prioritization, execution, and delivery.
* Balance new capabilities with technical debt, platform modernization, reliability, and operational commitments.
* Lead incident reviews and drive systemic fixes to prevent recurring production problems.
* Foster an engineering culture focused on ownership, technical excellence, simplicity, and measurable outcomes.

**Stakeholder Leadership**

* Partner closely with senior stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Business, Analytics, Trading, and Machine Learning.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical strategies.
* Lead challenging discussions involving priorities, timelines, technical limitations, architecture, cost, and competing business requirements.
* Challenge assumptions and requirements when necessary and provide data-driven alternatives.
* Clearly communicate technical trade-offs, risks, and investment requirements to technical and non-technical leadership.
* Build alignment across teams where ownership and priorities may not naturally align.

**We'd Love for You to Have**

* 10+ years of engineering experience, with significant experience leading and managing engineering teams.
* Proven experience hiring, mentoring, developing, and growing engineers and technical leaders.
* Strong technical background in large-scale distributed data and analytics systems.
* Hands-on architectural understanding of technologies such as Kafka, Spark/Spark Streaming, Snowflake, HDFS, and object storage.
* Deep understanding of streaming, batch processing, distributed computing, data modeling, and analytical architectures. Experience operating and evolving high-throughput, business-critical production systems.
* Strong understanding of system scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and infrastructure cost optimization.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, including experience working with senior technical and business leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate difficult conversations, resolve conflicting priorities, make trade-offs, and drive decisions.
* Ability to connect business outcomes with technical strategy and engineering execution.
* Experience with AdTech, high-scale real-time systems, audience platforms, ML/data infrastructure, or accelerated computing is a strong plus.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT) or an equivalent degree from a well-known institute or university; advanced degree is a plus but not required given depth of experience.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success means scaling and evolving an established, business-critical data ecosystem while building a strong engineering organization around it.
  
  
The platform should become more reliable, scalable, observable, cost-efficient, and easier to operate, while continuing to support growing reporting, analytics, audience, ML, and AI use cases.
  
  
At the same time, the Engineering Manager should develop a team with strong technical ownership, consistently deliver against business priorities, and effectively navigate complex stakeholder discussions and competing priorities.
  
  
**AI-Enabled Engineering Mindset**
We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc.) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high-scale, performance-critical environment.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
  
  
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

title: Pricing Analyst - Senior
description:
**Job Summary**
The Pricing Analyst – Senior is responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing pricing strategies that drive profitable growth while maintaining market competitiveness. This role leads pricing operations, pricing analytics, and cross-functional pricing initiatives by ensuring accurate pricing data, executing strategic price revisions, supporting customer pricing, and delivering actionable business insights. The position collaborates closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, and business leadership to align pricing decisions with organizational objectives, enhance pricing processes, and improve customer value.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the development, implementation, and execution of pricing strategies that support business growth, profitability, and competitive positioning.
* Plan, analyze, obtain approvals for, and execute annual and mid-year pricing revisions across multiple product lines and market segments.
* Maintain accurate pricing data across ERP, CRM, order management, rebate, and pricing systems, ensuring data integrity and first-time accuracy.
* Manage multiple pricing structures and price lists while ensuring synchronization across enterprise systems.
* Prepare customer quotations and pricing proposals in collaboration with Sales teams and support complex customer pricing negotiations.
* Analyze pricing performance, market trends, customer behavior, competitive intelligence, and win/loss data to recommend pricing improvements and business actions.
* Lead pricing governance forums and facilitate collaborative pricing decisions with Sales, Finance, and business leadership.
* Design and continuously improve pricing methodologies, pricing policies, and pricing philosophies aligned with business objectives.
* Lead pricing analytics initiatives by leveraging business intelligence, automation, AI, and digital tools to improve pricing effectiveness and decision-making.
* Develop reports, dashboards, forecasts, and executive presentations that provide meaningful pricing insights and business recommendations.
* Lead pricing improvement projects, process optimization initiatives, and continuous improvement activities to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure timely resolution of complex pricing issues while providing excellent support to internal and external customers.
* Maintain confidentiality of pricing information and ensure compliance with company policies, governance requirements, and applicable regulations.
* Monitor pricing operational KPIs including turnaround time, accuracy, and service levels, implementing corrective actions where required.
* Coach, mentor, and develop pricing team members while fostering a collaborative, high-performance work environment.

Build strong partnerships across Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, Supply Chain, and other business functions to achieve shared business goals.
  
  
**Core Competencies**

* Pricing Strategy & Execution
* Pricing Analytics & Business Intelligence
* Market Analysis & Forecasting
* Financial & Commercial Acumen
* Customer Pricing & Quotation Management
* Data Analysis & Decision Making
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Stakeholder Management & Influencing
* Project Leadership & Continuous Improvement
* ERP, CRM & Pricing Systems Management
* AI & Digital Analytics Adoption
* Problem Solving & Critical Thinking
* Process Excellence
* Customer Focus
* Effective Communication
* Accountability & Ownership
* Managing Ambiguity
* Building Networks
* Collaboration
* Coaching & Team Development
* Valuing Diverse Perspectives

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Marketing, Strategy, Accounting, Business Administration , or a related discipline is required.
* Master's degree or relevant professional certifications in Pricing, Finance, Analytics, or Business Management are preferred.
* Position may require compliance with applicable export controls or sanctions regulations.

**Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in pricing, commercial finance, pricing analytics, sales operations, business analytics, or related commercial functions.
* Experience developing and implementing pricing strategies within manufacturing, automotive, industrial, aftermarket, or B2B environments is preferred.
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience interpreting large datasets and translating insights into business recommendations.
* Experience managing complex pricing structures, customer pricing, rebates, quotations, and enterprise pricing systems.
* Working knowledge of ERP and CRM platforms (such as Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, or equivalent).
* Experience leading pricing governance, cross-functional projects, and strategic pricing initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and collaborate across multiple business functions.
* Experience leading or mentoring teams and driving employee development.
* Strong presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting/analytics tools; experience with Power BI, Tableau, AI-enabled analytics, or similar platforms is advantageous.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high levels of accuracy, quality, and customer focus.
* The position is for India aftermarket DBU Pricing leader.

title: Senior Analyst, Data Management, IT
description:
**Job Description**
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.
  
  
Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
  
  
As part of our IT team, your expertise will help Edwards strengthen trusted, governed, and high-quality master data across the enterprise. We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Data Management to support critical master data domains, including Healthcare Professional and Supplier Master, while helping modernize Edwards' Master Data Management capabilities from Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS toward a multi-domain Semarchy MDM platform on Snowflake. This role combines data stewardship, governance, data quality, business analysis, and operational support with direct partnership across global and regional business teams.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Participate in the implementation and expansion of Semarchy MDM as a Snowflake-based, multi-domain enterprise Master Data Management platform.
* Support the onboarding of new master data domains and contribute to migration planning, business validation, testing, and user adoption as domains transition from Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS to the future-state platform.
* Partner with MDM leadership, architects, engineers, data stewards, application teams, and business stakeholders to define scalable master data processes, governance models, stewardship workflows, and platform requirements.
* Support Healthcare Professional and Supplier Master domains operating on Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS, including application enhancements, release validation, testing, and production support.
* Investigate and resolve master data issues, data quality exceptions, match and merge conflicts, hierarchy requests, workflow issues, and data synchronization problems across upstream and downstream applications.
* Engage directly with regional business teams to understand business processes, data challenges, and master data requirements across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Elicit, document, validate, and translate business requirements into scalable data management and MDM solutions that business and technical teams can execute.
* Define, document, and maintain business rules, data standards, critical data elements, data definitions, stewardship procedures, and data quality controls.
* Perform data profiling, analysis, root cause investigation, and remediation activities using SQL, Snowflake, and related data tools.
* Develop and monitor data quality metrics, dashboards, and governance scorecards that improve data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and accountability.
* Create and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, governance artifacts, test evidence, and user guidance.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve business processes, data quality, operational efficiency, and the user experience.

**What You Will Need (Required)**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in master data management, data governance, data quality, business analysis, or enterprise data operations.
* Practical experience supporting Master Data Management solutions, data stewardship processes, or governed enterprise data domains.
* Experience eliciting, documenting, and validating business requirements and translating them into functional data or application requirements.
* Experience with data profiling, root cause analysis, issue remediation, business rules, data standards, and data quality controls.
* Working proficiency in SQL and experience analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex data issues across connected systems and processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to facilitate discussions across business and technical teams.
* Ability to work independently under general direction, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively across global time zones.
* Adhere to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health & Safety rules, and take adequate control measures to prevent injuries, protect the environment, and prevent pollution under their span of influence or control.

**What Else We Look For (Preferred)**

* Hands-on experience with Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud MDM SaaS, Semarchy MDM, or another enterprise multi-domain MDM platform.
* Experience with Healthcare Professional, Supplier, Customer, Product, or other enterprise master data domains.
* Experience supporting an MDM modernization or migration program, including business validation, testing, cutover readiness, and user adoption.
* Experience with Snowflake-based data solutions and integrations among MDM, source applications, and downstream consumers.
* Experience developing data quality dashboards, governance scorecards, stewardship workflows, or operating procedures.
* Relevant industry experience in medical device, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or another regulated environment.

**Additional Information**

* Develops solutions to a variety of complex data management problems and exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques after considering business, data quality, governance, and technical implications.
* Works with general direction focused on end results and may provide guidance to less-experienced team members or data stewards.
* Travel may be required up to 5%.

**Benefits And Equal Opportunity**
Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

title: Senior Energy Market Analyst (Solutions)
description:

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.*

* *IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners*
* *Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category*
* *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*

**How We Work**

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the Position**

As a member of the APAC Solutions team, the
**Senior Energy Market Analyst**
will be responsible for engaging directly with both potential and existing clients to increase sales and deliver technical work. will act as an energy markets subject matter expert, responsible for thought leadership towards customers. They will seek to understand the customers challenges, identify solutions within the Energy Exemplar product offerings, and articulate the value proposition within the marketplace. The successful candidate will be expected to heavily contribute to the building of energy market models for those regions, using Energy Exemplar’s flagship PLEXOS software tool (the role does not require programming/software development). The candidate should have a good understanding of fundamental market price drivers, and ideally have experience in stochastic optimization techniques.

This Senior Energy Market Analyst works in close collaboration with a team of technical subject matter experts. The position is supported by strong training, coaching, and mentoring and provides opportunity for professional growth and career advancement, as well as international travel to customer sites. * Manage project lifecycles, from scoping to delivery, ensuring customer success.
* Collaborate with the product development team to enhance software capabilities.

* Deep knowledge of energy markets & associated economics
* Expertise in model setup, custom configurations, and troubleshooting.
* Experience in scripting, automation, and integrating market datasets.
* Ability to communicate complex subject matter in an easy to understand manner
* Strong commercial awareness
* Top down approach to problem solving – ability to see the big picture
* Strong interpersonal presence and skills - demonstrated ability to build rapport
* Excellent verbal and written communications skills
* Strong listening and presentation skills
* Ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively
* Self-driven, results-orientated with a positive outlook and a focus on quality
* Thorough knowledge of standard Microsoft programs – Word, Excel, PowerPoint
* Ability to manage multiple competing priorities
* Sense of urgency for goal achievement
* Strong desire for personal and career advancement

**Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or equivalent in a relevant field.
* 5+ years of experience in energy market modeling, forecasting, or optimization.
* Extensive experience in PLEXOS or similar optimization software.
* Strong leadership, project management, and stakeholder engagement skills.

title: Senior Technical Support Consultant
description:
**About Armor Defense Inc**
At Armor, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in securing cyberspace. Our vision is to be the trusted protector and de facto standard that cloud-centric customers entrust with their risk. We strive to continuously evolve to be the best partner of choice, breaking norms and tirelessly innovating to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and reshaping how we deliver customer outcomes. We are passionate about making a positive impact in the world, and we’re looking for a highly skilled and experienced talent to join our dynamic team.
  
  
Armor has unique offerings to the market so customers can a) understand their risk b) leverage Armor to co-manage their risk or c) completely outsource their risk to Armor.
  
  
Learn more at: https://www.armor.com
  
  
**Summary**
The Technical Program Manager owns Armor’s problem-management program and the analytical work that drives down the volume of issues customers experience. This is a program and analysis role, not a day-to-day ticket-resolution role: rather than working individual customer tickets, the Technical Program Manager digs into the data behind them to find the systemic problems that generate recurring work, and drives those to permanent resolution or a clear, repeatable framework. That work is grounded in understanding how data flows into Armor’s systems—the connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines behind platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender—so root causes and data-quality issues can be identified, not guessed. The role partners closely with Engineering, SRE, and support delivery teams and thinks in terms of measurable, repeatable outcomes rather than one-off fixes—an approach that matters deeply for a cybersecurity company where recurring problems carry real customer risk. Based in Pune, India, the role works primarily on India business hours and carries the flexibility to overlap with US Central hours as needed to collaborate with Armor’s Dallas-based Engineering, SRE, and delivery teams. It reports to and takes strategic direction from the Head of Global Support.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Analyze incident and ticket data to identify the systemic drivers of ticket volume, and target measurable reductions in recurring work and customer-impacting incidents.
* Investigate how data flows into Armor’s systems—connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines from Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, Qualys/VMDR, log/SIEM sources, and Azure and cloud telemetry—to surface data-quality issues and the root causes behind recurring problems.
* Work through ambiguity: develop hypotheses about recurring and systemic problems, validate root cause with data, and ensure problems are genuinely understood before solutions are pursued.
* Consolidate recurring incidents and service requests into managed problem records and drive them to permanent resolution or a clear, repeatable framework—without taking over day-to-day ticket execution, which is owned by dedicated delivery teams.
* Build the queries, dashboards, and reports that surface trends and quantify customer and business impact (e.g., KQL over Sentinel/Defender, SQL, Power BI, and Jira reporting).
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for major and recurring problems; document root causes, workarounds, and known errors so delivery teams resolve recurrences consistently.
* Partner with Engineering, SRE, and delivery teams to land systemic fixes, and coordinate permanent fixes that require change through Armor’s change process.
* Define and report the metrics that matter—reduction in recurring customer-impacting incidents and ticket volume as the headline, with operational signals (recurring-problem count, MTTR, RCA compliance, and SLA adherence) as supporting measures.
* Run problem-review cadences, maintain and drive down a prioritized problem backlog, and track held known errors so workarounds do not quietly become permanent technical debt.
* Identify automation and process-improvement opportunities and program-manage their delivery to reduce manual, repetitive work.
* Maintain authoritative documentation and a known-error knowledge base in Confluence, and provide clear, executive-level status, risks, and escalations.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10-12 years of experience in technical program management, security or IT operations, data and analytics, or service/problem management; Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven ability to manage cross-functional programs and drive outcomes across multiple teams without direct authority.
* Hands-on data analysis: able to query operational and security data using KQL (Microsoft Sentinel/Defender) and SQL, and to build reports and dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Jira) that surface trends and quantify impact.
* Working understanding of data integrations—connectors, APIs, and ingestion pipelines—and how security telemetry reaches a SIEM or analytics platform (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender).
* Solid grounding in problem management and root cause analysis, aligned to ITIL (Problem, Incident, and Service Management).
* Familiarity (conceptual, not hands-on delivery) with the security domains Armor operates: vulnerability management (Qualys/VMDR), endpoint and EDR (Microsoft Defender), and cloud and identity (Azure, Okta/Entra).
* Ability to read incident and ticket data and translate it into prioritized, measurable action.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management in English, including executive-level reporting and clear RCAs and resolution frameworks.
* Proficiency with Jira and Confluence.
* Strategic, systemic thinker with a bias for repeatable, automation-assisted solutions over one-off fixes.
* Self-directed, taking strategic direction and prioritization from the Head of Support.

****Alignment to Armor Core Values****

* COMMITMENT TO GROWTH
* INTEGRITY ALWAYS
* EMPATHY IN ACTION
* IMMEDIATE IMPACT
* FOLLOW-THROUGH

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Depth in KQL/Kusto, Power BI, or Power Automate, or exposure to data engineering and pipeline troubleshooting.
* Experience building or troubleshooting API-based integrations and data connectors.
* PMP, ITIL v4, or Microsoft security/Azure certifications.
* Experience in a cybersecurity or managed-security services (MSSP) environment.

title: Data Service Excellence Specialist, IT
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.
  
  
Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
  
  
As part of our IT team, your expertise will help deliver reliable, customer-focused support for Edwards' global Data & Analytics platforms. We are seeking a Data Service Excellence Specialist to provide Level 3 support, access governance, incident resolution, user guidance, and operational coordination across Power BI, Qlik, Snowflake, and related services. This role is a hands-on escalation and resolution point that works directly with business users and partners with deeper platform and engineering specialists when a change to the underlying product or platform is required.
  
  
Shift Time - 3 PM IST to 12 AM IST
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Provide Level 3 functional and technical support for Data & Analytics platforms, including Power BI, Qlik, Snowflake, and related services, resolving complex incidents and requests within the role’s area of expertise.
* Investigate incidents and service requests by gathering evidence, reproducing issues, analyzing business impact, troubleshooting root causes, implementing appropriate resolutions, and documenting outcomes.
* Own access requests and provisioning activities while ensuring alignment with security, governance, compliance, and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Act as the escalation point for front-line and offshore support resources, validating prior troubleshooting, improving escalation quality, and engaging platform engineering or product teams only when deeper code, infrastructure, or design changes are required.
* Monitor, prioritize, and coordinate incident and request workloads through ServiceNow, Jira, and established service management practices, with clear communication through resolution.
* Serve as a liaison among business users, technical teams, and Pune-based or offshore support resources to maintain effective communication and dependable service delivery.
* Coordinate day-to-day operational activities across distributed support resources, including work prioritization, knowledge transfer, onboarding, and readiness for new or changing services.
* Create, maintain, and improve knowledge articles, FAQs, runbooks, support documentation, onboarding materials, and operational procedures.
* Coach support team members on troubleshooting methods, platform knowledge, service standards, and effective customer communication without direct people-management responsibility.
* Analyze recurring incidents and support trends, perform root cause reviews, and recommend or implement improvements that reduce repeat demand and improve the user experience.
* Support training and enablement for analytics users and new support team members across technical and non-technical audiences.

**What You Will Need (Required)**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field and a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in data and analytics support, business systems analysis, application support, or a related role; or a Master's Degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience.
* Hands-on experience supporting analytics platforms, with Power BI experience required and experience with Qlik, Tableau, Snowflake, or comparable platforms strongly valued.
* Experience resolving escalated application or platform incidents beyond basic intake and routing, including root cause investigation, documented resolution, and effective engagement of engineering teams when needed.
* Familiarity with ITIL service management practices, including Incident, Request, and Problem Management.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret incomplete or conflicting information.
* Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical users and manage multiple priorities independently.
* Strong documentation, organization, time management, stakeholder management, and customer service skills.
* Experience coordinating work, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness across geographically distributed teams.
* Ability to facilitate onboarding, training, and knowledge-sharing activities.
* Adhere to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health & Safety rules, and take adequate control measures to prevent injuries, protect the environment, and prevent pollution under their span of influence or control.

**What Else We Look For (Preferred)**

* Experience working in a global or matrixed environment and coordinating offshore or vendor-based support resources.
* Working knowledge of Snowflake roles and permissions and the ability to use simple SQL queries for investigation.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, GitLab, or comparable service management and version control tools.
* Understanding of data governance principles, analytics workflows, and access-control practices.
* Basic SQL or DAX knowledge, including simple queries, measures, or calculated columns.
* Experience developing runbooks, knowledge articles, support metrics, and service improvement plans.

**Additional Information**

* Works independently on Level 3 support activities with general supervision and applies judgment to select the appropriate resolution or escalation path based on technical findings and business impact.
* May provide functional guidance to lower-level or front-line support personnel while partnering with people managers or vendor leadership on formal people-management matters.
* Travel may be required up to 5%.

**Benefits And Equal Opportunity**
Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

* Lead vendor management, SLA tracking, broker negotiations, and program renewals.
* Resolve escalated employee queries and ensure clear benefit policy communications.

* Maintain C&B policy compliance with statutory regulations (PF, Gratuity, ESIC, LWF, Minimum Wages).
* Maintain complete documentation and process controls for internal and external audit readiness.
* Standardize and automate Total Rewards workflows.
* Analytics, Modeling & Budgeting
* Build executive dashboards tracking C&B cost impacts, headcount metrics, and payout trends.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Execution: 100% timeliness and zero-error accuracy in increment and variable pay cycles.

* Competitiveness: Alignment of salary bands with target market percentiles.

**Key Skills**

The role serves as the primary business owner for CRM-enabled processes spanning Sales, Service, Warranty, and Customer Management, ensuring alignment between business objectives, process standards, data requirements, and technology capabilities.

The role drives process standardization, business transformation, data quality, user adoption, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance customer engagement, operational efficiency, and business performance globally.

Drive successful deployment and adoption of Salesforce capabilities across Mobility business units.
  
  
Develop and deliver training, communication, and change management programs to maximize user adoption and process compliance.
  
  
Establish and govern CRM-related KPIs, performance measures, and adoption metrics to monitor business value realization.

description:

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
====================================
  
  
Own strategy and roadmap for Gen AI and agentic capabilities across Payment Reconciliation Intelligence.
  
  
Translate a deep understanding of our customers into products and solutions that drive significant customer value
  
  
Balance the long-term direction of a product with today’s needs and constraints by fully understanding the technical, competitive, and commercial contexts of our products.
  
  
Partner closely with engineering, data science/AI, other platform/COE teams to ensure architecture quality, safety, evaluation, and observability.

Mentor and develop junior product managers.

====================================
  
  
Product management and end to end delivery of products.
  
  
Strong ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable product requirements.
  
  
Proven track record collaborating in cross-functional teams to deliver outstanding products and features.
  
  
Designing, executing, and distilling user research to drive value for the customer.
  
  
Excellent execution, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  
  
Good to have : AI know how, specifically experience of working on Gen AI & agentic use cases support & delivery
  
  
Payments industry experience is a plus
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Technology and Innovation - Data Engineering Manager
description:
**Data Engineering Manager**
Riveron is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to be part of our data engineering team in India. This is not a pure people-management role — you will be writing code, building pipelines, and architecting data platforms daily alongside your team. We're looking for someone who leads from the codebase, not just from a conference room. If you bring deep implementation experience across Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks and can pair strong architectural thinking with real delivery output, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A data engineering professional with 8 to 12 years of experience, including 1-3 years balancing technical leadership with active, hands-on implementation — you've managed teams without stepping away from the keyboard.
* You write production-quality code daily. This role requires active coding and pipeline development — not just code reviews and architectural diagrams.
* Hands-on, implementation-level expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks is non-negotiable. You've personally built, deployed, and tuned production workloads on these platforms.
* Strong data architecture background spanning lakehouse design, medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data platform design — grounded in systems you've actually built, not just designed on paper.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and Python — you can write complex transformations, optimize query performance, debug pipeline failures, and build automation frameworks yourself.
* Proven experience building and shipping ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, dbt, Spark, and platform-native orchestration tools.
* Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud data services (Synapse Analytics, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database) and comfort operating in multi-cloud environments.
* Well-versed in data governance, data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and security best practices — with experience implementing these controls, not just defining policies.
* Proficient with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, and Infrastructure as Code — you commit code, open pull requests, and maintain deployment pipelines alongside your team.
* Comfortable working in Agile delivery environments and translating business requirements into scalable technical designs.

**What You'll Do**

* Spend a significant portion of your time writing code — building data pipelines, developing transformation logic, configuring platform services, and shipping production-ready solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers while remaining the team's strongest technical contributor and setting the standard through your own code and architectural decisions.
* Design and personally implement scalable data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks — selecting the right platform for each use case and building the solution end to end.
* Architect and build lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, defining and coding ingestion patterns, transformation layers, storage strategies, and consumption models.
* Own critical and complex implementation work — the toughest pipeline builds, the most challenging performance problems, and the architectural spikes that set direction for the team.
* Write and maintain shared libraries, frameworks, and reusable components that accelerate the team's delivery and enforce engineering standards.
* Conduct deep, line-level code reviews focused on correctness, performance, and maintainability — not just approval stamps.
* Partner with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into engineered solutions and personally prototype key components.
* Establish and enforce best practices for data modeling, pipeline reliability, observability, testing, and documentation — by building the reference implementations yourself.
* Optimize platform performance and manage costs across Snowflake compute, Databricks clusters, and Fabric capacities through hands-on tuning and configuration.
* Implement data governance and security controls across engineering initiatives, ensuring compliance, data quality, and lineage traceability at the code and platform level.
* Stay current with the evolving data platform landscape and evaluate emerging tools through hands-on proof-of-concept work, not just vendor demos.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A career path that shows sustained, hands-on implementation even as responsibilities grew — architect-turned-manager, not analyst-turned-manager.
* Hands-on experience building medallion-architecture lakehouses on Databricks or Microsoft Fabric, and designing and tuning performant Snowflake warehouse structures.
* Experience implementing CI/CD for data pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including writing the pipeline definitions and deployment scripts yourself.
* Familiarity with dbt for transformation orchestration, with personal experience writing and maintaining dbt models and tests.
* Exposure to real-time or near-real-time data ingestion patterns (Kafka, Event Hubs, Spark Structured Streaming) through direct implementation.
* Experience with data mesh or domain-oriented data platform strategies is a strong plus.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate architectural trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience running sprint planning, design reviews, and cross-functional delivery coordination.

**About Riveron**
At Riveron, we partner with clients—from global multinationals to high-growth private entities—to solve complex finance challenges, guided by our DELTA values: Drive, Excellence, Leadership, Teamwork, and Accountability. Our entrepreneurial culture thrives on collaboration, diverse perspectives, and delivering exceptional outcomes. We are committed to fostering growth, both for our clients and our people, through mentorship, integrity, and a client-centric approach. This inclusive environment offers flexibility, progressive benefits, and meaningful opportunities for impactful work that supports well-being in and out of the office.
  
  
Want to stay connected with Riveron? Join our Talent Community to learn more about our growing firm and be considered for future opportunities.
  
  
**Check Us Out On Social Media**
LinkedIn Glassdoor Instagram Facebook
  
  
*Riveron Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer and believes that we are stronger together through our diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.*

A complete description of all available benefits can be found at Riveron's Benefits page at https://riveron.com/riveron-life/. Contract roles are not eligible for benefits.

title: CX Analyst & Product Insights  (B2C, Tier-1) (GB04)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
  

We’re building a central Design Thinking function at Bajaj Finance - a team that will play a defining role as the organisation pivots into a direct-to-consumer company. This role sits at the intersection of data and human understanding, and thrives in that grey zone.

You’ll be the person who can stare at a funnel and see a human story. Who can sit with a field research readout and spot what’s missing. Who treats data not as an answer, but as a better question - and turns both into something the team can act on.

**What Your Work Looks Like-**

**You’ll operate across the Design Thinking lifecycle — from signal to solution:**

* Insight & Evidence: Journey analytics, Mining session replays, heatmaps, and behavioural data to surface where customers struggle and why. You bring statistical rigour — you know the difference between a pattern and noise, between correlation and causation, and you know when to trust the data and when to trust instinct.
* Challenge & Synthesis: You consume field research from dedicated research teams and stress-test it. You triangulate digital signals against qualitative findings, competitive benchmarks, and business metrics to build problem statements that hold up under scrutiny. You craft How Might We statements from clustered signals — framing the right questions that give the team a clear direction to solve against.
* Prototyping & Testing: You participate in solutioning — helping the team move from problem to prototype, designing tests, and closing the loop between what was hypothesised and what customers actually do.

**What Makes Someone Right for This-**

* 4–8 years in consumer insights, CX analytics, product analytics, UX research, or a similar role in B2C or consumer-facing companies, where you’ve worked across quantitative and qualitative inputs
* Comfortable in analytics platforms — session replay, web/app analytics, funnel analysis, segmented and cohort analysis. Can layer behavioural data over system-of-record data to move beyond surface-level insights. Specific tools matter less than your ability to get depth from any tool quickly
* Understands statistical thinking — hypothesis testing, significance, when to apply rigour and when to move on intuition
* Can read, challenge, and build on qualitative research even if you’re not the one conducting it — you know what good methodology looks like and can spot when a finding is thin
* Structures findings into clear, concise arguments. You’ve presented to senior stakeholders and know the difference between showing data and making a case
* Thinks in systems — you connect a drop-off at step 3 to an upstream design choice, a policy constraint, and a downstream business metric without being told to
* SQL-literate — you can pull what you need or speak to data teams in their language
* Brings critical reasoning that stress-tests assumptions rather than confirming them

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  
  

* Strong Consumer Insights / CX Analytics / Product Insights profile (behavioral/user/product/UX analytics)
* Mandatory (Experience 1) - Must have 4+ years of experience in Customer Experience (CX) Analytics, Consumer Insights, Product Analytics, Behavioral Analytics, or UX Analytics, working on B2C digital products (Web/App) with a focus on understanding customer behavior, customer journeys, and experience improvement.
* Mandatory (Experience 2) - Must have hands-on experience analyzing customer journeys, behavioral funnels, digital interactions, session-level behavior, clickstream data, and experience metrics to identify pain points, drop-offs, and optimization opportunities.
* Mandatory (Experience 3) - Must have experience using CX and Digital Experience Analytics platforms such as Medallia, ContentSquare, Google Analytics (GA4) or similar tools for customer behavior analysis, journey mapping, and insight generation.
* Mandatory (Experience 4) - Must have experience working closely with Product, Design, CX, Business, Marketing, and Research teams to generate insights, validate hypotheses, and drive customer experience improvements.
* Mandatory (Experience 5 ) - Strong working knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction, querying, analysis, exploratory data analysis, automation, and behavioral data interpretation. Ability to independently analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable business insights.
* Mandatory (Experience 6): Understanding of hypothesis-driven thinking and basic experimentation/A/B testing concepts, including interpreting results and distinguishing between correlation and causation.
* Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years
* Preferred ( Experience 1) - Candidates from product-based companies (B2C preferred) OR Data Analytics Service companies like Mu Sigma etc

Experience: 3–6 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days

Benefits
  
  

Our people define our passion and our audacious, incredibly rewarding achievements. Bajaj Finance Limited is one of India’s most diversified Non-banking financial companies, and among Asia’s top 10 Large workplaces. If you have the drive to get ahead, we can help find you an opportunity at any of the 500+ locations we’re present in India.

title: Business Analyst, Service Desk Reporting & Analytics
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Netrix Global is looking for a skilled
**Business Analyst, Service Desk Reporting & Analytics**
owns reporting and analytics for the Netrix Global Service Desk. This role transforms ServiceNow and contact center data into accurate, automated Power BI reporting that supports customer service reviews, SLA governance, and internal operational and financial decision-making. Working directly with customers and alongside Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, Lead Technical Architects, and service desk leadership, the Business Analyst ensures that the performance story Netrix tells its customers is timely, consistent, and backed by trusted data.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**
*****Customer Service Desk Reporting*****

* Produce, automate, and deliver monthly customer service reports and Netrix template service review presentations, enabling Service Delivery Managers to share them with customers during the first week of each month.
* Report SLA attainment by priority for response and resolution, including tickets opened and closed, backlog, mean time to resolve, reopened rates, escalations, and major incident activity.
* Report customer experience results, including CSAT, NPS, survey response rates, and voice-of-customer themes.
* Report contact center performance metrics, including average speed of answer, average handle time, abandonment rate, first contact resolution, and channel mix across phone, email, portal, and chat.
* Configure customer-specific views that reflect SLA targets, priority matrices, and scope defined in each customer’s statement of work.
* Incorporate customer outages, changes, and environmental factors into SLA commentary to ensure performance results are explained accurately.
* Develop trend analysis, identify top contact drivers, and provide improvement recommendations to support quarterly and executive business reviews.

*****Internal Operational and Financial Reporting*****

* Maintain daily operational reporting, including open and aging ticket reports, daily and month-to-date SLA status, and queue health.
* Provide volume and demand analytics by hour, day, and channel to support workforce management and staffing decisions across global follow-the-sun delivery centers.
* Deliver team and queue-level KPI reporting that supports service desk leadership, Quality Assurance, and Training.
* Produce internal financial reporting by customer, including revenue, cost of goods sold, and gross margin, while ensuring internal-only data is never included in customer-facing deliverables.
* Build leadership dashboards and executive summaries for service desk and Managed Services leadership reviews
* Establish reporting baselines and dashboards for new customers during service desk onboarding, transition, and hypercare.

*****Report Migration, Automation, and Modernization*****

* Analyze and redesign existing Excel, SQL, and legacy reports into scalable, automated Power BI solutions.
* Replace manual and semi-automated reporting workflows with automated datasets, dashboards, and scheduled distribution through Power BI Service and paginated reports.
* Standardize KPI definitions, data definitions, and report structures across all service desk customers.
* Optimize reports for performance, scalability, usability, and reduced turnaround time.

*****Data Modeling, Quality, and Governance*****

* Design and maintain data models using ServiceNow and contact center datasets from the consolidated SQL reporting environment.
* Perform data transformation using Power Query (M) and write efficient DAX measures.
* Validate, cleanse, and reconcile data to ensure reported figures are accurate and defensible before release.
* Implement row-level security and access controls so each customer and internal audience sees only authorized data.
* Follow data privacy, confidentiality, and governance requirements, including responsible handling of customer and employee data.
* Maintain documentation for data sources, KPI definitions, report logic, and refresh schedules.

***Customer Engagement and Delivery Partnership***

* Attend and present in customer meetings alongside Service Delivery Managers and leadership, walking customers through metrics, trends, and SLA results and answering questions with confidence.
* Partner closely with Service Delivery Managers, Technical Account Managers, Lead Technical Architects, service desk supervisors, Quality Assurance, Training, and workforce management.
* Gather, prioritize, and fulfill customer and internal reporting requests, translating business needs into clear and repeatable reporting solutions.
* Provide training and documentation to help service desk leaders and team members use Power BI and ServiceNow reporting effectively.

**What You Will Bring To The Table**

* 5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, operational and customer reporting
* Experience supporting an IT service desk, managed service provider, contact center, or ITSM environment strongly preferred
* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
* Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate preferred
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and ITIL Foundation preferred.
* Proficiency in SQL and advanced Excel (pivot tables, data validation, complex formulas). Python or R is a plus.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow ITSM, including Incident, Request, Problem, and Change records, SLA definitions and task SLA data, customer surveys, and native ServiceNow reporting
* Working knowledge of Power BI, including Power BI Desktop and Service, data modeling, DAX, Power Query (M), row level security, scheduled refresh, and paginated reports.
* Strong customer focus, with the ability to communicate clearly, confidently, and professionally with customers during service reviews and other meetings
* Ability to explain data, trends, and SLA results in plain language to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Proven ability to partner with service delivery team members and build trusted working relationships across the organization.
* Operates independently with minimal supervision, managing competing customer and internal reporting priorities against firm monthly deadlines.

title: Business Intelligence Associate
description:
**About The Role**
Your role as a Business Intelligence Senior Associate is to work with the product and machine learning team to automate the process of manual forecasting and identify the root causes. You are expected to detect anomalies/issues early, identify root causes, track revenue and spend trends on an hourly/daily/weekly/monthly basis against the forecast. Coordination with multiple teams to fix problems with rollouts/ releases and ensure leadership always has an accurate view of performance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Monitor the health of the business via tools such as our anomaly detection software and other dashboards, and keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on the health of key input metrics.
* Hourly and daily (Real-time monitoring): Monitor the hourly trend continuously.
* Revenue declines must be assessed to find the root cause and verify if the decline is associated with any product release.
* Executive Communication: Share insights and learnings on long-term and short-term trends with a broader set of stakeholders to inform strategic planning and GTM execution.
* Allocate the identified cause to the corresponding teams and assess the next actions.
* Inform the Network Operations Center team to trigger P1/P2 alerts based on the severity of the revenue decline.
* Weekly (Medium Term Monitoring): Own the revenue forecasting process and provide executive updates
* Define variance thresholds that trigger deeper analysis to understand reasons behind movements of key dimensions.
* Investigate any metrics that show signs of decay or are deviating from the norm and find the root cause.
* Monthly (Long Term Monitoring): Lead the monthly review process with Marketplace, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to track the key drivers of our spend on an ongoing basis.
* Be intimately involved in the quarterly and annual planning process and be aware of what assumptions went into the plan.
* Act as the project manager of investigations. Cross-functionally manage workstreams with account stakeholders to complete analyses and troubleshooting
* Provide regular updates on Steering Committees. Revenue Monitoring Process Improvement.
* Reduce “blind spots” by developing new monitoring frameworks and incorporating new data sources into existing monitoring processes.
* Collaborate with Product Management and external vendors to improve existing anomaly detection solutions, based on KPI performance.
* Rollout and Recovery Tracking: Work closely with the monetization product team to track and quantify the impact of product releases.

**We'd Love for You to Have**

* Proven 5 to 8 years of experience in data analysis, or a similar role, is preferred.
* Communication Skills - Ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise, and actionable way to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Technical skills such as Excel, Looker, MYSQL, forecasting, impact measurement, AB Testing, are a must.
* Knowledge of Excel macro/VBA, Python, and Ad Tech experience is good to have.
* Experience with GenAI-based tools like Cursor and Claude will be an added advantage.
* Strong knowledge of data manipulation and analysis.
* Familiarity with anomaly detection techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning methods, time-series analysis, and outlier detection algorithms.
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.
* Problem Solving - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work with ambiguous data.
* Attention to Detail - High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all work.
* Shift Timings - 3.00 PM to 12 midnight
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.

**Qualification**

* Should have a Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, and broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches, and much more!
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies, and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
  
  
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

**Essential Duties**

title: Investment Performance Analysis- Manager
description:
**State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT) is one of the world's leading providers of financial services to institutional investors, including investment servicing, investment management and investment research and trading. With $33.99 trillion in assets under custody and administration and $2.81 trillion\* in assets under management as of September 30, 2018, State Street operates in more than 100 geographic markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, Europe, the Middle East and Asia. For more information, visit State Street’s website at www.statestreet.com.**

**Key Responsibilities & Experience Range**

* Performance analysis and Attribution (i.e. absolute and relative portfolio performance to factors including security selection, asset allocation, currency, etc.)
* Reconcile and update portfolio/benchmark performance and validate, identify, investigate and resolve security level discrepancies at the transaction, position, and pricing level in Global Performance Measurement and Risk applications.
* Retrieve, validate and upload data from various source/vendor systems and upload to the department’s applications.
* Validate completeness and accuracy of data in department’s performance, risk, and analytics tools.
* The analyst must have strong communication skills and must be able to answer questions from other performance analysts, operations associates, portfolio managers and other users regarding the details of performance calculation process and auditing procedures.

**Supportive Responsibilities**

* Effectively communicate with Global Performance Measurement and Risk, Operations, and IT staff to resolve data issues and escalate problems to the appropriate groups.
* Collaborate with team members to develop, create and validate new performance analytical reports.
* Responsible for maintaining & creating a “best practice” process workflow environment in the team & in the designated projects.
* Must be able to independently “troubleshoot” functional and quantitative issues to ensure high quality report production. Must also be able to determine when problems & issues should be elevated to immediate manager.
* Collaborate with multiple departments across the firm to achieve firm wide goal of performance return centralization.
* Exceptional interpersonal, communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal, required.
* Must be prepared to work flexible hours, potentially alongside US based colleagues for production and other issues that Require immediate escalation and/or resolution.
* Ability to remain calm during stressful periods like quarter end and work well under pressure.
* Active participation in various forums of the organization and providing valuable inputs time to time.

**Skills & Knowledge**

* Qualification & Certifications
* Postgraduate, preferably an MBA in Finance from a reputed institute.
* FRM/CFA/Financial industry related certification is an added advantage.
* Experienced candidate with 6 - 8-year post-graduation experience in any financial firm.
* Experience in Performance Measurement will be an added advantage.

**Primary Skills (Must Have)**

* Good understanding of Equity, Fixed Income and Derivative instruments.
* Knowledge of Investment Management industry.
* Knowledge of security analysis and portfolio management, stock exchange markets, financial markets, dividends, trading and settlements is required.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Basic MS office skills.
* Exposure to POINT/Yield book/Factset is an added advantage.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data flows, reports, and system integrations.
* Stay current with the latest developments in SAP analytics technologies and best practices.
* Collaborate with functional teams for issue resolution
* Demonstrate strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Work effectively within structured, process-driven environments

Deloitte’s SAP Service Line is among the world’s largest, with 8,000 global practitioners and over 1,700 SAP implementation projects completed. + Understanding and implementing ingestion to Data platform via extractors, CDS, SDI, SLT, ODP frameworks
+ Modelling in BW / Datasphere with different artifacts like ADSO, Composite Providers, Open ODS Views, Hybrid modelling, dataflows, transformational flows, graphical views, calculations views, script scripts/procedures, analytical models, etc.

+ Integrate CDS views with Fiori Elements, Analytical List Pages (ALP), KPIs, and Smart Business Cockpits
+ Techniques for performance optimization of Views, query performance and data load processes.

Familiarity with connecting and consuming data from SAP BW/Datasphere/S/4HANA and embedding SAC in Fiori or other business apps.
