title: Principal Central Monitor-India
description:
Centralized monitoring is an integral part of risk-based monitoring strategy, defined as the timely, remote review of accumulating subject and operational data to help distinguish between reliable and unreliable data, trends, outliers and unusual variability using analytics and statistical methods.
  
  
The Principal Central Monitor is responsible for leading the development of new tools, instruction guidelines and analyses essential for centralized statistical review of study data from study start through to study database lock. The Principal Central Monitor enables proactive identification, communication, escalation and management of risks at the study/country/site level.
  
  
More specifically, the Principal Central Monitor must:
  
  

* Lead effort on the development of new tools, instruction guidelines and analyses within the area of specialty, including complex and collaborative approaches with other functions.
* Lead the development and setup of study-specific tools, analyses, and centralized monitoring plans, ensuring that the monitoring approach is aligned with study risks, critical data, and critical processes.
* Act as the strategic and technical lead for centralized monitoring across multiple studies and for function-wide initiatives, providing direction on complex analyses, resolving escalated issues, and establishing consistent approaches and standards.
* Assist in creating tools, techniques and processes for automating risk-based monitoring tasks (data integration automation, data retrieval automation, data mapping automation, and automated report generation).
* Act as mentor as well as train new team members and junior staff.
* Identify data quality trends indicative of systematic errors and potential performance issues at study/country/site level and track evidence of issues and potential risks with support from senior team members.
* Represent centralized monitoring in cross-functional study risk assessment meetings and provide expert guidance on identification, evaluation, prioritization, mitigation, and ongoing review of study risks.
* Provide input to leadership as needed to support development of risk characterization and reporting.

Employees may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.
  
  
Requirements:
  
  
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research.

**Experience**

* Minimum of 5 years of experience in central statistical monitoring with an overall 10 years of experience in two or more operational areas such as clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety, medical monitoring, biometrics, or project management.
* Excellent understanding of statistical monitoring and Risk Based Quality Management (RBQM) and their impact on data integrity.
* Thorough understanding of the processes associated with clinical study management, data management, and regulatory operations.
* Knowledge of clinical trial database systems (EDC, IRT, CTMS etc.).
* Excellent computer skills, with advanced knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and the ability to learn and use interactive computer systems and tools.
* Advanced level of understanding of descriptive analysis e.g. means, medians, significance, confidence intervals.
* Demonstrated expertise in analyzing and reviewing clinical data, ability to extract pertinent information from standard study documentation, such as protocols, electronic study data systems with the ability to learn to identify trending of site/study data.
* Must be able to work in non-traditional work environments.
* Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).
* Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels within the organization and with external customers.
* Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.
* Prioritization skills with ability to plan, monitor and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.
* Good understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
* Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.
* Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
* Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems

**About The Global Investment Product Analyst Program**
The Global Product Analyst program is seeking a junior to mid-level analyst with some work experience to work in Pune as part of our global teams. Each analyst will own two remits (a “major” and “minor”) across a two to four-year period. Balancing multiple responsibilities requires the analyst to master a broad skill set, have a wide understanding of business development in asset management, and complete projects that are critical to the success of the group, department or firm. On a biannual basis, the analyst will present learnings and contributions to the broader Global Business Development organization. Analysts will meet with their major and minor stakeholders regularly to collaborate on their responsibilities and will have the opportunity to become embedded in the teams they are supporting. After successfully completing two years in the program, the firm has the option based on performance and personnel needs to place the analyst in a full-time position on the team they are supporting or in other areas in which the analyst expresses interest and where there is skills alignment. Throughout the program, the program sponsors invest in the analysts’ growth through intensive training, development opportunities, and mentorship. A non-exhaustive list of potential major and minor remits include: the various asset class business development teams, Request for Proposal, Client Response Center, Product Strategy and Development, and vehicle teams (ETF, SMA, etc).

* Series 7 FINRA certification or willingness to obtain
* Current CFA or progressing towards preferred
* Creativity and a marketing “sense” is a distinct plus

title: Integrated Supply Chain Analyst – P3
description:
**ABOUT TENNECO**

At Tenneco, we don’t follow industry standards; we set them, and we don’t settle for being best-in-class because we hustle to be better than best-in-class. Whether it’s our Core Values, radical candor, simplify, organizational velocity, tenacious execution and win, or our Get Stuff Done (GSD) mindset, we’re determined to become the most trusted partner and best manufacturer and distributor to the transportation industry.

How do we make it happen? Through the Tenneco Way. Fueled by our Core Values, a winning mindset and a relentless commitment to excellence, the Tenneco Way is how we win. It keeps Team Tenneco bold, driven and focused on pushing past limits and redefining success.

Here, you’ll work alongside relentless problem-solvers committed to making a tangible impact. If you’re ready to break boundaries, deliver results and enjoy the ride along the way, you’ll thrive here.

Want to learn more about who we are? Check out our website to discover the Tenneco Way.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

The SCM / P3 Analyst uses Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, and the Microsoft Power Platform to design and maintain secure, scalable analytics and low-code solutions that support supply chain visibility, operational efficiency, workflow automation, and strategic decision-making.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Administer and support Power BI and Power Platform environments, capacities, workspaces, gateways, connections, and tenant settings.
* Design and develop Power Apps, including canvas apps and model-driven apps, for supply chain, procurement, inventory, logistics, quality, maintenance, and operations use cases.
* Build Power Automate cloud flows and approval workflows to streamline manual processes, notifications, exception handling, and business controls.
* Design Dataverse tables, relationships, security roles, business rules, and integrations to support scalable Power Platform solutions.
* Integrate Power Apps and Power Automate with Power BI, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, SharePoint, Teams, SQL, APIs, and enterprise data sources.
* Package and deploy Power Platform solutions across development, test, and production environments using managed solutions, connection references, environment variables, and ALM practices.
* Apply Power Platform governance standards, including environment strategy, DLP policies, connector controls, monitoring, auditing, and Center of Excellence practices.
* Develop analytics for supply chain costs, procurement efficiency, supplier performance, inventory health, logistics, and working capital.
* Build Power BI dashboards and semantic models for demand and supply planning, inventory levels, forecast accuracy, order fulfillment, lead times, and service performance.
* Create Power Apps and Power Automate solutions to streamline purchase requests, supplier onboarding, inventory exceptions, shipment tracking, approvals, and corrective-action workflows.
* Deliver insights for supplier quality, purchase price variance, on-time delivery, order cycle time, stockouts, excess and obsolete inventory, and transportation performance.
* Integrate data from ERP, warehouse management, transportation management, procurement, and supplier systems to provide end-to-end supply chain visibility.
* Connect Power BI and Power Platform solutions to ERP, warehouse management, transportation management, procurement, Dataverse, SharePoint, APIs, and other enterprise data sources.
* Ensure data consistency and accuracy across supply chain, procurement, inventory, logistics, and operational data sources.
* Implement row-level security (RLS), object-level security where applicable, role-based access control (RBAC), and environment-level access controls.
* Maintain audit trails, data governance policies, Power Platform governance controls, and solution documentation.
* Optimize Power BI reports, DAX calculations, and data models for faster performance.
* Improve report refresh times and optimize queries for large datasets.
* Apply best practices for data visualization, accessibility, responsive app design, and intuitive user experiences.
* Integrate Power BI and Power Platform solutions with AI/ML capabilities for demand forecasting, cost prediction, risk assessment, and intelligent automation.
* Partner with supply chain, procurement, logistics, operations, and IT teams to translate business requirements into analytics, applications, and automated workflows.
* Provide Power BI and Power Platform training and enablement to support governed self-service analytics and low-code development.
* Monitor Power BI reports, Power Apps, and Power Automate flows; troubleshoot data, performance, refresh, connection, and deployment issues.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS:**

* 10+ years of experience with business intelligence and analytics technologies, with deep expertise in Power BI; experience with Tableau is beneficial.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with Power BI, including semantic modeling, DAX, Power Query, dataflows, gateways, deployment pipelines, workspaces, security, and administration.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience building solutions with Power Apps (canvas and model-driven apps), Power Automate cloud flows, Dataverse, standard and premium connectors, and Microsoft 365 integrations.
* Experience with Python, Java, or Scala for data processing and integration is beneficial.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models, including Scrum ceremonies and work management tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience with source control, solution packaging, deployment automation, testing, and release management for Power BI and Power Platform solutions.
* Ability to work as a cross-functional team member supporting multiple workstreams, products, and business functions.
* Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Experience with Microsoft Power Platform administration, governance, environment strategy, data loss prevention (DLP) policies, Center of Excellence practices, and application lifecycle management (ALM).
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.
* Microsoft certification such as Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) is preferred.
* Microsoft Power Platform certifications such as Power Platform App Maker Associate (PL-100), Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400), or Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL-600) are preferred.

title: Sr Pharmacovigilance Data Migration Consultant – Oracle Argus Safety
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
Technical Consultant plays a crucial role in pharmacovigilance, particularly in the context of the Argus Safety System data migrations. The responsibilities of an data migration consultant, as outlined, involve various aspects of data migration, data management, automation, and collaboration with clients and source application data provider teams.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Configure, maintain, and optimize Oracle Argus Safety to support pharmacovigilance operations and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Lead end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects involving migration of safety data from legacy safety systems databases into target safety systems.
* Perform source system assessment, data profiling, gap analysis, and migration impact assessments to define migration strategies and project deliverables.
* Analyze and convert PostgreSQL databases, schemas, tables, views, indexes, sequences, functions, triggers, and stored procedures into Oracle Database/Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB) while ensuring data integrity and optimal performance.
* Design and maintain source-to-target mapping documents, transformation rules, migration specifications, and data conversion documentation.
* Develop SQL and PL/SQL scripts to support data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL), reconciliation, validation, and migration reporting activities.
* Perform data extraction, cleansing, standardization, transformation, and loading activities while ensuring accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
* Execute database schema conversion and optimize migrated database objects for Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Conduct comprehensive data validation and reconciliation between source and target systems to verify successful migration of all pharmacovigilance data.
* Support migration of safety entities including Cases, Products, Events, Licenses, Studies, Regulatory Reports, Literature, Users, Workflow Data, Attachments, and Configuration Data.
* Develop and execute migration validation plans, reconciliation reports, exception reports, and post-migration verification activities.
* Participate and support in migration testing activities including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Performance Testing, and Production Validation.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve migration issues related to data quality, database conversion, mapping discrepancies, application configurations, and system integrations.
* Develop and maintain Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) reports and validation reports to support migration verification and operational reporting.
* Collaborate with Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Business Analysts, Database Administrators, Validation Teams, and Oracle Support throughout migration projects.
* Support system integrations between Oracle Argus Safety and external applications using APIs, web services, and interface technologies.
* Ensure migrated data and system configurations comply with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EMA, ICH E2B(R3), GAMP 5, and organizational validation standards.
* Prepare and maintain migration documentation including Migration Plans, Data Mapping Specifications, Validation Documents, Technical Design Documents, SOPs, and Migration Summary Reports.
* Support Oracle Argus upgrades, cloud migrations, and database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Mentor junior consultants and provide technical guidance on migration methodologies, database conversion techniques, and Oracle Argus best practices.
* Recommend automation opportunities and continuous improvements to enhance migration efficiency, quality, and compliance.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Strong expertise in PostgreSQL database administration and development.
* Hands-on experience converting PostgreSQL databases to Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Experience with PostgreSQL-to-Oracle schema conversion, including tables, indexes, constraints, sequences, views, triggers, stored procedures, and functions.
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL programming skills.
* Experience developing migration scripts, stored procedures, packages, and automation utilities.
* Experience using Oracle SQL Developer Migration Workbench or equivalent schema conversion tools.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Database architecture, Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB), and performance tuning.
* Experience with ETL processes, data transformation, and migration automation.
* Ability to optimize SQL queries and improve migration performance for high-volume datasets.
* Perform end-to-end data assessment, profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and migration activities.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mapping documents and migration specifications.
* Execute complex SQL-based reconciliation and data validation activities.
* Identify and resolve migration defects, mapping inconsistencies, and data quality issues.
* Conduct pre-migration, mock migration, production migration, and post-migration verification.
* Support migration testing including SIT, UAT, Regression Testing, and Production Validation. Page 4 of 4 CONFIDENTIAL ERD-3-01b, Job Description Template, Rev. 13.0, Eff. 02/22/2023
* Perform record-level reconciliation to ensure completeness, consistency, and accuracy of migrated pharmacovigilance data.

* 7+ years of relevant experience in safety IT Systems

title: Fintech - FDI - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Business Analyst (Context Layer and Semantic Layer)
description:
**Sr. Business Analyst – India (Semantic Layer and Context Layer )**

**About SailPoint:**

Love what you do. And love where you do it. Smart people, fun culture, innovative work, beautiful offices — oh, and everyone’s really nice. That’s what people say about SailPoint. We’re known as the company where everyone wants to work, and employee reviews about us prove it. If you’re passionate about  AI Context Layer, Semantic Layer modeling and working at a company where you  can truly have an impact, join our team. SailPoint empowers the largest, most complex organizations by putting identity at the Centre of Security and IT. Our 2,000+ customers include global financial institutions, government entities, and pharmaceutical organizations and more.

**About the Role**

We are building the semantic and contextual foundation that powers our AI agent and agentic analytics platform. As Senior Business Analyst, you will own the translation of business knowledge — metrics, entities, business rules, and domain context — into structured, machine-consumable semantic and context layers that AI agents rely on to reason over enterprise data accurately and safely.

Unlike a traditional BI-focused semantic layer built for dashboards, this role treats the
**semantic layer as the "vocabulary" and the context layer as the "grounding Business context knowledge Base "**
that an LLM-powered agent uses at query/inference time — to disambiguate business terms, retrieve the right data, apply correct business logic, and avoid hallucinated or incorrect answers when a business user asks a natural-language question like
*"What was our churn last quarter by region?"*

You'll sit at the intersection of business analysis, data architecture, and applied AI — working closely with AI/ML engineers, platform architects, and business stakeholders to ensure the agent's "understanding" of the business is accurate, current, and governed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Semantic Layer for Agent Consumption**

* Define and maintain the semantic model (metrics, dimensions, entities, synonyms, relationships) that AI agents use to map natural-language business questions to correct data queries (SQL, semantic layer APIs, or knowledge graph traversals)
* Design metric and entity definitions with agent-readability in mind: unambiguous naming, explicit synonyms/aliases, disambiguation rules for overloaded business terms (e.g., "revenue" meaning different things in different departments)
* Partner with AI engineers to structure the semantic layer for tool-calling/function-calling patterns — ensuring agents select the right metric, filter, and grain when generating queries
* Continuously test and tune semantic definitions against agent query failures, misinterpretations, and hallucination patterns

**Context Layer & Grounding for AI Agents**

* Design the context layer that supplies agents with the business rules, caveats, definitions, data lineage, and usage guardrails needed to ground responses (e.g., via RAG retrieval, system prompts, or structured metadata injection)
* Curate and structure business context objects — glossaries, policy documents, calculation logic, exceptions/edge cases — into formats optimized for retrieval (chunking strategy, embeddings-friendly structure, metadata tagging)
* Define context scoping and prioritization rules so agents retrieve the
  *most relevant and correct*
  context per query, minimizing noise and conflicting information
* Work with platform teams to version and govern context content so agent behavior stays aligned as business rules evolve

**Agent Behaviour & Quality Assurance**

* Partner with AI/ML engineers to evaluate agent outputs against expected business answers; identify root causes when agents misinterpret semantic or contextual inputs
* Build test question sets ("golden queries") representing real business questions to validate semantic/context layer coverage and accuracy
* Define feedback loops where incorrect agent responses trace back to semantic gaps, missing context, or ambiguous definitions — and drive remediation
* Support prompt/context engineering efforts by translating business nuance into structured inputs agents can reliably use

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the primary bridge between business domain experts and the AI platform/engineering team, ensuring business intent is faithfully encoded into semantic and context structures
* Collaborate with Business Stakeholder, data engineers and architects to ensure the underlying data model supports the semantic layer the agent depends on
* Work with data governance teams to ensure context/semantic content meets accuracy, security, and access-control standards (e.g., row-level security respected by agent-generated queries)

**Documentation & Governance**

* Maintain a living business glossary and context repository that serves as the authoritative source for both human users and AI agents
* Document the semantic layer's coverage, known gaps, and disambiguation logic for auditability
* Establish a review/change-management process for updating semantic and context definitions as the business evolves, without degrading agent performance

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or Knowledge/Ontology Analyst, with recent exposure to AI/LLM-powered platforms, copilots, or agentic systems
* Strong grasp of semantic modeling concepts (metrics layers, ontologies, knowledge graphs) and how they differ when designed for machine/agent consumption vs. human dashboards
* Understanding of how LLMs consume structured context — RAG architectures, embeddings, chunking strategies, function/tool calling, prompt/context engineering
* Experience translating ambiguous business language into precise, structured, disambiguated definitions
* Strong SQL skills and ability to work with data models, APIs, or knowledge graphs that agents query against
* Experience writing and structuring documentation (glossaries, business rules, metadata) in formats consumable by both people and AI systems
* Excellent stakeholder management — able to extract and reconcile business logic from multiple domain experts

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with semantic layer tools (such as UnifyApp, Atlan, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, AtScale, LookML)
  *and*
  AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar)
* Experience with vector databases and RAG pipeline design (such as Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, etc.)
* Familiarity with knowledge graph technologies (Neo4j, RDF/OWL) for entity/relationship modeling
* Experience evaluating LLM/agent outputs — building eval harnesses, golden datasets, or human-in-the-loop review processes
* Background in AI governance, model risk, or responsible AI practices as applied to enterprise data
* Exposure to enterprise data catalogs (Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Purview) and metadata management

**What Success Looks Like**

* AI agents consistently interpret business questions correctly because the semantic layer resolves ambiguity before the query is even generated
* Agent responses are grounded in accurate, current business context — reducing hallucinations and incorrect metric usage
* Business stakeholders trust agent-generated insights because the underlying semantic/context layer is transparent, auditable, and governed
* A measurable reduction in agent query failures/misinterpretations over time, tracked via golden-query test suites

This role defines
*what*
the agent should know and
*how*
it's structured (business/semantic ownership), while assuming AI/ML engineers own the underlying retrieval and orchestration infrastructure.

**30-60-90 Day Plan: Sr. Business Analyst – Semantic & Context Layer for AI Agents**

**Phase 1: Days 1–30 — Learn, Map, Assess**

**Theme:**
Understand the business, the data, the current AI agent/platform state, and where the gaps are.

**Key Activities**

* Meet with Busienss Stakeholders, AI/ML engineering, data platform, and architecture teams to understand the current agent stack (LLM used, orchestration framework, RAG setup, semantic layer tooling if any)
* Meet with business stakeholders across key domains (Finance, Sales, Ops, Marketing , IT, HR, GTM, etc.) to understand how they currently define and use core metrics/entities
* Inventory existing semantic assets: BI semantic layers, data dictionaries, business glossaries, metric definitions — assess quality, coverage, and consistency
* Run/observe the AI agent (if live) against a sample of real business questions; log where it fails, hallucinates, or misinterprets terms
* Review existing data models, lineage documentation, and access/security controls relevant to agent queries
* Identify 3–5 high-value, high-ambiguity business domains to prioritize (e.g., Marketing, Salesforce (L2C), revenue, churn, customer segmentation)

**Deliverables**

* Current-state assessment document: semantic layer maturity, context layer gaps, agent failure patterns
* Initial glossary of top ambiguous/overloaded business terms
* Initial Context Layer and Semantic Layer – List of Objects, Tables , Fiels , Domain Terms, Rules, process if any , Metrics and Formulae.
* Stakeholder map (who owns which metrics/definitions)
* List of 15–20 "golden queries" collected from real business users to use as early test cases
* Complete 3 Pilot usecases for Context Layer

**Success Markers**

* Clear understanding of where agent inaccuracy stems from (semantic gaps vs. context gaps vs. data model issues)
* Relationships established with AI engineering and key business stakeholders

**Phase 2: Days 31–60 — Design, Build, Test**

**Theme:**
Start building and iterating on the semantic/context layer for the priority domains identified in Phase 1.

**Key Activities**

* Define structured metric and entity specs for priority domains: name, definition, synonyms/aliases, calculation logic, grain, owner
* Design disambiguation rules for known overloaded terms (e.g., department-specific "revenue" definitions)
* Structure context objects (business rules, caveats, exceptions) for RAG retrieval — work with AI engineers on chunking, tagging, and metadata format
* Run the golden-query set against the agent before and after semantic/context updates; document accuracy shifts
* Set up a lightweight review/change-management process for updating definitions without breaking agent behavior
* Begin building the living business glossary / context repository as the shared source of truth
* Establish a feedback loop: agent failure → root cause tagged (semantic gap, context gap, data issue) → routed to fix owner

**Deliverables**

* Semantic layer v1 for 3–5 priority domains, live in the agent's query/tool-calling logic
* Context layer v1 (structured business rules/definitions) integrated into RAG or prompt context
* Expanded golden-query test suite (40–50 queries) with pass/fail tracking
* First iteration of the governance/change-management process doc

**Success Markers**

* Measurable improvement in agent accuracy on golden queries for priority domains (target: define a baseline % and improvement goal, e.g., 60% → 80%)
* Business stakeholders in priority domains have reviewed and signed off on definitions
* A repeatable process exists for adding new metrics/context to the layer

**Phase 3: Days 61–90 — Scale, Govern, Prove Value**

**Theme:**
Expand coverage, formalize governance, and demonstrate measurable impact to stakeholders.

**Key Activities**

* Expand semantic/context coverage to additional business domains beyond the initial priority set
* Formalize the golden-query evaluation as an ongoing QA process (e.g., run weekly/bi-weekly, track trend over time)
* Present before/after agent accuracy results to leadership and stakeholders, using concrete examples of resolved ambiguity/hallucination
* Finalize governance model: who approves new metric definitions, how versioning works, how context gets deprecated/updated as business rules change
* Train business users and analysts on how to contribute to or query the glossary/context repository
* Document known limitations and a roadmap for the next 90 days (e.g., additional domains, knowledge graph expansion, more advanced disambiguation)

**Deliverables**

* Documented, governed semantic + context layer covering majority of high-value business domains
* Ongoing QA/eval process with historical accuracy tracking
* Stakeholder-facing readout: impact summary (accuracy improvement, reduced hallucinations, adoption metrics)
* 90-day forward roadmap

**Success Markers**

* Agent demonstrates sustained, measurable accuracy improvement across expanded domains
* Governance process is operating without the BA being a bottleneck for every change
* Leadership/stakeholders have visibility into and confidence in the semantic/context layer's value

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong UX Researcher (Quantitative Research / UX Analytics / Experimentation) Profiles.
* Mandatory (Experience 1) – Must have 3+ years of experience in UX Research, Quantitative UX Research, Product Research, Consumer Insights, behavioral research, or Experience Research, with a strong focus on quantitative research methodologies for digital products (Web/App).
* Mandatory (Experience 2) – Must have hands-on experience designing and executing quantitative UX research studies, including surveys, usability benchmarking, large-scale user feedback analysis, behavioral research, and statistical analysis to generate actionable product insights.

* Mandatory (Experience 5) – Must have practical exposure to A/B testing/Experimentation, including hypothesis creation, experiment design, statistical interpretation of results, and product optimization.
* Mandatory (Experience 6) – Must possess strong analytical skills with experience using tools such as SQL, Excel, Tableau, Power BI, GA4, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar for quantitative data analysis, reporting, and insight generation.

title: Vessel Performance Expert
description:
**Job Description**
**Vessel Performance Expert**
Smart Ship Hub (SSH) is hiring a
**Vessel Performance and Machinery Condition Monitoring Expert**
in Pune: a former sailing Chief Engineer (Marine) with shore-side experience who can turn vessel data into measurable fuel, reliability and maintenance outcomes.
  
  
**Item**
**Detail**
Position
  
  
Vessel Performance Expert
  
  
Function
  
  
Vessel Performance / Fleet Intelligence
  
  
Location
  
  
Pune, India
  
  
Engagement
  
  
Full time or part time
  
  
Core expertise
  
  
Vessel Performance, Predictive Diagnostics, Predictive Maintenance, Condition Based Monitoring (CBM)
  
  
Background
  
  
Sailed as Chief Engineer (Marine) plus mandatory shore experience in vessel performance, Condition based monitoring, Predictive machinery health
  
  
**Purpose and Scope of the Role**
The Vessel Performance Expert is SSH’s domain authority on how ships actually run. The role links onboard engineering reality with SSH’s digital platform, so that performance insights, diagnostics and maintenance recommendations are technically credible to Chief Engineers, superintendents, ship owners & managers.
  
  
The scope covers fleet-wide monitoring of main engine, auxiliary engine, machinery performance and hull, propulsion, supports both customer-facing delivery and the product and data science teams building SSH’s analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Predictive Diagnostics**

* Detect early deviations in main engine, auxiliary engine, turbocharger, boiler and auxiliary machinery behaviour, and identify probable root causes.
* Define diagnostic rules, thresholds and fault signatures with the data science team; validate model alerts against engineering judgement.

**Predictive Maintenance**

* Translate diagnostic findings into maintenance recommendations, spares planning and risk-ranked work orders.
* Align recommendations with PMS, class requirements and OEM guidelines; track outcomes to improve model accuracy.

**Condition Based Monitoring (CBM)**

* Design and maintain CBM programmes covering vibration, lube oil analysis, exhaust gas temperatures, cylinder pressures and bearing temperatures.
* Define sensor and data requirements for new vessels and retrofits; review data quality and flag gaps.

**Vessel Performance**

* Analyse speed, fuel consumption, trim, draft, hull and propeller condition, and weather-corrected performance using noon, high-frequency sensor and voyage data.
* Benchmark vessels and sister ships; recommend operational and technical actions that cut fuel cost and emissions (CII, EEOI, EU ETS exposure).
* Quantify hull cleaning, dry-dock and retrofit impact; produce performance reports for owners, managers and charterers.

**Customer and Internal Collaboration**

* Act as technical interface with customers’ superintendents and Chief Engineers; support presales demos and onboarding.
* Provide domain input to Product and Engineering for features, dashboards and alert logic.
* Mentor junior analysts on marine engineering concepts.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
**Mandatory**

* Sailed as Chief Engineer (Marine) on ocean-going vessels; valid CoC Class I (Motor/Steam) or equivalent.
* Shore-side experience in vessel performance is a must (for example in vessel or fleet performance management, performance analytics or technical superintendency with a performance focus).
* Demonstrated hands-on expertise in vessel performance, condition based monitoring, predictive diagnostics and predictive maintenance.
* Degree in Marine or Mechanical Engineering.

**Preferred**

* Experience with performance or CBM platforms, noon-report and high-frequency data, and OEM monitoring systems.
* Working knowledge of IMO CII, SEEMP, EU ETS and FuelEU Maritime.
* Exposure to Python, SQL or BI tools for analysis.
* Experience working with data science or product teams or customer-facing exposure.

**Deliverables, Engagement Terms and Why SSH**
**Key deliverables and KPIs**

* Monthly fleet performance and CBM reports delivered on time.
* Diagnostic alerts validated with a documented root cause and recommended action.
* Maintenance recommendations accepted and closed by customers; targets to be agreed with the hiring manager.
* Documented diagnostic rules and CBM playbooks added to SSH’s knowledge base.

**Why join Smart Ship Hub**

* Apply sea-going experience to a global maritime digital platform.
* Shape predictive analytics products used by ship owners and managers.
* Work directly with leadership in a growth-stage environment.

*Smart Ship Hub is an equal opportunity employer and evaluates all candidates on skills and experience.*

title: Data Analytics Engineer I
description:
**Job Purpose**
Design and deliver data transformation pipelines, semantic models, and BI solutions that enable reliable, self-service analytics across the organization. The role bridges data engineering and business intelligence, owning the analytical data layer from source transformation through to governed, business-ready reporting assets.
  
  
Key Result Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and maintain modular, well-tested ELT pipelines using tools such as dbt, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
* Build and maintain the semantic/analytical data layer in Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric, including fact and dimension tables, conformed metrics, and reusable dbt models.
* Develop production-grade Power BI reports and dashboards, including well-structured data models, DAX measures, and row-level security configurations.
* Define and implement data quality rules, testing frameworks, and monitoring to ensure accuracy and consistency of analytics outputs.

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued
  
  

* Collaborate with data analysts, business stakeholders, and data engineers to translate reporting requirements into robust, governed data assets.
* Apply and enforce dimensional modelling principles (star schema, slowly changing dimensions) to support efficient BI consumption.
* Work within Azure and Snowflake environments to manage datasets, optimize query performance, and control data access.
* Maintain clear documentation for all pipelines, semantic models, metric definitions, and report logic.
* Participate actively in code reviews and contribute to improving team standards for analytics engineering.

**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, Statistics, or a related field.
* Fluent in English Language.
* ITIL Certification is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Strong SQL skills and solid working knowledge of Python for data transformation tasks.
* Working knowledge of dbt for transformation layer development, including tests, documentation, and lineage.
* Hands-on experience with Power BI: data modelling, DAX, report design, and workspace governance.
* Demonstrable experience delivering Power BI solutions in a professional setting.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric or Azure Data Factory for pipeline orchestration and data movement.
* Solid understanding of dimensional modelling (star/snowflake schema, SCD types).
* Understanding of BI governance principles: semantic model management, certified datasets, and access control in Power BI.

Work Experience
  
  

* With 2–4 years of hands-on experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI development.
* Experience with Snowflake or Azure Synapse Analytics for data warehousing and query optimization.
* Experience with Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows.

Full-Time

Pune

Dairy

10:00 AM – 7:00 PM

6 Days

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a business analytics leader to build and lead our central analytics function. This person will establish the data foundation, lead analysts and data engineers, and help teams make faster, better decisions.

The role combines data strategy, business analytics, and growth. The person should understand P&L, category growth, marketing, operations, and customer behaviour. They will also work directly with the Founder on high-priority strategic projects.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Build the analytics function**

Define the company’s analytics vision, operating model, and roadmap.

Hire and lead a high-performing team of analysts and data engineers.

Create a central source of truth serving all business functions.

Build a culture of structured, data-backed decision-making.

**Build the data foundation**

Design a scalable architecture covering data integration, warehousing, modelling, governance, and BI.

Integrate data across marketing, sales, finance, operations, product, and customer systems.

Establish reliable metrics, data-quality standards, and self-serve dashboards.

Review architecture and analysis while guiding technical decisions.

**Drive business and growth decisions**

Identify revenue, margin, cost, and operational improvement opportunities.

Support planning, forecasting, target setting, and business reviews.

Build analytics frameworks for P&L, categories, channels, products, and customers.

Improve acquisition, conversion, retention, cross-sell, pricing, and customer lifetime value.

Strengthen marketing effectiveness through attribution, incrementality testing, segmentation, and budget optimisation.

Build an experimentation program across customer journeys, pricing, offers, and product features.

**Lead strategic projects**

Work with the Founder on complex, high-impact business problems.

Lead projects such as expansion, P&L optimisation, category growth, sales productivity, and cross-sell.

Turn analysis into clear recommendations and drive execution with stakeholders.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

Establish the central analytics team and operating model.

Build a trusted data foundation and self-serve analytics system.

Standardise KPIs and automate leadership business reviews.

Embed analytics into planning, experimentation, and capital allocation.

Deliver measurable improvements in growth, profitability, marketing efficiency, or operational productivity.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

Experience in business, growth, product, or data analytics.

Experience building an analytics function in a high-growth consumer/D2C company.

Proven ability to lead analysts and data engineers.

Strong understanding of unit economics, growth levers, customer funnels, and business operations.

Track record of improving revenue, profitability, conversion, retention, or marketing efficiency through data.

Experience with data warehousing, BI systems, experimentation, segmentation, and attribution.

Comfortable working directly with founders on ambiguous business problems.

Strong communicator who can translate complex analysis into clear decisions.

**TECHNICAL CAPABILITIES**

Strong SQL, analytical problem-solving, data modelling, BI, experimentation, and customer or marketing analytics skills. Experience with modern data warehouses and analytics tools is useful, but business judgment and measurable impact matter more than specific technologies.

description:

is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
**bringing together data, science, technology**
and
**human ingenuity**
to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
**client-first mentality**

Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
  
  
**Insights & Analytics**
**ZS's Insights & Analytics group**
partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.
  
  
The role
  
  
A hands-on build-and-analyze role. You own modules within AI-enabled analytics products and independently deliver core commercial analytics workstreams for the same client teams. Expect roughly a 50/50 split between AI engineering and core analytics, flexing with the release cycle. You work under a Consultant, guide Associates on your modules, and interact directly with client analysts and product owners.
  
  
This is not a pure AI/ML engineering role. You will be staffed across build and analytics work for the same client depending on demand. Both halves are required.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* AI & analytics engineering (~50%)

+ Build and maintain pipeline components on Databricks: Delta transformations, metric views, signal-detection logic, LLM narrative steps, app-facing data contracts.
+ Implement agent tools, prompts and context assets on an agent SDK (Claude Agent SDK or equivalent); write the unit and regression tests that go with them.
+ Run evaluation harnesses: score LLM outputs against rubrics, triage failures, log defects, propose fixes.
+ Implement data-layer guardrails (governed tables, scope-controlling joins) and KPI canonicalization in code.
+ Support SIT/UAT: test cases, evidence capture, defect lifecycle in JIRA.

**Core commercial analytics (~50%)**

* Deliver analyses across client functions — commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, enterprise operations — under Consultant direction, from data pull to insight.
* Apply the appropriate method — descriptive and diagnostic analysis, cohorts, segmentation, forecasting basics, test-and-control — and explain why it fits.
* Work hands-on with varied data: syndicated and patient-level real-world data, clinical and trial data, engagement and CRM data, payer, operational and financial data.
* QC your own work — reconciliation to source, benchmark and sanity checks — and turn analysis into clear slides and written summaries for client review.

**Team**

* Guide 1–2 Associates on module-level work; review their code and outputs.
* Own status and blockers for your modules; escalate early.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor's or master's degree required in any discipline with strong record of academic success in quantitative and analytic coursework such as operations research, applied mathematics, management science, data science, statistics, econometrics or engineering.
* 2-5 years of relevant post-collegiate job experience. A PhD may substitute in lieu of work experience.
* SQL — strong. Window functions, cohort logic, joins across large tables.
* Python — strong. pandas/PySpark, functions and modules, tests, Git.
* LLM application hands-on — Prompt and context engineering, RAG or tool calling; at least one application built end to end with a documented evaluation approach. Agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph) a plus.
* Applied analytics — translating business questions into analysis with QC: descriptive and diagnostic analysis, cohorts, segmentation, test-and-control, forecasting basics. Life-sciences or healthcare data experience preferred — any function; exposure to real-world data (claims, EHR), clinical/trial or engagement data a plus.
* Clear written summaries and slides; comfortable presenting your own work to clients.
* Delivers modules end to end; asks the right questions early.
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS.
  
  
**Hybrid working model:**
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
  
  
**Travel:**

While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
  
  
**Considering applying?**
At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. title: VP - Senior Salesforce Developer - IB Tech & CRM / Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
About IB Technology:
  
  
IB Tech, CRM & Analytics is a strategic, agile and cross-functional team responsible for leading the firm's global digitalization effort through innovative technology, data science and deep analytics. The team partners with all client-facing business units and corporate functions, as well as industry experts, to build transformational technology impacting investment banking, trading, sales, and research teams to drive revenue, maximize efficiency, and optimize client service.
  
  
We are at the forefront of Jefferies' cloud initiative, leveraging best-in-class cloud-based technologies to replace legacy on-premises solutions to provide intelligent trend insights, actionable opportunities, decision support, and transparency into all client and business-related activities.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a VP, Salesforce Engineer, you will own the design and delivery of complex, end-to-end solutions on the Salesforce platform - integration orchestration, compliance-grade workflows, and custom framework extensions within a large-scale enterprise org. You operate independently: given a problem, you determine the technical approach and present architectural trade-offs. You will work within a global engineering team, coordinating across time zones, driving technical decisions, and ensuring work holds up at a scale. This role demands deep expertise, strong engineering judgment, and the ability to lead through delivery in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Hands-On Development: Design and build complex functionality using Apex, LWC, Flows, and process automation - balancing declarative and custom coding. Contribute to data model design and architecture decisions that support long-term scalability.
* Integration Engineering: Develop and maintain integration using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Named Credentials, and External Objects.
* Global Coordination: Collaborate daily with a distributed engineering team across multiple geographies. Communicate clearly on technical approach, dependencies, and delivery timelines. Participate actively in Agile ceremonies.
* Code Quality & Platform Health: Write robust, well-tested code. Participate in peer code reviews. Develop with governor limits and org health in mind - optimized queries, bulkification, and appropriate async processing at scale.
* Troubleshooting: Perform root-cause analysis and debug complex problems across Apex, LWC, and integration layers with urgency and precision.

Mandatory Qualifications & Skills:
  
  

* Custom Framework Experience: Worked within a large, heavily customized Salesforce org, config-driven UI frameworks, custom LWC component libraries, metadata-driven layouts. Experience integrating third-party JS libraries inside LWC shadow DOM
* Advanced Apex & Async Processing: Triggers, batch, Queueable chains, future methods, platform events - all at scale with governor limits in mind. Built parallel callout orchestration to multiple external systems with partial failure handling.
* LWC (Beyond Basics): Component composition, custom event architecture, imperative Apex, dynamic rendering, cross-component state management. Strong JS/HTML/CSS - can take a custom design and build it accurately in Lightning.
* Multi-Pattern Integration: REST APIs, SOAP, Named Credentials, file ingestion, legacy adapters. Understands retry logic and contract-first design.
* Data Modelling for Scale & Compliance: Complex parent-child hierarchies, Custom Metadata as config (not just settings), JSON serialization for data capture, SOQL optimized for volume. Have built systems where data correctness has regulatory consequences.
* Engineering Fundamentals: Git workflows (branching, PRs, conflict resolution), IDE + SF CLI, SOLID principles, Agile with distributed teams. Communicates technical decisions clearly across time zones.
* Good to have - working knowledge of TypeScript; experience with test automation; familiarity with AWS services (Lambda, S3, API Gateway); Financial Services exposure.

Education & Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 8+ years of relevant experience.
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
* Salesforce Certified JavaScript Developer I
* Salesforce Certified Application or System Architect (Preferred)

**Insights & Analytics**
**ZS's Insights & Analytics group**
partners with clients to design and deliver solutions to help them tackle a broad range of business challenges. Our teams work on multiple projects simultaneously, leveraging advanced data analytics and problem-solving techniques. Our recommendations and solutions are based on rigorous research and analysis underpinned by deep expertise and thought leadership.
  
  
**The role**
A build-and-advise role. You lead build pods on AI-enabled analytics products and independently own core commercial analytics problems for the same client teams. Expect roughly a 60/40 split between AI engineering and core analytics, flexing with the release cycle. You own workstream-level delivery, manage 2–4 Associates / Associate Consultants, and are the day-to-day technical counterpart for client analytics and enterprise-AI stakeholders.
  
  
This is not a pure AI/ML engineering role. When build demand is low, you are staffed on core analytics workstreams for the same client; when it is high, you lead the build. Both halves are required.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* AI & analytics engineering (~60%)

+ Own end-to-end build of insight pipelines on Databricks: certified Delta tables → metric layer → signal detection → LLM narrative → application surface.
+ Design agentic workflows on an agent SDK (Claude Agent SDK or equivalent): tool design, context and prompt engineering, governed context stores, fallbacks and failure handling.
+ Enforce guardrails in data and metadata — governed tables, SQL-level scope control — rather than in prompt instructions.
+ Build evaluation harnesses for LLM output: answer-quality rubrics, binary gates (numerical fidelity, grounding, compliance), regression suites, release gates; tracing via Langfuse/LangSmith or equivalent.
+ Deliver conversational analytics (NL-to-SQL) on governed semantic layers (Databricks Genie, Metric Views) with certified KPI definitions.
+ Set engineering standards: code review, Git/CI, unit and SIT test plans, UAT support, release notes, observability, cost and latency tracking.
+ Produce architecture documents, security / IT-risk evidence packs and status reporting with honest status legends (implemented / in-flight / planned / blocked).

**Core commercial analytics (~40%)**

* Take ambiguous questions from any client function — commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, supply chain, enterprise operations — and structure them into decision-oriented analytical plans; own them end to end.
* Pick the method the question needs — diagnostic analysis, cohort and longitudinal analysis, segmentation, forecasting, test-and-control and causal inference, predictive modelling, optimisation — and defend the choice.
* Work across the client's data estate — syndicated and patient-level real-world data, clinical and trial data, engagement and CRM data, payer and access data, operational and financial data — integrating sources and resolving definitional conflicts.
* Establish governed definitions (KPIs, cohorts, business rules) with the client and make them enforceable in code — one definition, every surface.
* Convert results into decisions: QC'd, client-ready narratives and decks; activation into workflows, dashboards or products; present to Director+ stakeholders.

**Client & team leadership**

* Plan, review and coach a team of 2–4; QC everything before it reaches the client.
* Own workstream status, risks and dependencies with ZS leadership and client PMO.
* Contribute to proposals, POVs and CST capability building — reusable assets and AI upskilling of CST talent.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering (any discipline) with strong academic performance, particularly in analytics and quantitative coursework
* 5 – 8 years of relevant job experience. An MBA/PhD may substitute in lieu of work experience
* SQL — expert. Window functions, cohort and longitudinal logic, performance tuning on claims-scale data.
* Python — production-grade. pandas/PySpark, packaging, testing, Git; you have owned code others depend on.
* Lakehouse platform — Databricks (Delta, Unity Catalog, Spark, Workflows) or comparable (Snowflake/BigQuery + Spark).
* LLM application engineering — Prompt and context engineering, RAG, function/tool calling, agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph or equivalent), evaluation and monitoring. You can explain how your system failed and what you changed.
* Applied analytics — solving business problems in a stakeholder-facing role, spanning more than one method family: diagnostic and cohort/longitudinal analysis, segmentation, test-and-control / causal inference, forecasting, predictive modelling; statistical rigour and explicit QC. Life-sciences or healthcare analytics experience strongly preferred — any function (commercial, medical, market access, clinical development, operations); hands-on with real-world data (claims, EHR, registries), clinical/trial or engagement data a plus.
* Consulting skills. Structure ambiguity, own deliverables end to end, communicate crisply in PowerPoint, Excel and in the room.
* People leadership. Has led 2+ people on delivery with accountability for their output quality.
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

* Facilitating the removal of impediments to the team’s progress and follow up to track dependencies.
* Ensuring that all team events take place, they are productive and kept within the timebox.
* Being the facilitator of the team during workshops to achieve desirable outcomes.
* Creating the environment for continuous improvement, supporting the overall agile transformation.
* Together with the Product Owner and the team members, you create the roadmap and plan the releases for the products being built.

**Your Skills And Experience**

The ideal candidate will have a good blend of business and technical IT skills. Specific requirements for this position include:
  
  

* You have at least 5 years of experience working for IT projects.
* You possess in-depth knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodology and have a background of Data Analytics. You have at least 3 years of experience as a scrum master in an Agile IT development team. Being a Certified Scrum Master is a plus.
* You have at least 3 years of experience as a business or functional analyst
* You can use tools to accommodate efficient collaborations (Confluence, Jira, Teams).
* Having experience with Scaling frameworks and processes would be a plus.

* You understand the dynamics of change management, support, service, and you consider continuous improvement, thinking outside the box and ahead a given.
* You dare to question our way of working in a respectable way. At the same time, you’re open to feedback and new ideas.

Travel may be required occasionally.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Semantic BI - Senior
description:
