**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics - Semantic BI Engineer – Senior**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY's Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalise on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client's decision-making.
  
  
**Role : Semantic BI Engineer**
**Experience Guide : 3-7 Years**
**Primary Skill Area :**
Semantic Analytics, Self-Service BI, Dashboards, AI-Enabled Insights & Decision Intelligence
  
  
**The opportunity**
Design, build and advise on enterprise BI and semantic analytics solutions that convert trusted data into actionable business insights. This role is not limited to dashboard development; the candidate must be able to assess business needs, propose the right dashboarding or self-service reporting tools, design semantic data layers, build high-quality dashboards, and enable next-generation AI-assisted analytics experiences. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* BI Strategy, Tool Evaluation & Solution Advisory
* Assess business reporting, analytics and self-service consumption needs across user personas, maturity levels, governance requirements and operating constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend the right BI, dashboarding and self-service reporting tools based on scalability, semantic layer fit, governance, cost, user adoption, integration capability and AI-readiness.
* Shape enterprise BI and analytics roadmaps across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst and other modern analytics platforms.
* Advise stakeholders on when to use operational reporting, executive dashboards, self-service analytics, semantic search, conversational BI, embedded analytics or AI-assisted insight discovery.
* Semantic Layer & Analytics Engineering
* Design semantic data layers that separate business logic from physical data structures and allow consistent consumption across dashboards, reporting tools, AI assistants and self-service analytics platforms.
* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.
* Align semantic models with business glossaries, metadata, lineage, data quality rules, access controls and enterprise governance standards.
* Dashboard Development, Architecture & Data Storytelling
* Design and develop high-quality dashboards, scorecards and analytical reports that support executive decisions, operational monitoring, root-cause analysis and business performance tracking.
* Apply dashboard design principles including KPI hierarchy, drill-through, guided navigation, narrative flow, visual consistency, usability, accessibility and performance optimisation.
* Build dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst or equivalent enterprise BI platforms.
* Move beyond visualisation by translating patterns, trends and exceptions into actionable business insights, recommendations and decision support.
* Data Modelling, Data Analysis & Insight Generation
* Apply strong data modelling skills including dimensional modelling, star schema design, semantic modelling, analytical data product modelling, metric modelling and data mart design.
* Perform deep data analysis using SQL, analytical thinking, data profiling, reconciliation, segmentation, trend analysis, variance analysis and root-cause investigation.
* Partner with business SMEs, data engineers, data architects and product owners to convert business questions into robust data models, analytical logic and reusable reporting assets.
* Ensure insights are grounded in trusted data, explainable logic, meaningful context and clear business interpretation.
* AI-Enabled Analytics & Next-Generation BI
* Understand where and how AI can improve analytics workflows, including natural language querying, automated insight generation, anomaly detection, narrative summaries, semantic search and guided analysis.
* Enable AI-assisted analytics using capabilities such as Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI where relevant.
* Design AI-ready semantic layers that provide business context, trusted metrics, governed definitions and explainability for conversational BI and agentic analytics use cases.
* Identify appropriate use cases for AI in BI while recognising where traditional dashboards, governed reports or human-led analysis remain more suitable.
* Governance, Adoption & Analytics Operating Model
* Define governance standards for dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, certified datasets, access controls, refresh schedules, lifecycle management and reporting asset ownership.
* Support integration with governance and catalogue platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Immuta or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Create templates, design standards, dashboard review checklists, documentation patterns and adoption playbooks for consistent analytics delivery.
* Enable business users through self-service analytics training, guardrails, metric definitions and trusted data consumption practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* BI and dashboarding - Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, executive dashboards, self-service reporting, embedded analytics.
* Semantic and analytics engineering - Semantic layers, Fabric Semantic Models, Power BI datasets, metrics layer, governed KPIs, SQL, dbt-style modelling, analytical data products, business glossary alignment.
* Data modelling - Dimensional modelling, star schema design, snowflake schema design, semantic modelling, metric modelling, data mart design, canonical/domain model awareness, data dictionary creation.
* Data analysis and insight generation - Advanced SQL, data profiling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, variance analysis, segmentation, data storytelling, business analysis, actionable insight generation.
* AI and next-generation analytics - Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure OpenAI, conversational BI, semantic search, AI-assisted insights, agentic analytics.
* Governance and operations - Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Immuta, certified datasets, data lineage, access controls, dashboard governance, BI adoption, performance optimisation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: 3-7 years
* 3+ years of experience in BI, analytics engineering, data analysis, semantic modelling, data modelling or analytics architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and semantic models, with the ability to advise on the right BI/self-service analytics tools for business needs.
* Preferred certifications: Power BI Data Analyst, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, Tableau, Snowflake/Databricks analytics credentials, AI/GenAI foundations or cloud data certifications.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.
* This role is not a traditional BI Developer. It is a Semantic BI Engineer and analytics architect who defines how trusted data is modelled, consumed and converted into actionable insight through governed dashboards, self-service analytics and AI-enabled decision intelligence.

**What We Look For**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasises high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

* Experience in creating and analyzing energy data sets for power models.

  Collaborate with full-stack engineers to maintain an adaptable integration layer, ensuring vendor replacements require simple configuration rather than a full code rewrite.

* ****Data Quality Ownership:****

* ****Migration Strategy:****

  Lead data migration paths off retired legacy systems while preserving historical continuity and audit trails.
* ****Lean AI & Continuous Improvement:****

* Proactive adoption of AI tools to accelerate pipeline creation, audit data quality, and enrich datasets.

title: Lead - Claims
description:
**Lead - Claims**

**AArete is one-of-a-kind when it comes to consulting firm culture.**

We’re a global, innovative management and technology consulting firm with offices in the U.S. and India. Our name comes from the Greek word for excellence: “Areté.” And excellence is exactly what we strive for.

We’re celebrating our fourth year as one of Forbes’
*World’s Best Management Consulting Firms*
– and our success starts with our people. From robust career development planning to competitive life and wellness benefits, AArete’s “Culture of Care” takes a holistic approach to the employee experience.

AAretians (our team members) are leaders at every level. You are encouraged to unlock your full potential by directly contributing to our mission and prioritizing personal development and fulfillment.

**The Role**

As a Lead, you will work with US healthcare payer clients to identify opportunities that reduce medical and administrative costs, improve payment accuracy, and strengthen operational performance. You will help clients understand business issues, dig into the data, and develop recommendations that can be put into action. We are looking for someone who is comfortable going deep on unfamiliar payer topics, knows how to research quickly and thoughtfully, and can connect the dots across claims, operations, reimbursement, and client priorities.

**Work You’ll Do**

* Research payer topics, industry trends, regulations, operating models, and client-specific business issues.
* Review and analyze medical, eligibility, provider, pricing, reimbursement, and other healthcare data to find trends, issues, and opportunities.
* Use SQL and other tools to work through large datasets and evaluate utilization, cost drivers, reimbursement patterns, payment accuracy, and operational performance.
* Check data quality, test assumptions, document the logic behind the analysis, and make sure the work can stand up to client review.
* Develop recommendations, business cases, and implementation plans tied to cost savings, process improvement, medical cost management, and operational efficiency.
* Build practical points of view on payer topics such as claims, provider networks, reimbursement, payment integrity, utilization management, prior authorization, medical management and payer operations.
* Take loosely defined problems and turn them into a clear workplan by identifying the right questions, data sources, research sources, and decision points.
* Create presentations, summaries, dashboards, and reports that clearly explain what the analysis shows and what actions the client should consider.
* Lead workstreams, manage day-to-day analysis, and coordinate with client stakeholders, vendors, and internal AArete teams.
* Explain technical findings in plain business language during client meetings and internal working sessions.
* Identify related client needs and bring them to leadership when additional AArete support may be useful.
* Bring sound judgment, ownership, curiosity, and a hands-on problem-solving mindset to each engagement.
* Other duties as assigned

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, payer operations, claims analytics, healthcare operations, or a similar client-facing role.
* Bachelor’s degree required, or equivalent experience.
* Strong understanding of healthcare claims data, health plan data, payer processes, provider data, reimbursement concepts, and claims data structures.
* Good SQL skills and experience working with large datasets. Experience with Snowflake, Excel, or similar tools is helpful.
* Advanced Excel with the ability to create clean, client-ready analysis.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to move from data to insights, recommendations, and business cases.
* Excellent research skills, including the ability to learn unfamiliar payer topics, evaluate sources, pull out what matters, and explain the business implications clearly.
* Ability to contribute across a broad payer agenda, including claims, benefits, provider data, contracting, reimbursement, payment integrity, medical cost management, utilization management, prior authorization, risk adjustment, quality, Stars, member/provider experience, and operational transformation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analysis to both business and client audiences.
* Comfort working in fast-moving project environments with internal teams, clients, and vendors.
* High ownership, curiosity, accountability, and openness to feedback.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Direct payer experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience with claims analytics and/or network analytics, including payer/provider contracts, reimbursement language, and common contract terms.
* Exposure to medical management, utilization management, prior authorization, clinical operations, or related payer/provider functions.
* Experience with healthcare platforms such as provider data management systems, claims adjudication systems
* Familiarity with healthcare coding systems, including CPT, HCPCS, ICD, DRG, and APC.
* Strong knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid policies, regulations, and operating considerations.
* Experience with professional and facility claims.
* Experience with cost reduction, payment accuracy, process improvement, or operational transformation work in healthcare.

title: BI Lab Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Ecolab seeks a business-centric analytics professional who excels at turning ambiguous questions into actionable insights and has deep expertise in evolving those insights into scalable, production-ready solutions.
  
  
This role is the leader of a small team that sits at the intersection of business strategy, data, and product thinking. The primary strength of this role is the ability to quickly understand business context, translate it into meaningful metrics and analyses, and deliver relevant outputs that move decision-making forward.
  
  
In addition to leading the team, this individual will work iteratively with a variety of stakeholders across the enterprise. The day-to-day may include rapidly prototyping analyses, tools, or visualizations, refining them with stakeholders, and ultimately identifying which solutions should be scaled. As solutions mature, they will partner with BI developers and data engineers to operationalize them.
  
  
The person in this role will either facilitate the start of scaled solutions or they may contribute to hands-on delivery of scaled solution.
  
  
Success in this role is defined not by technical complexity, but by the ability to deliver relevant, impactful, data solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Translate business needs into data-driven solutions

+ Engage stakeholders to understand goals, context, and constraints
+ Identify the most relevant questions, metrics, and drivers of value

* Rapidly prototype insights and analytical tools

+ Move quickly from problem definition to gathering data to delivering an insight.
+ Deliver early versions of analyses, dashboards, models, or lightweight tools either via PowerPoint, PowerBI, Streamlit, or custom AI tools.
+ Iterate based on feedback to refine usefulness and clarity

* Apply the appropriate analytical approach

+ Determine when to use visualization, statistical analysis, modeling, or simple heuristics to a business problem.
+ Balance speed, rigor, and usability based on the situation (including the maturity of the question and the needs of the business).

* Perform data transformation and analysis

+ Use SQL or Python to source, clean, and transform data into useable data for analysis. If engaged in scaling data transformation, leverage dbt to create a scaled and tested data model for consumption.

* Design meaningful metrics and outputs

+ Define metrics that align with real business outcomes. Work with stakeholders to understand gaps in metric definitions or propose functional alternatives.
+ Ensure outputs are interpretable, actionable, and relevant to business needs.

* Evolve prototypes into scalable solutions

+ Translate prototypes into clear requirements for BI developers and data engineers
+ Partner cross-functionally to scale solutions into production
+ Sometimes contribute to scaled products.

* Operate flexibly between guidance and execution

+ Provide direction and oversight when resources allow
+ Contribute hands-on development when needed in resource-constrained environments

* Drive insight-led decision-making

+ Use outputs to guide and advance stakeholder conversations
+ Continuously refine questions and approaches through iteration

* Team Leadership

+ Coach direct reports and “dotted line” analysts on ways to improve solution development.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data science
* 3-5 Years of Direct People Management Experience
* Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction and transformation
* Proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, or prototyping
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar)
* Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into analytical approaches and solutions
* Experience working directly with stakeholders and iterating on analytical outputs
* Strong problem-framing and prioritization skills, with a focus on business impact

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with dbt for data transformation and modeling
* Experience building lightweight applications or prototypes using tools such as Streamlit.
* Familiarity with semantic models in Snowflake
* Experience with AI-enabled analytics tools such as Snowflake Cortex Agent or Databricks Genie.
* Experience implementing or supporting data quality testing frameworks.
* Exposure to product-oriented thinking in analytics (e.g., scaling dashboards, tools, or data products)
* Ability to translate exploratory work into structured requirements for engineering teams
* Experience with GitHub or other CI/CD pipeline tools.
* Experience using Claude Code or similar GenAI development tools.

**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging**
Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

title: Applied ML & Forecasting Lead for Freight MNC-Pune
description:
Responsibilities

● Build and maintain the forecasting arms behind one common interface: seasonal baselines, statistical models,

regularised linear models, LightGBM panel models with conformal calibration, and a pre-trained challenger

(Chronos-type foundation model).

● Own walk-forward backtesting, the sealed lockbox, prediction intervals, abstention rules and the router that picks an arm per market segment; hierarchical reconciliation from lane to corridor to index.

● Run the pre-registered signal-validation loop: screening of economic hypotheses, multiple-testing (false-

discovery-rate) control, bootstrap and placebo confirmation, and the out-of-sample gate that decides whether a signal enters the models.

● Graph: evaluate graph features through the same backtest fabric as every other feature; specify what the graph layer must deliver for forecasting; keep the door open for graph neural networks once the gates are met.

● Produce reproducible evaluation reports (skill vs. naive anchor, coverage, Diebold-Mariano) verifiable from a repository tag.

**Must have**

● Time-series, panel and multi-horizon forecasting in production (not only notebooks); LightGBM and regularised regression; temporal feature engineering.

● Rigorous evaluation: walk-forward and temporal cross-validation, leakage detection, point-in-time (as-of) correctness, calibration, conformal prediction, prediction intervals, model comparison.

● Statistics for signal discovery: lead/lag analysis, Granger-type tests, multiple testing and false-discovery-rate control, bootstrap methods.

● Strong Python, SQL, Pandas/Polars, experiment tracking (MLflow or comparable); containers, APIs and cloud basics.

● Can instruct a coding agent to implement a new forecasting arm with backtests, leakage checks and baseline comparison — and then judge whether the result is statistically correct.

**Nice to have**

Hierarchical forecasting and reconciliation; foundation models for time series; graph machine learning (PyTorch Geometric, heterogeneous graph models); basic Cypher; exposure to logistics, freight, commodities or financial time series.

Looking for Someone who has shipped forecasting models to production, not only in notebooks, and whose strength is statistics and time series rather than LLM applications.

**Common requirement**

AI-native engineering is mandatory. Daily, productive use of Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor or comparable agents; breaks work into

agent-ready specs and steers parallel tasks; reads, challenges and corrects AI-generated code; tests, CI/CD and evals as guardrails

(build → test → review → fix → merge → verify); fluent in Git, pull requests and code review; maintains CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md;Independent, remote, fluent English. Agent experience alone is not enough — LangChain/RAG/prompt-engineering profiles are not a fit.

title: Senior Engineer – Supply Chain
description:
**POSITION OVERVIEW**

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented
**Engineer / Senior Engineer – Supply Chain**
to manage and coordinate
**end-to-end supply chain activities**
, including demand planning, production scheduling, supplier management, inventory planning, SIOP, and delivery performance.

The ideal candidate should have experience in the
**automobile, construction machinery, heavy equipment, or engineering manufacturing industry**
, with strong analytical skills and hands-on experience in
**Advanced Excel and ERP systems such as Infor LN or SAP**
.

**MAIN TASK & RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Demand Planning & Forecasting***

* Develop and maintain demand plans based on customer requirements, sales forecasts, historical trends, and business inputs.
* Analyze demand vs. supply gaps and identify potential shortages or excess inventory.
* Coordinate with Sales, Marketing, Production, and other functions to ensure demand alignment.
* Monitor changes in customer requirements and assess their impact on supply and production plans.

***Production Planning & Scheduling***

* Prepare and maintain production plans and schedules based on demand, capacity, material availability, and customer priorities.
* Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Stores, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of the plan.
* Monitor production progress and proactively identify bottlenecks or constraints.
* Ensure timely availability of materials/components to support production schedules.

***Supplier Management & OTIF***

* Monitor supplier performance against
  **OTIF (On-Time In-Full)**
  targets.
* Track supplier delivery schedules, shortages, delays, and recovery plans.
* Coordinate with suppliers and internal procurement teams to resolve supply issues.
* Prepare supplier performance reports and highlight critical risks to management.
* Drive actions to improve supplier delivery reliability and reduce line stoppages.

***SIOP / Supply Chain Planning***

* Participate in the
  **SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning)**
  process.
* Prepare and analyze supply-demand scenarios and capacity constraints.
* Provide inputs on inventory, demand, supply, production capacity, and material availability.
* Support cross-functional discussions to align business demand with operational capacity.
* Highlight risks, constraints, and opportunities during SIOP reviews.

***Inventory Management***

* Monitor inventory levels and ensure optimum stock availability.
* Analyze excess, slow-moving, obsolete, and shortage materials.
* Support initiatives to improve inventory turns and reduce working capital.
* Ensure appropriate safety stock and replenishment parameters.

***ERP & Data Analysis***

* Use
  **ERP systems such as Infor LN or SAP**
  for planning, material management, order tracking, inventory monitoring, and reporting.
* Develop and maintain supply chain dashboards and MIS reports.
* Use
  **Advanced Excel**
  for data analysis, planning, forecasting, reporting, and scenario analysis.
* Knowledge of Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Power Query, advanced formulas, charts, and data visualization is preferred.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Supplier
  **OTIF / OTD**
* Production plan adherence
* Material availability
* Customer delivery performance
* Inventory levels and inventory turns
* Shortage and line-stop incidents
* Forecast accuracy
* Schedule adherence
* Excess and obsolete inventory
* Supply-demand gap closure

**REQUIREMENTS**

* **Both WAREHOUSE MANAGMENT & SUPPLY CHAIN MANAGEMENT (SCM) are a MUST.**
* Bachelor's degree in
  **Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering, or a related field**
  .
* **3–5 years of relevant experience**
  in Supply Chain, PPC, Material Planning, Production Planning, or Operations.
* Experience in
  **Automobile, Construction Machinery, Heavy Equipment, Engineering Manufacturing, or similar industries**
  .
* Good understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes.
* Hands-on experience in
  **Demand Planning, Production Scheduling, Supplier Management, OTIF, Inventory Management, and SIOP**
  .
* Working knowledge of
  **Infor LN and/or SAP**
  .
* Strong proficiency in
  **Advanced Excel**
  and data analysis.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, coordination, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and suppliers.
* Candidates who can
  **join at short notice**
  will be preferred.

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

* Knowledge of MRP/MPS and material planning concepts.
* Understanding of manufacturing processes and production capacity planning.
* Experience with supply chain dashboards and MIS.
* Knowledge of Power BI will be an added advantage.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
* Strong follow-up and stakeholder-management skills.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

The ideal candidate will be someone who can
**own the supply chain cycle from demand to delivery**
, rather than being limited to a single planning activity. The person should be comfortable working with
**customers/internal stakeholders, production teams, procurement, suppliers, and management**
, while using data and ERP systems to identify and resolve supply constraints.

title: Technology Commercial Support - Growth
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced technology pricing professional to lead the commercial design and pricing of complex, high-value opportunities during the pre-signature phase. This location-agnostic role sits within Technology Commercial Support, Growth, and reports to a Senior Technology Account Manager or market-specific Technology Account Manager.
  
  
You will act as the pricing lead for strategic opportunities, typically valued at €10 million to €30 million in total contract value, or support larger and more complex bids. You will develop value-led, competitive and governable commercial constructs while protecting margin, addressing commercial risk and aligning pricing decisions with market conditions.
  
  
Working across defined strategic accounts, sub-accounts or opportunity portfolios, you will collaborate with Technology Account Managers, pricing teams, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments, Digital & IT leaders and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Pricing and commercial design
  
  

* Shape end-to-end commercial constructs for new technology opportunities, aligning the pricing approach with deal strategy, customer requirements and risk profile
* Define pricing strategies that balance competitiveness, margin protection and long-term value
* Build, review and approve complex pricing models, including sensitivity, scenario and profitability analysis
* Apply relevant pricing constructs, including time and materials, Managed Services, output-based and gain-share models
* Clearly document and govern pricing assumptions, commercial risks, dependencies and guardrails
* Set pricing strategies and commercial constructs within Growth governance, escalating material risks or deviations where required
* Provide commercial analysis, market insight and competitor perspectives to support informed pricing decisions

Bid support and governance
  
  

* Lead pricing activity within bid squads for opportunities typically valued at €10 million to €30 million, or provide pricing leadership within larger, multi-tower bids
* Coordinate commercial inputs for requests for information, requests for proposal and customer submissions
* Create detailed pricing models, submission packs, proposal artefacts and governance documentation
* Assure the quality, consistency, accuracy and completeness of all pricing deliverables
* Coordinate with solution, pricing and commercial support teams to meet bid timelines and quality requirements
* Support opportunity and pipeline qualification, together with pricing approval processes, in line with Growth governance
* Maintain disciplined delivery across multiple customers and concurrent opportunities
* Enable an effective transition from Growth to business-as-usual teams by documenting pricing assumptions and commercial guardrails

Stakeholder and customer engagement
  
  

* Build collaborative relationships with key VOIS stakeholders, customer service owners and service leads
* Work closely with Senior Technology Account Managers, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments and Digital & IT leaders
* Participate in customer engagement activities and contribute commercial insight to the shaping of deals and solutions

title: Engineer – Order Management & Supplier Performance
description:
**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for an
**Engineer – Order Management & Supplier Performance**
responsible for managing purchase orders in the ERP system in line with production demand and material requirements. The role will focus on
**PO creation and maintenance, supplier delivery performance monitoring, OTIF measurement, supplier gap analysis, and delivery-date management**
in coordination with production and suppliers.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in
**supplier performance management, ERP-based order management, production planning coordination, and supplier delivery improvement**
.

**MAIN TASK & RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Purchase Order & Order Management***

* Create and release
  **Purchase Orders (POs)**
  in the ERP system based on approved demand, production requirements, and material plans.
* Ensure PO quantities and delivery schedules are aligned with
  **production requirements and demand planning**
  .
* Monitor open POs and follow up with suppliers for timely confirmation and delivery.
* Maintain accurate PO data in ERP, including quantities, delivery dates, and other relevant parameters.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Planning, Production, and suppliers to resolve PO-related issues.

***Supplier OTIF Performance Management***

* Measure and monitor
  **supplier OTIF (On-Time In-Full)**
  performance on a regular basis.
* Prepare supplier-wise OTIF reports and performance dashboards.
* Identify suppliers with
  **low OTIF performance**
  and highlight recurring delivery issues.
* Conduct
  **gap analysis**
  to understand the reasons for supplier delivery failures.
* Categorize delivery gaps such as:
* Supplier capacity constraints
* Raw material availability
* Production delays
* Logistics/transportation issues
* Incorrect quantities
* Quality-related delays
* Planning or communication gaps
* Work with suppliers and internal stakeholders to define corrective and preventive actions.

***Delivery Date Management in ERP***

* Regularly review PO delivery dates against the latest production plan.
* Update/reschedule PO delivery dates in the ERP when there is a
  **postponement or change in production requirements**
  , including changes caused by production mix.
* Ensure ERP delivery dates accurately reflect the latest agreed requirement with suppliers.
* Coordinate with Production Planning and suppliers before making delivery-date changes.
* Maintain proper records and visibility of changes to delivery schedules.

***Supplier Performance Improvement***

* Track supplier performance trends and identify recurring delivery issues.
* Conduct supplier-wise
  **performance gap analysis**
  and support improvement actions.
* Follow up with suppliers on agreed recovery plans and monitor closure.
* Support supplier performance review meetings with relevant data and analysis.
* Escalate critical supplier delivery risks that may impact production.
* Develop and maintain supplier performance reports, dashboards, and KPIs.

***Cross-Functional Coordination***

* Work closely with
  **Production Planning, Procurement, Stores/Warehouse, Quality, Logistics, and suppliers**
  .
* Communicate changes in production requirements and delivery schedules to suppliers.
* Ensure material availability is aligned with production requirements.
* Support resolution of shortages, delayed deliveries, excess deliveries, and other supply-related issues.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

* Supplier
  **OTIF %**
* PO delivery adherence
* Material availability against production requirement
* Number/value of overdue POs
* Supplier delivery gap closure
* Accuracy and timeliness of ERP PO updates
* Reduction in supplier delivery delays
* Timely closure of supplier corrective actions

**REQUIREMENTS**

* **Bachelor's degree in Engineering**
  , preferably Mechanical / Industrial / Production / Manufacturing Engineering.
* **3–5 years of relevant experience**
  in:
* Supplier Performance Management
* Order Management
* Supply Chain / Materials Management
* Procurement Operations
* Production Planning coordination
* Experience in a
  **manufacturing/automotive/engineering environment**
  would be preferred.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

* Strong understanding of
  **Purchase Order and supplier delivery management**
  .
* Good knowledge of
  **OTIF measurement and supplier performance KPIs**
  .
* Experience in supplier
  **gap analysis and corrective-action follow-up**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **ERP systems**
  such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent.
* Good knowledge of
  **MS Excel**
  , including Pivot Tables, lookups, data analysis, and reporting.
* Ability to analyze supplier delivery data and identify trends/root causes.
* Strong follow-up and coordination skills.
* Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work with suppliers and internal teams to resolve delivery issues.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple POs/suppliers simultaneously.

**PREFERRED SKILLS**

* Experience with
  **SAP MM / PP**
  or equivalent ERP modules.
* Knowledge of
  **MRP, production planning, and material requirement planning**
  .
* Knowledge of supplier scorecards and performance dashboards.
* Experience with
  **Power BI**
  or other reporting/analytics tools.
* Knowledge of
  **8D, RCA, CAPA, or similar problem-solving methodologies**
  .

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

The ideal candidate will be an engineer with
**3–5 years of hands-on experience in supplier performance and order management**
, who can independently manage PO schedules in ERP, monitor supplier OTIF, identify delivery-performance gaps, coordinate corrective actions with suppliers, and ensure that ERP delivery dates remain synchronized with changing production requirements

***NOTE: Kindly be informed that only shortlisted applicants will be contacted regarding the next steps in the recruitment process.***

title: Senior Staff - IT Data Engineering and Analytics
description:
**Overview**
**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity**
With 4,300 employees and over 400,000 retail and institutional clients from more than 80 offices spread across five continents, we’re a Fortune-100, Nasdaq-listed provider, connecting clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
At StoneX, we offer you the opportunity to be part of an institutional-grade financial services network that connects companies, organizations, and investors to the global markets ecosystem. As a team member, you'll benefit from our unique blend of digital platforms, comprehensive clearing and execution services, personalized high-touch support, and deep industry expertise. Elevate your career with us and make a significant impact in the world of global finance.
  
  
**Business Segment Overview:**
The Enterprise Data & Technology (EDT) team supports a wide variety of data assets and technologies in support of StoneX business initiatives for institutional and retail customers, while providing data services to almost all areas of the organization. Reporting to the Chief Data Officer, the EDT organization serves multiple internal stakeholders.
  
  
**Corporate:**
Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Purpose and Responsibilities**
**Position Purpose:**
The Senior Data Engineer (Forward Deployed) is a hands-on engineer who works alongside the business, not behind a ticket queue. You will embed with trading, operations, finance and risk teams to understand how they work, turn their questions into precise source-to-target mappings, and ship production Databricks pipelines on the StoneX Unified Data Platform in days and weeks, not quarters. AI is a core part of how you work: you use it to analyse sources, draft mappings, generate and test code, and build reusable frameworks that make the whole Global Data Services team faster. The role suits an engineer who enjoys a live problem, a demanding stakeholder and a fast pace, and who can explain a technical trade-off as clearly to a trader as to an engineer.
  
  
**What 'Forward Deployed' means here:**

* Embedded: you spend a large share of your time with business users – in their meetings, their tools and their data – and you own the outcome, not just the code.
* End to end: discovery → mapping → pipeline → validation → adoption, delivered by one accountable engineer.
* Fast and iterative: working increments in front of users early, with short feedback loops.
* Leverage: every engagement leaves something reusable behind (a framework, a template, an agent) so the next one is faster.

**Technology Ecosystem:**

* Data platform: Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Workflows, Databricks SQL), Python, PySpark, SQL, SQL Server
* Integration: RedPanda (Kafka), OpenAPI / REST APIs, Airflow, Profisee MDM, Microsoft Dynamics
* AI-assisted delivery: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks Assistant and AI/BI Genie
* Engineering: medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold), data warehousing, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins), Docker, Kubernetes
* Consumption and cloud: Power BI, React.js; Microsoft Azure

**Primary duties will include:**

* Discover and translate: run discovery sessions with business stakeholders; turn loosely defined asks into clear requirements, data contracts and acceptance criteria; play your understanding back in plain language.
* Map: produce rigorous source-to-target mappings (STTM) covering field-level lineage, transformation logic, keys, defaults, SCD handling and data quality rules, signed off by engineers and business users alike.
* Build: design and build batch and streaming pipelines on Databricks (PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow) that follow the medallion patterns of the Unified Data Platform.
* Accelerate with AI: use AI coding agents every day to profile sources, draft STTMs, and generate pipelines and tests; build reusable AI-enabled frameworks such as metadata-driven ingestion, STTM-to-code generation and automated data quality and reconciliation checks.
* Validate and land: reconcile outputs with the business, own data quality and monitoring, and drive adoption in Power BI and downstream systems.
* Operate: own production reliability for what you build (CI/CD, alerting, incident response, root-cause analysis), including cost and performance tuning on shared Databricks compute.
* Communicate: give crisp written and verbal updates to business and technology leaders, record decisions in Confluence and Jira, and reset expectations early when scope, dates or data change.
* Raise the bar: coach engineers on business engagement and AI-assisted delivery; review others' AI-generated code for correctness, security and performance.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications:**
**To land this role you will need:**

* 6–9 years of hands-on data engineering, including 3+ years building production pipelines on Spark / Databricks.
* 2+ years in a business-facing delivery role (forward-deployed, consulting, solutions or embedded analytics engineering) where you owned outcomes with non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven ability to write source-to-target mappings and dimensional / medallion data models from ambiguous requirements.
* Expert Python, PySpark and SQL; strong Delta Lake, Unity Catalog and Databricks Workflows / Lakeflow experience on Microsoft Azure.
* Recent, demonstrable use of AI coding agents to deliver production work, with the judgment to verify, test and reject what they produce.
* Excellent verbal and written communication; confident running workshops and explaining trade-offs to senior business stakeholders.
* Thrives at pace: comfortable with shifting priorities, tight deadlines and overlap with US / UK business hours when needed.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Capital markets, commodities or trade-lifecycle data experience (trades, positions, postings, balances, reference data).
* You have built a reusable framework or internal tool, ideally AI-enabled, that other engineers adopted.
* Streaming with Kafka / RedPanda, and APIs (OpenAPI / REST) as data sources.
* MDM (Profisee) and CRM (Microsoft Dynamics) data integration.
* Power BI semantic models or Databricks AI/BI (Genie) spaces that business users rely on.
* Time in a start-up, consulting firm or forward-deployed engineering team.

**Education / Certification Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional (strongly preferred) or Associate.
* Azure Data Engineer Associate or equivalent.
* Generative AI certifications (e.g., Databricks Generative AI Engineer Associate) are a plus.

**Working environment:**

* Hybrid (as per RTO policy), Bengaluru.
* Embedded with business and technology teams across the US, UK, India and Poland; regular overlap with US / UK hours.
* Travel: occasional, for discovery workshops and go-lives.

title: Head of Financial Crime Prevention Model Analytics
description:
**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
  
  
**Business Segment Overview**
**Corporate:**
Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
StoneX is seeking a
**Head of Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) Model Analytics**
to establish and lead a first-line analytical centre of excellence for Transaction Monitoring, Customer Screening and Payment Screening.
  
  
The function will provide quantitative, technical and analytical expertise to optimize financial crime detection controls and related governance. It will ensure controls remain risk-sensitive, typology-led, data-driven and operationally efficient, while working with Technology and Data teams to obtain the evidence needed to validate completeness, accuracy and integrity.
  
  
The role will work closely with Transaction Monitoring, Customer Screening, Payment Screening, Technology and Data teams to improve risk coverage, detection performance and operational efficiency, with clear FCP Model Analytics ownership of calibration activities.
  
  
The role will partner with Technology, Data, Architecture and solution vendors to support the implementation, optimization and governance of financial crime solutions, using evidence on data lineage, completeness, accuracy and coverage to provide effective financial crime risk oversight.
  
  
**Primary duties will include:**
**Model Performance, Calibration & Optimisation**

* Monitor Transaction Monitoring, Customer Screening and Payment Screening performance.
* Calibrate scenarios, rules, thresholds and matching logic.
* Use alert outcomes to improve detection performance and reduce false positives.
* Design and enhance scenarios, rules and detection logic for evolving typologies and emerging financial crime risks.
* Maintain analytical oversight of detection performance across products, legal entities, customer segments and jurisdictions.
* Own ongoing calibration and periodic recalibration of financial crime detection solutions, including Transaction Monitoring, Customer/Counterparty Screening, Payment Screening and related controls, ensuring they remain effective as typologies, volumes and risk parameters evolve.
* Partner with Technology, Data and solution vendors to support implementation, optimisation and performance monitoring of financial crime detection solutions.

**Data Quality, Integrity & Governance**

* Oversee data quality issues affecting financial crime systems.
* Validate, based on outputs provided by Technology and Data teams, the completeness, accuracy, consistency and timeliness of monitoring and screening data.
* Review data lineage, mapping logic, enrichment processes and transformations, based on documentation maintained by Technology and Data teams.
* Escalate material data quality issues affecting monitoring or screening controls.
* Develop data quality metrics, reporting and exception management for issues affecting monitoring or screening controls.
* Own the business assessment, challenge and sign-off of evidence provided by Technology and Data teams on data coverage, completeness, accuracy, timeliness and lineage, confirming that monitoring and screening data is fit for purpose and supports effective financial crime controls.

**Screening & List Governance**

* Oversee sanctions, PEP, adverse media and internal watchlist analytics.
* Oversee list onboarding, maintenance, testing, retirement and quality assurance.
* Validate list completeness, integrity and implementation accuracy using evidence from relevant system and data owners.
* Manage governance for list updates and configuration changes.
* Ensure screening configurations remain aligned to obligations, business requirements and risk appetite.
* Maintain lifecycle governance over financial crime solutions, screening lists, configurations and calibration records, including appropriate review, version control and change management.

**Analytics, Insights & Management Information**

* Produce management information on risk coverage, detection performance, control outcomes and operational efficiency.
* Provide clear insight and recommendations to management and governance forums.

**Testing, Change & Implementation**

* Design and execute analytical testing for new scenarios, rule enhancements, screening configuration changes, system upgrades and data changes, including above- and below-the-line testing where applicable.
* Define, support and evidence UAT, regression testing and implementation readiness for monitoring, screening, calibration, configuration and data-related changes.
* Work with Technology, Data and vendor teams to define business requirements, support implementation, validate solution changes and ensure controlled deployment of financial crime capabilities.

**Governance & Regulatory Readiness**

* Maintain inventories of detection models, monitoring scenarios, screening configurations, thresholds, assumptions, calibration activities and change history.
* Produce governance reporting for financial crime committees.
* Provide evidence and subject matter input to internal audit, assurance reviews and regulatory examinations.
* Maintain evidence supporting control outcomes, calibration decisions and model governance.
* Support governance and model validation for AI-enabled financial crime solutions, including use case inventory, explainability, performance monitoring, change control, appropriate human oversight and regulatory readiness.

**Typology Development & Detection Enhancement**

* Monitor emerging money laundering, sanctions and fraud typologies.
* Assess the impact of emerging typologies on existing detection controls.
* Drive appropriate use of advanced analytics, automation and AI-enabled detection techniques within defined governance standards.

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Build and lead a high-performing FCP Model Analytics function.
* Develop specialist capability across financial crime analytics, detection methodologies and optimisation.
* Establish methodologies, quality standards and operating procedures.
* Foster a culture of challenge, evidence-based decision making and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
**To land this role you will need**
:
  
  

* Significant experience in financial crime analytics.
* Strong understanding of financial crime typologies and detection methodologies.
* Strong analytical, statistical and data interpretation skills, with experience designing performance metrics, model governance and management information.
* Understanding of data quality, data governance, data lineage and AI model governance principles.
* Ability to translate complex analytical findings into practical, risk-based recommendations for senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively with second-line Financial Crime Risk and Controls teams to demonstrate control suitability, effectiveness and alignment to risk appetite.

**What makes you stand out:**

* Experience operating within wholesale, institutional, brokerage, trading, payments or capital markets environments.
* Experience supporting model validation, regulatory reviews, audit examinations or financial crime technology programs.
* Knowledge of AI, machine learning, SQL, Python, data visualization or other advanced analytics techniques.
* Experience with financial crime technology and data providers such as NICE Actimize, CGI Hotscan360, Dow Jones Risk & Compliance, LSEG World-Check and WorkFusion.
* Relevant professional qualification, degree or equivalent experience in financial crime, data analytics, risk management, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, economics or another STEM-related discipline.

**Working environment:**

* Hybrid (4 days' work from office).

title: VP- Salesforce Developer - IB Tech & CRM/ Analytics
description:
**Job Description**
**About IB Technology**
IB Tech, CRM & Analytics is a strategic, agile and cross-functional team responsible for leading the firm's global digitalization effort through innovative technology, data science and deep analytics. The team partners with all client-facing business units and corporate functions, as well as industry experts, to build transformational technology impacting investment banking, trading, sales, and research teams to drive revenue, maximize efficiency, and optimize client service.
  
  
We are at the forefront of Jefferies' cloud initiative, leveraging best-in-class cloud-based technologies to replace legacy on-premises solutions to provide intelligent trend insights, actionable opportunities, decision support, and transparency into all client and business-related activities.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As a VP, Salesforce Engineer, you will own the design and delivery of complex, end-to-end solutions on the Salesforce platform - integration orchestration, compliance-grade workflows, and custom framework extensions within a large-scale enterprise org. You operate independently: given a problem, you determine the technical approach and present architectural trade-offs. You will work within a global engineering team, coordinating across time zones, driving technical decisions, and ensuring work holds up at a scale. This role demands deep expertise, strong engineering judgment, and the ability to lead through delivery in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Hands-On Development: Design and build complex functionality using Apex, LWC, Flows, and process automation - balancing declarative and custom coding. Contribute to data model design and architecture decisions that support long-term scalability.
  
  
Integration Engineering: Develop and maintain integration using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Named Credentials, and External Objects.
  
  
Global Coordination: Collaborate daily with a distributed engineering team across multiple geographies. Communicate clearly on technical approach, dependencies, and delivery timelines. Participate actively in Agile ceremonies.
  
  
Code Quality & Platform Health:Write robust, well-tested code. Participate in peer code reviews. Develop with governor limits and org health in mind - optimized queries, bulkification, and appropriate async processing at scale.
  
  
Troubleshooting: Perform root-cause analysis and debug complex problems across Apex, LWC, and integration layers with urgency and precision.
  
  
**Mandatory Qualifications & Skills**
Custom Framework Experience: Worked within a large, heavily customized Salesforce org, config-driven UI frameworks, custom LWC component libraries, metadata-driven layouts. Experience integrating third-party JS libraries inside LWC shadow DOM.
  
  
Advanced Apex & Async Processing: Triggers, batch, Queueable chains, future methods, platform events - all at scale with governor limits in mind. Built parallel callout orchestration to multiple external systems with partial failure handling.
  
  
LWC (Beyond Basics): Component composition, custom event architecture, imperative Apex, dynamic rendering, cross-component state management. Strong JS/HTML/CSS - can take a custom design and build it accurately in Lightning.
  
  
Multi-Pattern Integration: REST APIs, SOAP, Named Credentials, file ingestion, legacy adapters. Understands retry logic and contract-first design.
  
  
Data Modelling for Scale & Compliance: Complex parent-child hierarchies, Custom Metadata as config (not just settings), JSON serialization for data capture, SOQL optimized for volume. Have built systems where data correctness has regulatory consequences.
  
  
Engineering Fundamentals: Git workflows (branching, PRs, conflict resolution), IDE + SF CLI, SOLID principles, Agile with distributed teams. Communicates technical decisions clearly across time zones.
  
  
Good to have: working knowledge of TypeScript; experience with test automation; familiarity with AWS services (Lambda, S3, API Gateway); Financial Services exposure.

Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.

 

We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.

 

**About the role**

This is an end-to-end ownership role. The
**Senior Business Analyst**
(BSA) is accountable for the business-facing thread of an automation or AI initiative from first stakeholder conversation to post-production stabilisation. You will run process discovery and feasibility assessment, define and baseline requirements, partner with architects and developers through build, own functional and user acceptance testing, support go-live and hypercare, and hand over a fully documented, measurable solution to the client and support teams. You are expected to operate independently on complex processes, mentor junior analysts, and be the person the client trusts to tell them what is genuinely automatable and what is not.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* Lead structured discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, job shadowing and process walkthroughs with business SMEs to capture the true operating process, including exceptions, workarounds and undocumented tribal knowledge.

* Perform automation feasibility and complexity assessment; qualify or disqualify candidate processes against standardisation, rule-clarity, volume, stability and data-quality criteria, and have the confidence to recommend against automation where the business case does not hold.

* Build the business case: quantify AS-IS effort, volumes, FTE cost, error rates and cycle times; model expected benefit, ROI, payback period and effort estimate, and present it to client sponsors for funding approval.

* Capture process metrics and prepare the Process Qualification / Assessment output, including pipeline prioritisation where multiple candidates compete for the same delivery capacity.

* Use Process Mining and Task Mining outputs where available to validate stated process behaviour against actual system event data, rather than relying solely on stakeholder recall.

* Conduct deep-dive "As-Is" analysis to design optimized "To-Be" states, ensuring processes are not just automated, but architected for peak efficiency.

* Author comprehensive Process Design Documents (PDDs) and partner on Solution Designs (SDDs) to ensure absolute logic clarity and traceability.

* Produce end-to-end process maps and flow diagrams (BPMN / Visio / Lucid), covering the happy path, every business exception, every system exception and the defined handling for each.

* Define and baseline detailed functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, input/output specifications and in-scope / out-of-scope boundaries; drive formal sign-off from the process owner before build begins.

* Own the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) so that every requirement is traceable through design, build, test case and production release.

* Identify and document the AS-IS to TO-BE process re-engineering opportunities, eliminating waste before automating rather than automating an inefficient process as-is.

* Contribute to pre-sales and solutioning activity - discovery for prospects, effort estimation and proposal input - where the account requires it.

 

**Deliverables Owned by This Role**

 

* Process Assessment / Qualification Document and automation business case with ROI model.

* As-Is and To-Be process maps and detailed process flow diagrams.

* Process Definition Document (PDD) and contribution to the Solution Design Document (SDD).

* Functional and non-functional requirements specification with acceptance criteria and business rules.

* Test strategy, test scenarios, test cases, UAT pack and signed UAT closure report.

* Exception handling and business continuity procedure.

* End-user training material, SOPs and user guides.

* Support runbook, escalation matrix and knowledge-transfer pack for handover.

* Post-implementation benefit realisation report.

 

**Must Have Qualifications:**

 

* 5+ years of Business Analysis experience with a dedicated focus on
  **Intelligent Automation, RPA (e.g., UiPath)**
  , or AI-driven application engineering, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead analyst capacity.

* Proven understanding of modern AI architectures, with the ability to design workflows that incorporate LLMs, API integrations, and unstructured data processing.

* Demonstrable expertise in authoring rigorous PDDs and collaborating on SDDs with strict traceability.

* Strong track record operating within Agile frameworks, serving as the definitive translation layer between executive business stakeholders and technical engineering pods.

* Migration Fluency: Specific exposure to UiPath and/or Blue Prism.

* Demonstrated end-to-end SDLC ownership: evidence of personally carrying at least three automation or AI initiatives from discovery through production deployment and hypercare, not only the documentation phase.

 

**Strong Plus:**

 

* UiPath Certified Professional Business Analyst (UiBPA).

* Domain depth in Banking and Financial Services, particularly regulated processes with audit and control requirements.

**What We Offer**

 

* **A truly international environment,**

  collaborating on global automation projects.

* **The opportunity to experiment and innovate**

  with Agentic 
  **AI solutions**

  as we pioneer and rebrand our offering in the consultancy space

* Work at the 
  **core of the automation and AI wave**

   — we’re a 
  **pure-play automation company**

   fully focused on innovation and future-ready solutions.
* A 
  **growth-focused environment**

   where you’re empowered to 
  **develop**

  , 
  **excel**

  , and 
  **contribute meaningfully**

   — no corporate silos, no red tape.
* This is 
  **not your standard corporate job**

   — we value initiative over hierarchy, and you’ll have room to make a real impact from day one.
* A 
  **vibrant team culture**

  , collaborative spirit and culture you can’t experience anywhere else!

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Specialist Business Analyst, Actimize
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
**So, what’s the role all about?**
As a SME in the Actimize Watch Group, they will play a crucial role in analyzing data, identifying suspicious patterns, performing tuning for transaction monitoring systems, providing recommendations on segmentation and predictive scoring to Actimize customers. They should have in depth knowledge about various financial payment systems, FATF and AML /FINCEN laws. They should also have experience using Actimize AML products. Knowledge or experience working as a AML analyst or investigator is a plus. They should have strong presentation, problem solving and communication skills. They should also be able to work well alone and as part of a team.
  
  
**How will you make an impact?**

* Provide consultation on the AML services / strategies for newly onboarded Actimize Customers
* Provide ongoing consultation on AML services provided including using Actimize solutions [for e.g. SAM & WLX or ACTONE], machine learning models, recommendations on new features, etc.
* Collect and analyze financial data for potential AML, initial triage of missed alerts for Actimize clients,
* Perform tuning on transaction monitoring system to reduce false positives and improve quality of alerts.
* Prepare reports and periodic AML analytics presentations on AML trends and actionable insights for Actimize customers.
* Engage with clients, stakeholders, and internal teams to gather insights, identify problems , provide solutions, and manage expectations.
* Initiate and lead key strategic initiatives.
* Translate business needs into technical requirements for data science and machine learning initiatives.
* Coach and mentor peer analytics team members on best analytic practices

**Have you got what it takes?**

* 8+ years of experience in financial services industry, financial crime prevention, transaction monitoring, sanctions screen etc. Experience in financial domain is a plus.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, Information Technology, or related field. Certifications in business analytics or financial crime prevention [ CAMS, CFE or related] are plus.
* Experience working with Actimize solutions such as SAM, WLF is necessary.
* Proficiency in presentation tools such as Microsoft PowerPoint and similar technologies.
* Basic knowledge of machine learning algorithms, understand model performances, model governance etc.
* Proficiency with SQL, Python, R and/or other data analysis framework
* Excellent verbal, written, interpersonal communication skills for effective stakeholder management and collaboration.
* Creative problem-solving skills , strategic thinking, and good analytical skills.
* Efficient time management, ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to use AI to improve day to day performance.

**What’s in it for you?**
Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!
  
  
**Enjoy NiCE-FLEX!**
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.
  
  
**Requisition Details**

* Req ID: 11734
* Reporting to: Group Manager
* Role Type: Individual Contributor

**About NiCE**
*NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.*
*Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.*
*NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.*

title: Data Analyst, Associate 2
description:
**What Are We Looking For**
State Street Global Delivery Data Operations team is seeking a versatile individual in an Associate 2 role with strong data analysis, technical skills, and business analysis skills to support services and offerings across Global Delivery, primarily in Custody and Accounting. This qualified individual will provide data and business solutions and will collaborate with technology and product partners. This associate will be expected to build relationships and collaborate with both business stakeholders and technology partnerships in order to contribute to the timely execution of long-term strategic plans for building out sophisticated data solutions.
  
  
**Why This Job Is Important To Us**
State Street Data Operations brings together data capabilities across the investment lifecycle to help our clients make better decisions, grow at scale, and deliver returns for their clients. The successful candidate must be skilled in analyzing our complex business service flows across front, middle, and back office operating models, with a focus on data management. They will also be driving the strategic solution design, business architecture, and business solutions/services while driving program/project execution and reporting.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Establish strong partnerships with internal stakeholders in Operations and Technology teams to influence and coordinate cross-functional business data solutions and products, in support of client and business goals.
* Possess strong knowledge of front-to-back Investment management/Investment services with focus on user data requirements.
* Conduct reconciliations, data quality monitoring, and data delivery in a timely manner.
* Research and document data exceptions with appropriate client-focused communication
* Work with business and technology partners to establish clear connections between business goals, strategies, and the data output
* Communicates recommendations to management/senior business leaders through effective written and oral communication.

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Strong Technical skills with a background in Accounting, Custody, and/or Performance.
* Strategic thinker with strong business analysis and planning skills.
* Documentation of data and business process flows and defining the business problem, solution, and design using various tools.
* Proven experience with business requirements analysis to meet critical business needs, must display an ability to drive tasks through to completion.
* Excellent time management and organization skills, with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities.
* Ability to think creatively and strategically with a focus on achieving outcomes.
* Understanding of data strategy including data lineage, quality, governance and analysis.
* Proven related financial services experience. Good understanding of State Street businesses, specifically in Custody and Accounting.
* Demonstrate understanding of Data Operations processes and procedures and an ability to learn quickly.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, facilitation, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Proficiency with MS Office Products; MS Access, Visio; Jira, Confluence, PowerPoint.

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, MIS, Information Technology, or a related field of study.
* Data Analysis technical skills including SQL, Data Visualization tools, Power BI, etc.
* 2+ years of experience in Data analysis, Operations, or Product management.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. **Technical Documentation & Change Control:**

Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation including solution design notes, process logic, code commenting, SOPs, testing evidence, version histories, and user guidance to ensure sustainable ownership and supportability.

**Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement:**

* Troubleshoot defects, resolve production issues, support enhancement requests

* Contribute to improving development standards, documentation quality, and reusability of automation components.

* Hands-on experience in workflow automation tools such as Power Automate, FloQast, and Power Apps.

* Strong structured problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues logically and design practical technical solutions.

* Strong communication skills with the ability to work directly with Finance operations end-users to gather requirements, explain solutions, and support adoption.
* Strong documentation discipline and a high standard for supportability, clarity, and technical quality.
* Self-starter with a hands-on engineering mindset and the ability to independently manage technical deliverables in a fast-paced environment.
* Adaptable, dependable, and comfortable balancing delivery speed with control and quality.
