We think this is a great start to our exciting journey.

Come, join us, help us transform the world, mobility, and have a blast while doing it! Think you are the right fit? Feel free to apply!

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Executive – ORM will be responsible for managing the brand’s online reputation, handling customer escalations across digital platforms, and driving organic growth in brand visibility and positive customer sentiment. The role will focus on proactive reputation monitoring, effective escalation management, and identifying opportunities to strengthen the brand’s digital presence through authentic customer engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Online Reputation & Escalation Management**

* Monitor customer feedback, complaints, reviews, and brand mentions across social media, online review platforms, forums, and other digital channels.
* Take ownership of escalated customer issues and coordinate with internal teams for timely resolution.
* Draft professional, empathetic, and brand-aligned responses to customer feedback and complaints.
* Identify recurring customer concerns and work with relevant stakeholders to implement corrective actions.
* Ensure adherence to response timelines, escalation matrices, and service-level agreements (SLAs).

**2. Organic Online Reputation Growth**

* Work with internal teams to address customer pain points and improve overall online sentiment.
* Monitor brand mentions, customer discussions, reviews, and sentiment trends to identify reputation-building opportunities.
* Ensure all reputation-building activities remain authentic, transparent, and compliant with platform guidelines.

**3. Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports covering escalations, response TAT, resolution status, customer sentiment, and brand reputation trends.
* Track key performance indicators such as response time, resolution time, sentiment, review ratings, and recurring complaint categories.
* Analyse customer feedback to identify improvement areas and recommend corrective measures.
* Share actionable insights with management and relevant teams to improve customer experience.

**4. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Work closely with Customer Service, Marketing, Product, Sales, and Service teams to resolve customer escalations.
* Ensure timely follow-ups and closure of high-priority issues.
* Maintain escalation trackers and ensure clear ownership and accountability for pending cases.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 2–5 years of experience in ORM, digital customer experience, online reputation management, or customer escalation management.
* Hands-on experience managing customer complaints and reviews across digital platforms.
* Understanding of social media monitoring, online sentiment analysis, and organic brand reputation growth.
* Excellent written communication, response drafting, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and reporting dashboards.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders.
* A proactive, customer-centric approach with strong attention to detail.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* ORM response and resolution TAT.
* SLA adherence and escalation closure rate.
* Improvement in online customer sentiment and brand reputation.
* Organic growth in authentic positive customer engagement and brand advocacy.
* Reduction in unresolved and repeat customer complaints.
* Accuracy and timeliness of reporting.

title: Senior Consultant – Oracle Fusion Payroll
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a Senior Oracle Fusion Payroll Consultant with strong functional expertise in payroll concepts, Oracle Fusion Payroll implementation, configuration, and troubleshooting. The role involves delivering end-to-end payroll implementations, enhancements, testing, and production support for clients in the United Arab Emirates (UAE).

The consultant will work offshore in close collaboration with onsite teams to configure payroll solutions, develop and debug Fast Formulas, execute parallel payroll runs, resolve complex payroll issues, and ensure accurate payroll processing and successful go-live.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Payroll Configuration:**
  Configure payroll definitions, elements, eligibility rules, balances, payment methods, costing, and General Ledger (GL) transfer.
* **Payroll Concepts:**
  Apply a strong understanding of gross-to-net calculations, earnings and deductions, retroactive processing, proration, arrears, balances and dimensions, costing, and payroll period close.
* **Fast Formula Development:**
  Develop, modify, test, and troubleshoot payroll Fast Formulas to support complex payroll calculations and business requirements.
* **Implementation:**
  Lead and execute end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, including requirements analysis, configuration, testing, data migration, go-live, and hypercare.
* **Testing and Parallel Runs:**
  Prepare test scenarios, conduct system integration testing (SIT), execute parallel payroll cycles, and reconcile results against legacy payroll systems.
* **Troubleshooting and Support:**
  Diagnose failed payroll flows, incorrect calculations, retroactive processing issues, balance discrepancies, and costing errors using logs, element entries, and balance views.
* **Data Migration:**
  Perform payroll balance and element entry migrations using HCM Data Loader (HDL), validate migrated data, and support payroll readiness for go-live.
* **UAE Payroll Localization:**
  Support UAE payroll requirements, including Wage Protection System (WPS), applicable pension and social security rules, gratuity, and leave salary calculations, as relevant to client requirements.
* **Enhancements and Updates:**
  Implement payroll policy changes, assess quarterly Oracle updates, conduct regression testing, and maintain existing payroll configurations.
* **Reporting:**
  Develop and maintain payroll and costing reports to support payroll validation, reconciliation, and business reporting.
* **Oracle Support:**
  Raise, manage, and follow up on Oracle service requests to resolve product-related issues.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
  Work closely with onsite leads, HR, Finance, technical teams, and client stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver payroll solutions.
* **Documentation:**
  Maintain functional specifications, configuration documents, test scripts, reconciliation reports, and implementation documentation.

**Role Requirements and Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience in Oracle Payroll, including at least 4 years of hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Payroll.
* Minimum of 2 end-to-end Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations, covering configuration, parallel runs, and go-live.
* Strong understanding of payroll concepts, gross-to-net calculations, earnings, deductions, balances, retroactive processing, proration, arrears, and costing.
* Strong hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Payroll configuration and payroll processing.
* Proficiency in developing, debugging, and troubleshooting Oracle Payroll Fast Formulas.
* Experience with payroll testing, parallel runs, payroll reconciliation, data migration, and production support.
* Hands-on experience with HCM Data Loader (HDL) for payroll balance and element entry migration.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across payroll flows, calculation errors, balance discrepancies, and costing issues.
* Ability to work independently with onsite teams and manage implementation activities effectively.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document and explain technical and functional issues clearly in English.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with UAE and Gulf payroll localization, including Wage Protection System (WPS), General Pension and Social Security Authority (GPSSA) requirements, gratuity, and leave salary.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Absence Management and Time and Labor.
* Previous experience with Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) Payroll.
* Experience developing payroll and costing reports using Oracle BI Publisher.
* Familiarity with Oracle Fusion quarterly updates, regression testing, and Oracle Support service requests.
* Oracle Fusion Global Payroll certification is preferred.

**Why Join Us:**

* Opportunity to work on Oracle Fusion Payroll implementations and enhancements for clients in the UAE.
* Exposure to enterprise payroll transformation and complex functional requirements.
* Collaborative working environment with onsite and offshore implementation teams.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, technical development, and career growth.
* A culture that encourages ownership, problem-solving, and professional development.

title: Senior Specialist, Provider Data Operations (US Healthcare Insurance)
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
As an Insurance Senior Specialist, you will serve as the subject matter expert for Zocdoc's insurance taxonomy and related systems. You will own the policies, processes, and quality standards that ensure our insurance data is accurate, scalable, and aligned with product strategy. This role combines deep expertise in the U.S. health insurance landscape with strong analytical thinking to improve the patient search experience and strengthen the integrity of our insurance database.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to define insurance policies, monitor database health, and drive continuous improvements. Your work will directly influence how patients find in-network care by ensuring that our insurance taxonomies, carrier and plan coverage, and provider matching systems remain accurate, scalable, and responsive to changes in the healthcare market.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of a Product Operations Specialist:**

* Define Insurance Policies & Standards: Own the policies governing insurance carriers and plans across the Zocdoc marketplace. Define and maintain rules for adding, modifying, and removing insurance carriers and plans, as well as thresholds for performance-based retention or removal.
* Monitor Insurance Market Trends: Stay informed about developments in the U.S. health insurance landscape, including new carrier launches, plan introductions, mergers, and regulatory changes. Evaluate their impact on Zocdoc's insurance database and recommend proactive updates.
* Drive Cross-functional Strategy: Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data & Analytics teams to ensure insurance taxonomies support product strategy and accurate patient search experiences. Translate complex insurance policies into clear product requirements, data models, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Advise senior Product and Engineering leaders on recommendations and tradeoffs, influence roadmap priorities, and shape taxonomy architecture, validation logic, tooling, and system controls. Define reporting and monitor performance, while leading incident reviews and escalations involving inaccurate insurance availability or provider matching to identify root causes and mitigate future risk.
* Own Insurance Database Health: Define, monitor, and report on key insurance database health metrics. Conduct regular reviews with Product, Operations, and Data partners to identify trends, prioritize improvements, and maintain high data quality.
* Improve Processes & Quality: Identify systemic issues affecting insurance data quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives. Refine policies and operational processes to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and increase accuracy across workflows.
* Perform Quality Assurance & Expert Reviews: Act as the organization's expert on U.S. health insurance, review and validate outputs from operational teams for new insurance plan additions and complex taxonomy decisions. Serve as the final escalation point for policy interpretation and insurance-related quality questions.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* 5+ years of experience in the U.S. healthcare industry, with deep expertise in Insurance Payor Management, Payor Analytics, Database
* Management or related functions at payor or plan level.
* Strong understanding of U.S. commercial insurance plans, carriers, provider networks.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience using metrics and data to drive strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product, Operations, Analytics, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.
* Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to balance strategic thinking and operational execution.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to influence stakeholders across functions.
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Looker or other analytical tools is a must.
* Familiarity and proven usage of AI-driven tools and workflow automation is a must.

**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026

**About Us**
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
  
  
Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values -
*Together, Not Alone*
, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

**Job Description**
**THE POSITION**
**:**

plays a crucial role in pharmacovigilance, particularly in the context of the Argus Safety System. The responsibilities of an Argus administrator, as outlined, involve various aspects of configuration, data management, automation, and collaboration with case processing teams.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze business requirements and implement Argus configurations aligned with regulatory standards and industry best practices.
* Design, develop, and enhance Argus workflows, business rules, and automation solutions to improve operational efficiency.

* Collaborate with business, safety, and technical teams to define migration requirements and source-to-target mapping specifications.

* Ensure system configurations, migrated data, and business processes comply with global pharmacovigilance regulations, including FDA, EMA, and other applicable requirements.
* Support validation documentation and compliance activities for audits, inspections, system upgrades, and regulatory reviews.
* Collaborate with Oracle Support and internal stakeholders for incident management, patch deployments, and system enhancements.
* Provide end-user support, training, and documentation to promote effective system utilization and knowledge sharing.
* Monitor regulatory updates, Argus product enhancements, and industry trends to recommend continuous process and system improvements.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

*Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.*
**Qualifications**
The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
  
  

* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, and IT teams to gather migration and reporting requirements.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mapping documents, data migration specifications, and reconciliation reports.
* Execute data extraction, transformation, cleansing, and validation activities to ensure data quality and integrity throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Perform SQL-based data analysis, data validation, reconciliation, and issue investigation to support migration and reporting activities.
* Identify, analyze, and resolve data discrepancies, mapping issues, and migration defects.
* Support migration testing activities, including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and post-migration validation.
* Conduct data reconciliation between source and target systems to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance of migrated data.
* Design, develop, customize, and maintain Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) reports, line listings, and regulatory outputs based on business requirements.
* Create and optimize complex data models, templates, and report layouts within Oracle BI Publisher.
* Support generation and validation of operational, regulatory, and management reports using BIP and database queries.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and scripts to support reporting, migration, and data analysis requirements.
* Collaborate with technical teams to support integrations, data interfaces, and reporting solutions across pharmacovigilance systems.
* Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and migration projects, ensuring reporting and data validation requirements are met.
* Prepare and maintain migration documentation, validation evidence, test scripts, SOPs, and technical specifications.
* Ensure migrated data and reporting processes comply with pharmacovigilance regulations and organizational data governance standards.
* Provide end-user support and training related to migration deliverables, reporting solutions, and BI Publisher reports.
* Monitor reporting performance and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.
* Stay current with Oracle BI Publisher enhancements, data migration best practices, and emerging pharmacovigilance technologies.
* PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
* Bachelor’s degree/Masters Degree in IT Stream
* 3+ years of relevant experience in drug safety IT Systems

**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. title: Process and Data Officer
description:
**Description**
***Join Envalior – Imagine The Future!***
Are you passionate about pioneering change in a constantly evolving environment? At Envalior, we are seeking a talented Process and Data Officer to join our dynamic Supply Chain team.
  
  
At Envalior, the future of high-performance materials isn't just being shaped; it's being pioneered. A belief in fostering an environment where every voice is heard and ideas are valued is integral to our culture. Empowerment is the driving force behind our pioneering spirit, allowing our teams to take initiative, explore new solutions, and revel in the thrill of constant innovation.
  
  
Join us and be a part of a team committed to making a positive impact—where safety, sustainability, collaboration, and empowerment intersect to drive innovation.
  
  
**Requirements**
Purpose of the position
  
  
The Process & Data Officer serves as a subject matter expert for master data across multiple business processes. The role ensures high-quality master and configuration data and supports agile, accurate processing of master data requests. The job holder must possess solid knowledge of key business processes (PtP, OtC, SCM) to provide the right data foundation for efficient and compliant process execution.
  
  
**The Key Areas Of Accountability/responsibility**
Governance (approx. 10%)
  
  

* Validate whether correct and complete master data requests have been submitted.
* Assess whether email-based requests can be executed directly or require workflow routing.
* Identify and clean up non-used master data elements; align conditions and decisions with relevant stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement (approx. 15%)
  
  

* Simplify complex processes, automate routine activities, and proactively eliminate redundancies.
* Identify repetitive business activities and transfer them into automated tasks using available tooling (e.g., RPA).

Reporting (approx. 15%)
  
  

* Monitor and report data quality based on business rules describing logical relationships across data fields.
* Develop detailed reports to support clean-up actions beyond high-level KPIs.
* Provide ad hoc reporting to support projects, issue resolution, and fact-based decision making.

Project Support (approx. 20%)
  
  

* Contribute to project activities; master data is critical to all process and system implementations.
* Support data preparation, data mapping, and validation activities.
* Play an active role during UAT and be a key contributor during cutover planning and execution.

Operational Support (approx. 40%)
  
  

* Support SAP users in understanding and applying master data correctly.
* Assist in troubleshooting by identifying root causes, even when issues are not directly data-related.
* Interpret incoming requests and determine which master data objects require updates (vendors, customers, materials, contracts, info records, source lists, etc.).
* Choose the most effective data entry method (manual entry vs. upload tools).
* Maintain shipment routes across multiple regions.
* Maintain approval tables (SAP/SRM) and the department’s SharePoint environment.
* Maintain the PANDA master data workflow application (users, roles, tasks, workflows).
* Ensure timely responses to all support questions submitted through the central mailbox.

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE**
Core Competencies
  
  

* Analytical & Conceptual Thinking
* Stakeholder Management & Influence
* Process Discipline & Quality Orientation
* Problem-Solving & Troubleshooting Mindset
* Ownership & Accountability
* Continuous Improvement Attitude
* Communication & Service Orientation

Technical Skills
  
  

* SAP Master Data Expertise
* Data Quality & Reporting Tools
* Workflow & Process Tools
* Basic Automation or Scripting Knowledge (advantage)
* Documentation Skills.

**Additional Requirements**

* Strong command of English (written and verbal); additional languages are an asset.
* Ability to work effectively in a global environment across multiple time zones.
* High level of organization and ability to manage high request volumes (6,000+ emails, 10,000+ workflows annually).
* Ability to balance standardization with practical support in a non-harmonized business environment.

**Benefits**
**WHY ENVALIOR?**
**Competitive Compensation**
Join us at Envalior and enjoy competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and individual performance bonuses, ensuring your hard work is recognized and rewarded.
  
  
**Comprehensive Benefits**
Your well-being matters to us. At Envalior, we provide an array of benefits supporting your financial security, health, and overall well-being. This includes retirement plans, health programs, life insurance, and comprehensive medical care.
  
  
**Work-Life Balance & Flexibility**
Maintain a healthy balance between work and personal life with Envalior's commitment to supporting your schedule.
  
  
**Training & Development Opportunities**
At Envalior, your growth matters. We encourage and invest in your professional and personal development. We support our employees in their growth and personal development through ongoing investment in their knowledge and skills via training, coaching, and mentoring.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
At Envalior, our people drive our success, so it’s only right that we provide a diverse and inclusive working environment and foster a culture of belonging, openness, and respect. We value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We are committed to nurturing and empowering every individual to reach their full potential.
  
  
**APPLY NOW!**
Ready to pioneer change with Envalior? Join us in our mission to drive innovation, sustainability, and excellence. Apply today and become a part of our transformative journey towards a more sustainable future.
  
  
Submit your application online by sending your CV and motivation letter in English through our career portal. If you have any questions, feel free to connect directly with our recruiter at Deepanshu.Tripathi@envalior.com
  
  
*Envalior is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*
If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at Talent.Acquisition@Envalior.com.
  
  
**OUR HERITAGE**
With a combined heritage of over 100 years, Envalior brings together two established global materials players: DSM Engineering Materials and LANXESS High Performance Materials. Our unique combined portfolio of longstanding material-, application-, and design expertise enables our customers to develop and launch sustainable future-proof designs. Envalior is the brand new materials powerhouse that was Launched in early 2023.
  
  
We aim to be a global leader in sustainable and high-performance engineering materials. We imagine the future by shaping the world of today and tomorrow. We’re conscious that this is both a privilege and a responsibility – so, when we imagine the future, we’re guided by our key values to help us create a better world.

title: Lead, Data Validation Specialist
description:

Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. **The Role**

You’ll manage daily workflows, ensure consistent data quality across projects, and serve as the primary liaison between the Data Validations team and cross-functional partners.
  
  
This is primarily a non-client-facing role that plays a key part behind the scenes, requiring focus, consistency, and comfort with repetitive work. It’s a great fit for someone who enjoys working with data in a structured way and takes pride in getting the details right.
  
  
You’ll be instrumental in fostering a collaborative team culture, driving consistency in our data conversions, and contributing to the growth of both your team and our global function.

* Foster a team culture that values collaboration, learning, and a shared commitment to client success

**Who You Are**

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: Supplier Due Diligence Analyst (ESG) & Cyber Security
description:
Job Title
  
  
Supplier Due Diligence Analyst (ESG) & Cyber Security
  
  
**Job Description**
**Supplier Due Diligence Analyst (ESG) & Cyber Security | Pune | Full-time**
Vanderlande is seeking a proactive and analytical Supplier Risk & Due Diligence Analyst (ESG & Cyber Security) to support the global Supplier Sustainability & Risk function within Procurement.
  
  
As part of Vanderlande’s global procurement organization, you will play a key role in assessing supplier risks and ensuring our supply base operates in line with sustainability, compliance, and cyber security expectations. You will contribute to a resilient, responsible, and future-proof supplier ecosystem by supporting supplier due diligence, ESG assessments, third-party cyber security reviews, and ongoing supplier risk monitoring.
  
  
Our global procurement organization enables projects and business functions by maximizing value and minimizing risks through the procurement of goods and services in a smart, cost-effective, sustainable, and secure way.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Supplier Risk & Due Diligence Analyst, you will support supplier qualification, onboarding, monitoring, reassessment, and remediation activities across multiple risk dimensions. You will work closely with Procurement, Sustainability, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, business stakeholders, and suppliers to evaluate and manage supplier-related risks throughout the supplier lifecycle and support risk management activities embedded within Vanderlande's Source-to-Pay (S2P) processes.
  
  
A key part of the role will be supporting the adoption and operational use of supplier risk and cyber security monitoring tools, including BitSight or other approved risk intelligence platforms, to assess third-party cyber exposure, identify risk indicators, and support timely follow-up actions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support execution of supplier due diligence activities as part of supplier onboarding, qualification, periodic reassessment, and ongoing monitoring processes.
* Conduct supplier risk assessments across ESG, cyber security, information security, financial stability, compliance, geopolitical, operational, and business continuity risk dimensions.
* Review supplier information, responses, supporting documentation, certifications, policies, and evidence to validate due diligence outcomes and identify potential risk indicators and information gaps.
* Review supplier cyber security documentation, including security questionnaires, ISO 27001 certifications, NIS2, SOC reports, data privacy indicators, business continuity documentation, and third-party cyber risk ratings.
* Support the implementation and operational use of BitSight or similar approved cyber risk intelligence platforms, including supplier monitoring, cyber risk score analysis, follow-up of identified risk indicators, and reporting to relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor supplier risk intelligence sources and identify emerging risks requiring escalation, mitigation, reassessment, or stakeholder review.
* Analyze supplier risk data and prepare clear insights, dashboards, reports, and management updates for procurement and governance forums.
* Review supplier documentation and due diligence evidence against established responsible sourcing, sustainability, compliance, and governance requirements, highlighting potential concerns and coordinating follow-up with relevant stakeholders
* Coordinate remediation activities with suppliers and internal stakeholders, ensuring actions are tracked, documented, and followed up within agreed timelines.
* Maintain accurate supplier risk records, assessment outcomes, documentation, dashboards, and reporting within approved systems and tools.
* Collaborate with Procurement, Sustainability, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, IT, and business teams to ensure an integrated supplier risk management approach.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of supplier due diligence, ESG, risk, and cyber security assessment processes, templates, tools, and governance routines.
* Ensure all activities are executed in compliance with company policies, governance standards, confidentiality requirements, and regulatory expectations.

**What You Bring**
To succeed in this role, you bring a strong combination of analytical thinking, operational discipline, stakeholder collaboration, and risk awareness. You are comfortable working in a dynamic global environment and can translate supplier risk data into clear, actionable insights.
  
  
You should bring
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business Administration, Sustainability, Risk Management, Information Security, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 5–8 years of experience in supplier risk management, due diligence, procurement, sustainability, compliance, cyber security, audit, or a related field.
* Good understanding of supplier lifecycle management, third-party risk management, supplier onboarding, and supplier reassessment processes.
* Knowledge of ESG frameworks, responsible sourcing practices, sustainability regulations, and supply chain due diligence expectations.
* Understanding of cyber security and information security concepts, including third-party cyber risk, information security controls, ISO 27001, NIS2, SOC reports, data privacy, GDPR, business continuity, and disaster recovery.
* Experience with supplier risk, due diligence, compliance, ESG, or cyber risk monitoring platforms. Experience with BitSight or similar cyber risk intelligence platforms is preferred.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and other data analysis or reporting tools.
* Ability to assess supplier documentation, identify gaps, and translate findings into clear risk summaries and follow-up actions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across procurement, suppliers, technical teams, and global stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
* Curiosity, continuous learning mindset, and willingness to adapt to evolving regulations, risk landscapes, and digital tools.
* Business fluency in English.

**About Vanderlande**
Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors.
  
  
At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.
  
  
**Website**
www.vanderlande.com
  
  
**What We Offer**
Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice
  
  

* Competitive Salary Package
* 30 days of annual leave (pro-rated from the start of the financial year), including
* 22 paid leave days
* sick/casual leave days
* Applicable government holidays
* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work-life balance.
* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs to enhance your skills.
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage.
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally.

**How We Work**
We work by three values Every day better, we care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.
  
  
**Ready to apply?**
Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.
  
  
**Diversity & inclusion**
Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Manager, Data Operations
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Manager, IBOR Operations, based in Pune, to lead the team responsible for the accuracy and timeliness of Addepar's Investment Book of Record (IBOR) — spanning Corporate Actions, Investment Accounting, Investable/Safe Cash, and Performance & Valuation. This role owns the operational integrity of positions, transactions, and reconciliations across custodial, aggregator, and trading data feeds, and acts as the senior escalation point for complex data and reconciliation issues. Reporting into Data Operations leadership, this person will manage a team made up of a Lead and Analysts, partner closely with Product and Engineering to evolve IBOR tooling, and represent Data Operations to senior stakeholders across the business.
  
  
Do you enjoy the ability to work and build your career in an exciting, fast-growing environment? If so, you’ll fit in with our open and inclusive culture that is disrupting the wealth management and financial services industry.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the operational integrity of Addepar's IBOR — positions, transactions, corporate actions, tax lot accuracy, trade static data, trade enrichment, and market claims — across custodial, aggregator, and trading data feeds
* Lead and develop a team comprising a Data Operations Lead and Analysts, setting priorities, quality standards, and performance expectations
* Establish and maintain process controls and metrics that track reconciliation break resolution, data quality, and SLA performance across the IBOR function
* Serve as the senior escalation point for complex trade lifecycle, corporate actions, reconciliation, and trade fail issues that affect IBOR accuracy, partnering with clients and custodial/data providers to drive resolution
* Partner with Product and Engineering to define requirements and prioritize tooling that improves IBOR data quality, automates reconciliation, and scales operations
* Drive cross-functional initiatives with other Operations, Product, and Engineering leaders on data strategy and new platform capabilities
* Own hiring, onboarding, mentorship, and career development for the Lead and analysts within the team

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or equivalent experience
* 9+ years of experience in investment/portfolio operations, middle office, custody, or trading operations, with direct exposure to IBOR, OMS/EMS, or custody data feeds
* Background in asset management or the sell side of custody/fund administration, with solid grounding in capital markets fundamentals
* Strong working knowledge of corporate actions processing, position/cash/trade reconciliation, and tax lot accounting, including tax lot relief methods and tax-loss harvesting mechanics
* Understanding of the trade lifecycle and trading process end-to-end; a trading qualification (e.g. Series 7/63 or equivalent) is a plus
* Comfortable with SQL and Python for data analysis, break investigation, and process automation; familiarity with database management a plus
* Familiarity with IBOR or portfolio accounting platforms (e.g. SimCorp, Eagle, Aladdin, Charles River) is a plus
* Proven experience managing and developing a team directly, including through a Lead, with a track record of coaching individuals to grow in their roles
* Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to represent Data Operations to senior internal and external audiences
* Excellent judgment under pressure, with a track record of driving process improvement in a high-throughput, deadline-driven environment
* Strong communication skills, able to convey complex ideas clearly across cultural and functional boundaries
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and clients is mandatory

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy & Transactions - Mergers & Acquisition – I&D MO – Senior Consultant**
Join our team of Strategy & Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

We guide M&A initiatives for companies to help expand and accelerate revenue and cost synergies, reduce transaction risk, and retain key talent, even as they make structural changes to their business, operating model, or capital model. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

* Consulting Background
* M&A advisory experience

MBA is mandatory

Bengaluru/ Hyderabad/Pune

title: Sr. Martech Enterprise System Engineer
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
Avalara's Marketing Technology team is scaling its execution capabilities and expanding its AI capabilities to keep pace with a growing go-to-market engine. The systems that power campaign execution, lead lifecycle management, and marketing operations, Workfront, Marketo, and our leads pipeline, require strong, hands-on technical talent to build, maintain, and continuously improve them.
  
  
This IC4 MarTech Engineer role is for a strong technical leader who can transition marketing capabilities from a digital marketing paradigm to an agentic marketing approach by integrating, automating, and configuring new agentic models and solutions across our enterprise capabilities, building reliable integrations, automating marketing workflows, and ensuring lead data flows accurately from capture to CRM handoff.
  
  
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Build and maintain integrations between Marketo, Salesforce CRM, Workfront, and adjacent MarTech systems, delivering reliable, well-documented solutions.
* Engineer and optimize the lead lifecycle from capture and enrichment through scoring, routing, and CRM handoff, reducing lead leakage and improving data accuracy across the pipeline.
* Develop and maintain automation for campaign operations, asset management workflows in Workfront, and lead management processes in Marketo, replacing manual effort with reliable, auditable automation.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions by working closely with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, and Sales Operations to understand needs and deliver working solutions on time.
* Troubleshoot and resolve platform issues across Workfront, Marketo, and the leads pipeline, performing root cause analysis and implementing fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Write clean, maintainable code and configurations following team standards for API design, data handling, error management, and security best practices.
* Contribute to technical documentation by keeping integration maps, data flow diagrams, and runbooks current so the team can operate and onboard efficiently.
* Support peers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and hands-on collaboration, raising the technical quality of the team's output.
* Monitor platform health and proactively flag performance issues, data anomalies, or integration failures before they impact marketing operations

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Qualifications**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of hands-on experience in marketing technology, enterprise systems engineering, or a closely related technical discipline have recent hands-on work building AI/ML systems
* Solid hands-on experience with Marketo, including program setup, smart list logic, API integrations, lead lifecycle configuration, and data management.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront, including workflow configuration, template management, and automation for marketing or creative operations.
* Experience building and maintaining lead management pipelines, including capture, enrichment, deduplication, and scoring.
* Demonstrated production experience with LLMs, RAG pipelines, vector search/embeddings, or recommendation systems — not prototypes, but systems that served real traffic
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, and JavaScript/Node.js, with experience owning AWS Lambda data pipelines from design to deployment.
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and modern ML tooling (e.g., MLflow, SageMaker, or equivalents)

**Bar Raiser Expectations**
This role is a Bar Raiser hire. The successful candidate will:
  
  

* Hold themselves and others to high standards of technical quality, data integrity, and operational accountability
* Demonstrate strong judgment when making platform and technical tradeoffs, especially those that affect campaign performance, lead data quality, or system reliability.
* Raise the performance of those around them through mentorship, rigorous code reviews, and clear documentation.
* Simplify complexity, translating ambiguous marketing requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions.
* Challenge assumptions respectfully and bring data into technical decisions.
* Leave every system, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

**AI Expectations**
Avalara is an AI-first company. This role is expected to be an
**AI Bar Raiser**
, not a casual user of AI tools, but someone who embeds AI into how MarTech work gets done and elevates the AI capability of the team.
  
  
**Specifically, This Role Is Expected To**

* Use AI to accelerate development and troubleshooting, including AI-assisted code generation, API debugging, and automated testing for MarTech integrations.
* Apply AI to lead intelligence, leveraging AI/ML-based lead scoring and intent signal processing to improve pipeline quality and Sales efficiency.
* Automate content and campaign operations using AI tools to reduce manual effort in asset creation, QA, and campaign setup within Marketo and Workfront.
* Identify and quantify AI-driven improvements, e.g., reduction in lead processing time, improvement in MQL-to-SQL conversion, or hours saved through intelligent workflow automation.
* Share AI best practices with the MarTech team and Marketing Operations, helping peers adopt AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Apply AI responsibly, with awareness of data privacy, governance, and ethical use standards relevant to marketing data and customer information.

Candidates who cannot demonstrate specific, measurable AI impact in prior roles do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

* Own the architecture and technical roadmap for Riveron’s enterprise data platform.

title: Team Lead - Collections
description:
**Job Description**

The Credit & Control Team Lead at NIQ is responsible for overseeing the credit management and control processes within the finance department. This leadership role entails managing a team focused on maintaining sound credit policies, performing credit assessments, managing receivables, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, a solid background in credit management, and the ability to foster a team environment that prioritizes accuracy and efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Credit Policy Management:**
  Develop, implement, and maintain credit policies and procedures that minimize risk and promote revenue growth
* **Team Leadership:**
  Lead and mentor a team of credit analysts and control team members, managing workloads, setting goals, and conducting performance reviews
* **Credit Risk Assessment:**
  Oversee the assessment of credit risk, approve credit limits, and monitor credit exposures to ensure compliance with internal guidelines
* **Accounts Receivable Management:**
  Ensure efficient management of accounts receivable and timely collection of monies owed. Implement strategies to reduce days sales outstanding (DSO) and improve cash flow
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
  Work closely with the sales and customer service teams to resolve credit issues and enhance customer satisfaction
* **Reporting and Compliance:**
  Generate regular reports on credit control activities and performance metrics. Ensure compliance with financial policies and regulatory requirements
* **Process Improvement:**
  Continuously identify and implement improvements in credit processes and technologies to increase efficiency and effectiveness

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field. Professional certification in credit management (e.g., CICM) is a must
* Minimum of 7 years of experience in credit management or a related financial role, including supervisory or leadership experience
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Strong knowledge of credit-related laws and regulations, as well as proficiency in financial software and Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel
* **Analytical Skills:**

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Job Title: Business Analyst**

**Experience: 2 to 3 Years**

**Location: Pune**

**Position Overview:**

We are looking for a Business Analyst with strong experience in requirements analysis, requirements elicitation, and client collaboration. The ideal candidate will understand the client's

business domain, turn business needs into clear and testable requirements, and support design and delivery through wireframes, documentation, and UAT. The role needs a proactive communicator who keeps clients and internal teams informed and tracks tasks to closure without being asked.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Lead requirement gathering and elicitation with clients and stakeholders through workshops, interviews, questionnaires, demos and document reviews.

• Conduct domain analysis to understand the client's business, industry processes, user groups and regulatory context before defining solutions.

• Analyse requirements for completeness, consistency and testability, and identify gaps, dependencies and open questions early.

• Prepare and maintain BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flow diagrams and acceptance criteria.

• Create wireframes, mockups and functional flow diagrams to align stakeholders before design and development begin.

• Act as the day-to-day point of contact for clients by running requirement discussions, managing expectations, and obtaining requirement sign-offs.

• Collaborate with clients during demos and UAT, prepare UAT scenarios, track execution, and publish UAT reports covering test results, defect status, and sign-off readiness.

• Communicate proactively by sharing progress, risks, blockers, and decisions with clients and internal teams before they are requested.

• Track tasks and action items proactively in JIRA or project tools, follow up on pending client inputs, and keep status accurate and current.

• Manage requirement changes, maintain traceability, and flag the impact of new requests on scope and timelines.

• Work closely with development, QA, and design teams to clarify business logic and acceptance criteria.

• Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and Scrum ceremonies.

**Required Skills & Competencies:**

• 2 to 3 years of experience as a Business Analyst in an IT services or software product environment.

• Strong skills in requirements analysis and elicitation techniques such as interviews, workshops, observation, and document analysis.

• Ability to learn a new business domain quickly and ask the right questions.

• Hands-on experience with wireframing tools (Figma, Balsamiq, or similar).

• Experience preparing UAT test cases, tracking UAT, and writing UAT reports.

• Confident client-facing communication, both written and verbal, with good stakeholder management skills.

• Strong ownership and follow-through, with a habit of proactive updates and task tracking.

• Good understanding of SDLC and Agile/Scrum methodologies.

• Working knowledge of APIs, data flow, and system integrations; exposure to Postman or Swagger is a plus.

• Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, MS Office / Google Workspace.

• Ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Educational Qualification:**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Business analysis or Agile certification (ECBA, CCBA, CSM, PSPO, etc.) will be an added advantage

* Candidate will work as the Lead Architect for the value stream and will be working in Agile Philosophy. He/She will be a member of cross-functional IT delivery team that includes business analysts, developers and testers.

**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
  
  

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work as a Lead Business Functional Analyst and application owner for the learning technologies used in the Bank.
* Undertake detailed business analysis and act as a point of Subject Matter Expert knowledge to provide and document clear and concise understanding of the HR business processes

* Responsible for understanding and documenting accurately and comprehensively technology current and target state architectures

* Good understanding of the HR Business Processes, technology data flows and dependencies.

* Ability to self-manage a book of work and ensure clear transparency on progress with clear, timely, communication of issues and adequate reporting to the relevant stakeholders
* Capability to interact successfully in a virtual, multi-vendor and multi-cultural environment
* Experience with Software Development experience (SDLC) methodologies like Agile.
* Good understanding of risk management process and governance process
* Experience in applying critical business analysis techniques to deconstruct complex business workflows
* Good analytical skills.
* Proficient communication skills.
* Keeps pace with technical innovation.

* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

**Job Summary**
We are seeking a Business Analyst to bridge the gap between business needs and technology solutions. title: CX Analyst & Product Insights  (B2C, Tier-1) (GB04)
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  

We’re building a central Design Thinking function at Bajaj Finance - a team that will play a defining role as the organisation pivots into a direct-to-consumer company. This role sits at the intersection of data and human understanding, and thrives in that grey zone.

You’ll be the person who can stare at a funnel and see a human story. Who can sit with a field research readout and spot what’s missing. Who treats data not as an answer, but as a better question - and turns both into something the team can act on.

**What Your Work Looks Like-**

**You’ll operate across the Design Thinking lifecycle — from signal to solution:**

* Insight & Evidence: Journey analytics, Mining session replays, heatmaps, and behavioural data to surface where customers struggle and why. You bring statistical rigour — you know the difference between a pattern and noise, between correlation and causation, and you know when to trust the data and when to trust instinct.
* Challenge & Synthesis: You consume field research from dedicated research teams and stress-test it. You triangulate digital signals against qualitative findings, competitive benchmarks, and business metrics to build problem statements that hold up under scrutiny. You craft How Might We statements from clustered signals — framing the right questions that give the team a clear direction to solve against.
* Prototyping & Testing: You participate in solutioning — helping the team move from problem to prototype, designing tests, and closing the loop between what was hypothesised and what customers actually do.

**What Makes Someone Right for This-**

* 4–8 years in consumer insights, CX analytics, product analytics, UX research, or a similar role in B2C or consumer-facing companies, where you’ve worked across quantitative and qualitative inputs
* Comfortable in analytics platforms — session replay, web/app analytics, funnel analysis, segmented and cohort analysis. Can layer behavioural data over system-of-record data to move beyond surface-level insights. Specific tools matter less than your ability to get depth from any tool quickly
* Understands statistical thinking — hypothesis testing, significance, when to apply rigour and when to move on intuition
* Can read, challenge, and build on qualitative research even if you’re not the one conducting it — you know what good methodology looks like and can spot when a finding is thin
* Structures findings into clear, concise arguments. You’ve presented to senior stakeholders and know the difference between showing data and making a case
* Thinks in systems — you connect a drop-off at step 3 to an upstream design choice, a policy constraint, and a downstream business metric without being told to
* SQL-literate — you can pull what you need or speak to data teams in their language
* Brings critical reasoning that stress-tests assumptions rather than confirming them

Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong Consumer Insights / CX Analytics / Product Insights profile (behavioral/user/product/UX analytics)
* Mandatory (Experience 1) - Must have 4+ years of experience in Customer Experience (CX) Analytics, Consumer Insights, Product Analytics, Behavioral Analytics, or UX Analytics, working on B2C digital products (Web/App) with a focus on understanding customer behavior, customer journeys, and experience improvement.
* Mandatory (Experience 2) - Must have hands-on experience analyzing customer journeys, behavioral funnels, digital interactions, session-level behavior, clickstream data, and experience metrics to identify pain points, drop-offs, and optimization opportunities.
* Mandatory (Experience 3) - Must have experience using CX and Digital Experience Analytics platforms such as Medallia, ContentSquare, Google Analytics (GA4) or similar tools for customer behavior analysis, journey mapping, and insight generation.
* Mandatory (Experience 4) - Must have experience working closely with Product, Design, CX, Business, Marketing, and Research teams to generate insights, validate hypotheses, and drive customer experience improvements.
* Mandatory (Experience 5 ) - Strong working knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction, querying, analysis, exploratory data analysis, automation, and behavioral data interpretation. Ability to independently analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable business insights.
* Mandatory (Experience 6): Understanding of hypothesis-driven thinking and basic experimentation/A/B testing concepts, including interpreting results and distinguishing between correlation and causation.
* Mandatory (Gender) - Only Female candidates are considered.
* Mandatory (Age)—The candidate's age should be below 28 years
* Preferred ( Experience 1) - Candidates from product-based companies (B2C preferred) OR Data Analytics Service companies like Mu Sigma etc

Experience: 3–7 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days

Benefits
  
  

Our people define our passion and our audacious, incredibly rewarding achievements. Bajaj Finance Limited is one of India’s most diversified Non-banking financial companies, and among Asia’s top 10 Large workplaces. If you have the drive to get ahead, we can help find you an opportunity at any of the 500+ locations we’re present in India.

title: Analyst II, Gross-to-Net (GTN)
description:
**Company Description**
IntegriChain is the data and application backbone for market access departments of Life Sciences manufacturers. We deliver the data, the applications, and the business process infrastructure for patient access and therapy commercialization. More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data-driven decision support. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators are digitalizing labor-intensive processes – freeing up their best talent to identify and resolve coverage and availability hurdles and to manage pricing and forecasting complexity.
  
  
We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in: Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your mission at IntegriChain:**
Gross-to-Net is the gap between a drug’s list price and the net revenue a manufacturer realizes after rebates, chargebacks, discounts, and fees. Grss-to-Net is central to how pharmaceutical companies forecast, report, and plan.
  
  
As a GTN Analyst II, you will support multiple external clients by reconciling transactional data, validating pricing calculations, explaining variances, and producing the reports they rely on to meet contractual deadlines. You will work across our GTN systems and Excel, partner with colleagues in Pune and remote teams in the U.S. and build expertise in pharmaceutical revenue management.
  
  
**Working hours:**
This is a hybrid role based in Pune. Because you will work closely with U.S.-based clients and managers, the role requires some overlap with U.S. Eastern working hours
  
  
**What you’ll do to thrive in this role:**

* Data and reconciliation

+ Gather client transactional data, reconcile it to the general ledger, and load it into the source system.
+ Identify and resolve errors in the GTN system according to defined business rules, applying corrections as needed.
+ Monitor and review system output for consistency, accuracy, and formatting.

* Reporting and delivery

+ Produce client deliverables and reports from system results and explain the variances behind them.
+ Meet contractual SLAs by planning and prioritizing your workload around fixed deadlines.
+ Escalate issues promptly when they fall outside defined business rules or put a deadline at risk.

* Process and collaboration

+ Keep process documentation and work instructions current and aligned with RACI standards.
+ Build strong working relationships with internal colleagues and remote team members across multiple locations.

**Where You’ll Grow:**

* As you build confidence in the core role, you will cross-train in adjacent areas of Net Revenue and Compliance, as appliable:
* Government Pricing (GP): transactional and master data, GL reconciliations, and data extraction across client, internal, and external systems, fundamentals including Class of Trade (COT), PHS 340B validation, and monthly pricing calculations.
* State Price Transparency Reporting (SPTR): reporting requirements and the U.S. state regulations behind them: portfolio setup, reporting activities, and preparation of client deliverables.

**Qualifications**
**What you’ll bring to the table:**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Information Management, or another business discipline.
* 2–4 years of experience in financial analysis, reporting, accounting, or a related field.
* Experience producing financial reports, with strong Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, and large datasets) and working knowledge of MS Office.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including comfort working with large data volumes and complex financial models.
* Sharp attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy in data and reporting.
* A process-oriented, organized approach to planning work across multiple client accounts.
* Clear written and spoken English, with the confidence to collaborate with cross-functional and U.S.-based teams.
* Ability to pick up new software and systems quickly.
* Initiative to support value add projects and drive process improvements

**Nice to have**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
* Working knowledge of Managed Care, Medicaid, GPO contracting, or Government Pricing.
* Familiarity with GTN calculations and revenue recognition in the pharmaceutical industry.

Additional Information
  
  
**What does IntegriChain have to offer?**

* Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives!
* Excellent and affordable medical benefits + non-medical perks including Flexible Paid Time Off and much more!
* Robust Learning & Development opportunities including over 700+ development courses free to all employees

IntegriChain is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, Depend®, and Kimberly-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly-Clark, it’s all here for you: innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.

In this role, you will deliver recurring governance processes, prepare data-driven performance insights, manage action plans, and help identify and implement risk countermeasures, savings, cost avoidance, operational excellence, and process improvements.
