title: Big Data / PySpark Engineering Lead - Vice President
description:
The Applications Development Technology Lead Analyst is a senior level position responsible for establishing and implementing new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to lead applications systems analysis and programming activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Architecture & Design**

* Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant batch and real-time data processing pipelines.
* Develop robust data models and schema designs optimized for both performance and storage efficiency.
* Evaluate and integrate emerging tools and frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink, Kafka) into the existing stack.
* Provide in-depth analysis with interpretive thinking to define issues and develop innovative solutions
* Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, such as architecture and infrastructure, integrate to accomplish business goals

**Data Modernization & Migration Leadership**

* Legacy Systems Decommissioning: Lead the strategic migration of data and logic from legacy platforms (e.g. on-premises SQL Servers) to a modern Data Lakehouse environment.
* ETL/ELT Transformation: Re-engineer existing stored procedures and complex legacy ETL jobs into scalable, distributed processing frameworks using Spark (Python) and Starburst/Trino.
* Validation & Parity Testing: Design and implement automated frameworks for Data Parity Testing to ensure 100% accuracy and consistency between legacy outputs and new big data results.
* Schema Evolution: Map and transform rigid, legacy relational schemas into flexible, high-performance formats optimized for the cloud (e.g., Parquet, Avro, or Iceberg).
* Phased Cutover Management: Orchestrate a phased migration strategy (Parallel Run, Shadow Execution) to ensure zero downtime for downstream business applications and reporting tools.
* Performance Benchmarking: Establish performance baselines on legacy systems and ensure the new Big Data architecture meets or exceeds those benchmarks at scale.
* Resolve variety of high impact problems/projects through in-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and industry standards
* Engineering Excellence
* Write clean, high-performance code in Python.
* Optimize complex SQL queries and fine-tune distributed computing clusters to reduce latency and costs.
* Ensure data integrity and security by implementing rigorous validation and encryption standards.
* DevOps & Reliability
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and deployment of data jobs.
* Monitor system health and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks across the data lifecycle.
* Leadership & Strategy
* Provide technical mentorship and conduct code reviews for junior and mid-level engineers. Serve as advisor or coach to mid-level developers and analysts, allocating work as necessary.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical specifications.
* Collaborate with Product Managers to ensure data availability for downstream analytics, business models and users
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process improvements

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Highly experienced and skilled technical lead with 12+years of experience with software building and platform engineering.
* Experience in Data Engineering, focused on Big Data ecosystems.
* Knowledge in Hadoop, YARN, Hive, Impala, Spark, and Spark SQL with extensive high volume of data processing pipeline development. Programming Expert level and hand on experience in Python.
* Familiarity with data formats like Avro, Parquet, CSV, JSON.
* Hands-on experience in writing SQL queries.
* Highly experienced with Unix based operating systems and shell scripting.
* Experience with source code management tools such as Bitbucket, Git etc.
* Big Data Tech Proficiency and hands-on in Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Kafka, and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, HBase).
* Experience working with query engines like Trino, Presto, Starburst
* Strong computer science fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, databases, and operating systems.
* Reverse Engineering, ability to read "spaghetti" SQL or old scripts and document the business logic before moving it.
* Data Lineage, Experience using tools (like Collibra or Informatica) to track where data comes from and where it’s going.
* Change Management, Experience managing the technical "shock" to the business when switching from legacy BI tools to modern query engines like Starburst.

**Preferred Qualities**

* Problem Solver: You don't just fix bugs; you identify the root cause to prevent recurrence.
* Communicator: You can explain the "why" behind a technical decision to non-technical stakeholders.
* Automation and AI Mindset: You believe that if a task has to be done twice, it should be automated. Familiarity with AI tools to expedite deliveries.

* Data-driven with the ability to analyze and optimize campaign performance.

reviews or other forms of UGC.

The OOH Planning & Operations Analyst will support the end-to-end planning, execution, and reporting of Out-of-Home (OOH) media campaigns. The role requires strong attention to detail, coordination with media partners, and the ability to manage planning documentation, RFPs, estimates, contracts, and campaign deliverables accurately and within agreed timelines.

• Create and issue contracts through Domedia, ensuring required documentation and approvals are in place.

• Develop and maintain production grids, including campaign timelines, deliverables, and partner requirements.

• Prepare quarterly Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) reports and support data consolidation as required.

• Create and update POP documentation, recommendations, proposal materials, and presentation decks.

• Maintain accurate records in trackers and ensure planning, partner, and campaign information is up to date.

• Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external partners to resolve questions, dependencies, or discrepancies.

• Ensure adherence to process guidelines, quality standards, naming conventions, and delivery timelines.

**Required Skills and Experience**

• Experience in media planning, media operations, OOH planning, or media investment.

• Understanding of OOH campaign planning, partner coordination, RFP processes, estimates, contracts, and campaign execution workflows.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple deliverables simultaneously.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills for internal and partner coordination.

• Ability to work independently while proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and follow-up actions.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

**Tools and Platforms**

• MBOX • Domedia • UniLive • POP Tracker • Microsoft Excel • Microsoft PowerPoint Preferred

**Qualifications**

• A full-time graduate degree (Mandatory)

• Prior experience supporting OOH media campaigns or media investment processes.

• Experience working with media partners, creating RFPs, and managing campaign documentation.

• Familiarity with contract workflows and media planning tools is preferred.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**About Company**

DeHaat, a leading Agri-Tech startup, offers end-to-end solutions to India's farmers using AI technologies. With a presence in 12 states, 18,000+ DeHaat Centers, and 500+ FPOs, we impact 13 million+ farmers. Our AI crop advisory covers 30+ crops in regional languages & we export to 30+ countries. Founded by top institute alumni, DeHaat is fully funded, achieving consecutive
*Great Place to Work certifications*
. Recognized by NASSCOM, Forbes, ET, Niti Aayog, and Bill Gates Foundation, our 13-year journey reflects impactful innovation in the agricultural sector.

**Website:**
https://agrevolution.in/

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a Business Analyst with 1–4 years of experience to partner with business teams and drive financial planning, profitability analysis, working capital management, and business performance reporting. The role requires strong commercial acumen, analytical capability, and exposure to export-oriented, manufacturing, or food processing businesses. The incumbent will support strategic decision-making through insights on margins, costs, pricing, cash flows, and operational performance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Business Planning & Analysis

* Prepare annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and monthly business projections.
* Monitor performance against budgets and identify key variances and improvement opportunities.
* Analyze revenue, margins, profitability, and cost drivers across products, customers, channels, and geographies.
* Support management with commercial insights for strategic decision-making.

Business Partnering

* Collaborate with Sales, Procurement, Supply Chain, Operations, and Commercial teams to improve profitability.
* Evaluate pricing strategies, export margins, customer profitability, and product-wise contribution.
* Support new market entry, product launches, capacity planning, and commercial negotiations through robust analysis.
* Partner with processing teams to review conversion costs, yield, wastage, and operational efficiency.

Export & Commercial Analysis

* Track export sales, foreign currency exposures, and realization cycles.
* Monitor export incentives, duty benefits, and government schemes applicable to agri exports.
* Analyse landed costs, freight, cold-chain expenses, logistics costs, and route-wise profitability.
* Support evaluation of export contracts, pricing, credit terms, and commercial viability.

Working Capital & Cash Flow Management

* Monitor receivables, inventory, and payables to improve cash conversion cycles.
* Support optimization of working capital across procurement, production, and sales cycles.
* Prepare cash flow forecasts and ensure adequate liquidity for business operations.
* Review inventory ageing, wastage, shelf-life risks, and working capital efficiency.

MIS, Reporting & Dashboards

* Prepare monthly business review presentations and management dashboards.
* Develop KPIs related to sales, procurement, production, inventory, wastage, margins, and profitability.
* Provide actionable recommendations based on performance trends and business insights.
* Strengthen and automate reporting through Excel, Power BI, and ERP-based MIS.

Controls & Compliance

* Ensure adherence to internal controls, commercial policies, and business processes.
* Support statutory audits, internal audits, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with accounting and reporting teams to ensure accurate and timely business information.

**Qualifications:**

* Chartered Accountant (CA), Cost Accountant (CMA/ICWA), or MBA in Finance.
* 1–4 years of relevant experience in business analysis, FP&A, commercial analysis, or business performance management.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Exposure to manufacturing, food processing, agri-processing, FMCG, or export-oriented businesses.
* Understanding of export documentation, forex transactions, and international trade processes.
* Experience in budgeting, forecasting, margin analysis, pricing, and working capital management.
* Familiarity with production costs, yield analysis, procurement cycles, and inventory management.

**Skills Required:**

* Strong analytical, modelling, and problem-solving skills.
* Advanced Excel and Power BI/MIS reporting skills.
* Working knowledge of SAP or other ERP systems.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, seasonal, and operations-driven business environment.

****Job Summary:****
Designs, improves, and installs integrated manufacturing or administrative systems which use people, materials, information, equipment, and energy.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****
Leads work studies for new and current production lines. Leads standard work methods for new and current production lines. Leads the work for specific projects to create and implement all aspects of a manufacturing processes to ensure safety requirements, manufacturing goals, business goals, and product specifications are met. Leads by applying the knowledge or use of manufacturing principles and practices to improve manufacturing equipment and processes. Maintains the application of Cummins standards and develops manufacturing standards. Leads the communications with and influences key external stakeholders, business leaders, and functional members. Works with internal and external resources on specific project assignments. Leads the advanced knowledge of manufacturing principles and practices as they are applied to Cummins. Maintains relationships and coaches key stakeholders.
  
  
****Competencies:****
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Ergonomic Fundamentals - Understands ergonomic concepts by applying Cummins ergonomic standards, guidelines, controls and tools to reduce ergonomic risk to employees while at work.
  
  
Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.
  
  
Line Balancing - Evaluates work activities performed by individuals or machines to identify opportunities to optimize operating time and distributing of the work content to meet the changes in customer demands while continuing to optimize manufacturing processes.
  
  
Manufacturing Analysis Led Design - Uses digital tools to model and simulate manufacturing processes, equipment and performance to make data driven decisions before changes are made and to drive continuous improvements.
  
  
Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.
  
  
Process Layout - Creates and/or modifies an optimized manufacturing process by incorporating knowledge of equipment, human interfaces, sequences of production steps, and facilities requirements in order to reduce process time and waste.
  
  
Work Measurement - Quantifies and evaluates the elements of work that make up a process by breaking it down into detailed steps to identify and reduce waste, and redistribute work content to optimize process flows.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Continuous Process Improvement - Recognizes areas in which a process can be improved by properly implementing process improvement and waste reduction methodologies to reduce process cost and improve quality in current manufacturing processes.
  
  
Drawing Interpretation - Integrates product design and manufacturing equipment engineering drawings to support the design and development of an optimal manufacturing process that meets product design specifications.
  
  
Industrial Engineering Knowledge - Integrates the pillars of industrial engineering techniques by applying a comprehensive and quantitative analysis to available data to be used as decision factors for the development or improvement of manufacturing processes to contribute to the most efficient process.
  
  
****Education, Licenses, Certifications:****
College, university, or degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) or related field, or equivalent experience required.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
****Experience:****
Intermediate level relevant work experience required.

**Job Description**

Overview

If you enjoy working at the intersection of learning, data, technology, and customer experience, this role is for you.

Help shape the future of customer learning at NIQ. NIQ is transforming how customers learn, adopt, and get value from our data, products, and platforms. In this role, you’ll help use data and insights to shape digital learning experiences that support NIQ’s large, global FMCG and T&D clients as they move from onboarding to confident product adoption.

Work on visible, strategic initiatives. You’ll contribute to global, leadership-visible client learning initiatives, including the implementation of a new Learning Experience Platform. From defining meaningful measures of success to analyzing learner behavior and identifying adoption opportunities, you’ll play a hands-on role in building a modern, global learning ecosystem. Collaborating across Product, AI, Technology, UX, and content teams, your work will directly support strategic initiatives that bring NIQ’s innovative client learning solutions to life at a global scale.

Grow future-ready skills. If you’re someone who enjoys exploring data, experimenting with new tools, and turning insights into practical solutions, this role offers the opportunity to build hands-on experience with learning analytics, digital adoption, AI-enabled tools, learning platforms, and business intelligence. You bring a strong foundation in adoption and engagement initiatives, and a passion for using data-informed insights to make learning simpler, smarter, and more scalable.

**Responsibilities**

Learning Analytics, Adoption & Platform Operations

Data-informed insight, adoption, and continuous optimization of NIQ’s learning ecosystem.

* Support the implementation, configuration, testing, and launch of a new Learning Experience Platform (LXP), including reporting, measurement, and ongoing optimization.

* Partner with stakeholders and technology teams to develop learning dashboards, reporting, KPIs, and recurring performance analyses.

* Analyze learner engagement and behavior to identify adoption gaps, areas of friction, and opportunities to improve the learner experience.

* Translate learning and platform data into clear, actionable recommendations for experience improvements, personalization, adoption initiatives, and continuous optimization.

* Contribute to ongoing platform administration, including content governance, setup, publishing, and QA tasks in the LXP and related systems to ensure quality and consistency.

* Contribute to support issue resolution by troubleshooting learner access, tracking, and related learning platform issues to maintain a reliable learning experience.

title: Senior Product Manager, Analytics and Agentic Platform
description:
****About The Role****
PubMatic is building the next generation of AI-powered products for digital advertising, including intelligent agents that help customers monitor marketplace performance, identify new opportunities, troubleshoot issues, make recommendations, and take action. We are also evolving our data visualization, reporting, and analytics platform that publishers and partners rely on to understand their performance.
  
  
We are looking for a highly technical, customer-oriented Product Manager to lead our Agentic Platform and AI strategy while driving the roadmap for our analytics and reporting platform. This role owns the foundational capabilities that enable teams across PubMatic to build, evaluate, deploy, and operate production-grade AI agents, and leads strategic customer-facing AI and analytics experiences that turn complex marketplace data into actionable intelligence.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of Generative AI, agentic systems, advertising technology, data, and product experience. You will partner closely with engineering (onshore and offshore), design, and commercial teams, and with DSPs, ad networks, agency trading desks, exchanges, publishers, and audience/data providers, to turn emerging AI capabilities into scalable products that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes.
  
  
****What You'll Do****
**AI and Agentic Platform**

* Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for PubMatic's shared AI and Agentic Platform, enabling teams company-wide to build and operate production-grade AI agents.
* Own platform capabilities including agent orchestration, model and tool integration, context and knowledge management, evaluation frameworks, observability, governance, and reusable agent infrastructure.
* Lead the strategy and development of publisher- and marketplace-facing AI experiences that transform complex marketplace data into actionable intelligence.
* Build rigorous evaluation methodologies combining offline evaluation, golden datasets, LLM-based evaluation, human review, experimentation, and production telemetry.
* Define success metrics across AI quality, customer adoption, task completion, business impact, latency, reliability, and cost.

**Data Visualization, Reporting & Analytics**

* Define, develop, and execute the vision, roadmap, and requirements for PubMatic's data visualization, reporting, and analytics platform.
* Develop clear, compelling PRDs and user stories for new initiatives and enhancements, including business justification, revenue potential, and operational impact.
* Monitor product adoption, proactively identify opportunities, and make actionable recommendations to drive uptake and effectiveness.

****Common Responsibilities****

* Validate product direction through customer and internal stakeholder interaction and by analyzing market and product trends.
* Create and maintain a prioritized product backlog.
* Work closely with UX and engineering teams to guide development and testing.
* Partner with Sales, Services, and Product Marketing on training, collateral, and product rollout, and evangelize PubMatic offerings internally and to prospects and the installed base.
* Own the full product lifecycle, from opportunity identification and strategy through requirements, experimentation, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.

**We'd Love for You to Have**
**Required Qualifications**

* 6-8+ years of Product Management experience, including 1-2 years of hands-on experience leading technically complex agentic platforms and building AI agents in production, and experience in data visualization, analytics, or business intelligence.
* Strong understanding of modern AI application architecture, including LLMs and reasoning models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation and knowledge systems, agent orchestration and tool use, AI evaluation and experimentation, prompt and context engineering, and observability and production monitoring.
* Demonstrated ability to identify business problems and strategic, revenue-generating opportunities.
* Demonstrated ability to partner deeply with engineering and AI teams, making thoughtful product and technical tradeoffs.
* Experience taking ambiguous, zero-to-one products from concept through production and measurable adoption.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to define metrics and evaluation frameworks for probabilistic AI systems.
* Firm sense of accountability and ownership for the end-to-end product lifecycle.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate between technical teams, customers, and senior leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2-5 years of experience in the online advertising industry, including ad tech, programmatic advertising, and marketplaces.
* Experience building enterprise AI products where reliability, governance, privacy, security, and explainability are critical.
* Familiarity with agent interoperability standards and architectures, such as MCP, agent-to-agent communication, structured tool calling, and multi-agent systems.

****Qualifications:****

* Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics or an Engineering discipline (e.g., Computer Science), or equivalent experience.

****Additional Information:****
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
****About PubMatic****
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
  
  
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

* Transition post go-live into the permanent Master Data Analyst role, owning ongoing data quality, customer creation and maintenance.

* Define data quality rules and cleansing requirements.
* Identify and resolve data gaps, duplicates and errors.
* Execute minimum two data migration test cycles.
* Reconcile MDT source data to S/4HANA target with 100% match required.
* Support data cut-over planning and rehearsal.
* Own go-live data readiness and sign-off on data quality.
* Document all data transformation rules and exceptions.

* Own customer master data creation and maintenance in S/4HANA.
* Load approved credit limits.
* Maintain payment terms and dunning configuration by customer.
* Monitor and resolve data quality issues.
* Manage duplicate account identification and merge activities.
* Validate customer bank details for refund processing.
* Support audit data requests.
* Maintain data quality KPIs.

* 5+ years of SAP master data experience.
* Customer master data experience, including XD01/XD02 or Business Partner (BP).
* Experience with data migration tools such as LSMW, LTMC or S/4HANA MDG.
* Data quality management and cleansing experience.
* Reconciliation and validation techniques.
* Strong Excel and analytical skills.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* High attention to detail and accuracy.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* S/4HANA data migration experience.
* AR-specific master data experience, including credit limits, payment terms and dunning procedures.
* Healthcare or medical devices industry experience.
* Experience migrating between SAP systems.
* SQL or data extraction tool experience.
* Understanding of GDPR and data protection.

title: Field Experience Engineer
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
  
  
**We are looking for**
**Field Experience Engineer**
**You’ll make a difference by**

* Act as the key analytical interface between headquarters, depots, project teams, engineering functions, and other stakeholders across Siemens Mobility Rolling Stock.
* Prepare and maintain project reports, including customer, supplier, performance, reliability, and management reports.
* Support the development, implementation, and follow-up of corrective and preventive action plans.
* Perform vehicle performance, reliability, and diagnostic analyses using field and operational data.
* Ensure high-quality field data through regular data validation, quality reviews, and plausibility checks.
* Conduct weak-point and trend analyses to identify improvement opportunities & drive reliability growth.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives for products, processes, methodologies, operational procedures.
* Serve as the focal point between sites and headquarters on reliability, availability, and fleet performance topics.
* Analyze field data, capture lessons learned, facilitate knowledge sharing, and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.
* Support operational, tactical, and strategic fleet/product monitoring across multiple platforms.
* Train and coach end users on CMS/CMMS systems, data management practices, and analysis tools.
* Foster effective cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful project execution and customer satisfaction.
* Proficient in Cormap, RS CMS, SAP, Spotfire, Power BI, FRACAS, and 8D problem-solving methodologies.

**Desired Skills:**

* Graduate Engineer with a minimum of 10~12 years of experience in Field Experience Management, including at least 6~7 years in rolling stock engineering and fleet management. Knowledge of railway standards and regulations is an advantage.
* Strong process-oriented mindset with proven experience in analyzing, optimizing, and improving processes and systems.
* Good understanding of Siemens Mobility Rolling Stock processes; experience in rail vehicle projects is preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Agile and results-oriented, with the ability to manage priorities and work effectively under demanding project schedules.
* Capable of working successfully in an international, multicultural, and matrix organization environment.
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills; German language proficiency is an added advantage.

**Join us and be yourself!**
We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
  
  
**Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.**
This role is based in Pune. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.
  
  
Find out more about mobility at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:

**Job Description**
We are a global energy business involved in every aspect of the energy system. We are working towards delivering light, heat, and mobility to millions of people every day. We are one of the very few companies equipped to solve some of the big complex challenges that matter for the future. We have a real contribution to make to the world's ambition of a low-carbon future. Join us and be part of what we can accomplish together.

title: FPA VMC Analyst
description:
**About AkzoNobel**
Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.
  
  
For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com
  
  
© 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
**Role –**
The VMC FP&A Analyst reports to the BU FP&A VMC Team Lead and works closely with the BU Head, BU FP&A, R2R, Costing Analyst, IBP, ISC and Commercial Navigators / Controller, creating an impact by providing high value adding analysis on variable manufacturing cost (VMC) of the respective BU at various levels (BU, Performance Cell, Region, Country, Legal Entity, Site, Customer-Material to the ISC and Commercial association.
  
  
**VMC CoE End to End Scope:**
The VMC CoE Analyst collaborates with BU finance leadership to provide a detailed overview of VMC development, using advanced data platforms like CFIN, CRYSTAL, Power BI, Alteryx, and SAP BI. They identify cost variance drivers, conduct root cause analysis, and work with other pillars to implement corrective actions. The Analyst also supports future cost planning for critical pricing decisions.
  
  
As a reliable business partner, the Analyst identifies and flags process and system related issues, ensuring adherence to accounting standards and AkzoNobel’s P&L guidance (PLENT). They contribute to key projects and continuously improve processes through CI initiatives.
  
  
Candidates should be open to learning new skills and flexible in exploring new ways of working. AkzoNobel promotes a dynamic work culture with a focus on technology adoption to stay ahead of the curve. Analysts are expected to prioritize skill development to keep pace with market and competitor advancements, such as AI and Automation.
  
  
**Key Activities**

* Planning (QRF + Budget):
* Budget Preparation: Prepare budget templates, gather inputs, and load FLM data; run validation checks and resolve data issues.
* Rolling Forecast: Update drivers and post approved manual adjustments; ensure documentation and version control.
* Forecast Translation: Upload and reconcile forecast data in HFM; resolve validation errors under guidance.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Collect inputs from Demand, Data Science, Costing, and Procurement FP&A; track submissions to closure.
* Cost Trend Packs: Generate cost-trend reports vs PY/BUD/QRF; prepare variance tables and initial commentary.
* VMC Bridge Build: Consolidate inputs for PVM bridge and co-ordinate with HRT; validate mappings and ensure consistency with prior versions.
* Strategic Business Support:
* Variance Packs: Prepare MEC variance packs and waterfall charts; summarize drivers for review.
* A06 Preparation: Populate A06 templates; compare to prior periods and fix mapping issues.
* KPI Dashboard: Refresh KPI dashboards (VMC, VMC/L); run data-quality checks and highlight outliers.
* PVM Observations: Draft observations from PVM results for VMC Story telling.
* IBP Support: Compile IBP materials, update slides, record minutes and action owners
* Inventory Revaluation: Calculate RMPI-based forecast impact; maintain workings and assumptions repository.
* Data & Process Integrity (System hygiene, process hygiene):
* Data Hygiene Monitoring: Run exception/integrity reports; flag anomalies (e.g., not-in-use materials) to owners.
* RCA Support: Provide data extracts and trend summaries for RCAs; track action status.
* Gap Ticketing: Raise system/process gap tickets and follow up to resolution.
* Process Improvements:
* Product Cost Checks: Validate BOM/routing and cost splits; flag anomalies to costing.
* CI & Automation: Build macros/Power Query/Power BI measures; document steps and handover notes.
* System Reconciliations: Execute reconciliation scripts across HFM/CFIN/Crystal/SAP; log and categorize issues.
* Digital Tool Usage: Adopt approved AI/digital tools; provide structured feedback.
* Data Standards: Apply naming conventions and data definitions consistently.
* Project Support:
* Project Documentation: Maintain project trackers, timelines, and RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependency) logs for assigned initiatives.
* Data Provisioning: Extract, cleanse, and provision datasets for project charters and ad hoc analyses.

**Education**

* Proven work experience “5 to 7 years” in a strategic financial analysis role is essential.
* Qualified chartered or cost accountant or similar equivalent professional competency.
* Experience in large scale manufacturing industry/GBS/GCC. Leveraging deep industry knowledge to enhance financial analysis, cost management, and strategic planning.
* Focus on stakeholder management (e.g. BU Head of Finance, Head of FP&A, Reg Proc Director, Comm, ISC Navigators, Acc Controller, R2R, etc.) engaging to drive actions that support strategic objectives.
* Ensure accurate and timely reporting, optimize data processes, and provide strategic insights to support high-level decision-making (VMC FP&A team is collectively analyzing Variable Manufacturing Cost of around 6 billion €, BU wise ranging from 0.3 billion € to 1 billion €).
* In-depth knowledge of process order settlement and material ledger runs, familiarity with Inter Company (ICD) transactions, proficiency in managing material master attributes, strong analytical skills for financial reviews, and effective communication skills for managing price variations and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Possess in-depth knowledge of Financial & Cost accounting, Product costing, Transfer pricing, IFRS, Financial Statements, and System accounting flow, with a dynamic and innovative approach to problem-solving.
* Must have experience in a multinational company, demonstrating a proven track record of success. Ability to think outside the box and drive strategic financial initiatives.
* Support in managing external financial reporting & ensuring compliance. Responsibilities include preparing VMC Price Volume Mix reporting and Analysis “A06”.
* Proven experience in managing complex organizational setups. Responsibilities include overseeing intricate financial structures, ensuring seamless integration of financial systems, and optimizing processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

title: Lead Analyst Procurement
description:
**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
:

The Lead Analyst Procurement supports category strategy and sourcing activities across the allocated categories. The role contributes market insight, commercial analysis, and structured supplier support to ensure services are sourced and managed in a way that delivers measurable value, operational efficiency, and long-term performance – not only for the assigned categories. Applying category management best practices, the role supports spend analysis, supply market intelligence, industry benchmarking of pricing and service delivery models, supplier segmentation, and the development of sourcing strategies that balance cost efficiency with service quality and innovation. Working closely with the internal stakeholders, the role translates operational priorities into sourcing approaches and supplier solutions. Operating within a global procurement framework, the role supports consistent application of category strategy, sourcing governance, and supplier management practices, while leveraging digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to improve spend visibility and process efficiency. ESG and supplier diversity considerations are applied as part of broader sourcing decisions, in line with company policy.

**Major Responsibilities:**

1. Conduct spend data analysis and generate actionable insights, identifying cost drivers, spending patterns, supplier concentration, and opportunities for savings and improved contract coverage
2. Support the development and execution of category strategies incorporating spend analysis, supply market intelligence, and industry benchmarking of pricing, supplier practices, and service delivery models to inform sourcing direction and stakeholder recommendations
3. Analyze market trends, to identify solutions that meet business needs across the categories in scope
4. Contribute to measurable value creation through sourcing initiatives and supplier engagement that deliver cost savings, improved cash flow, stronger supplier performance, effective risk mitigation, and supplier-led innovation
5. Identify opportunities to optimize supplier footprint, service delivery models, and commercial structures
6. Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and ensure procurement activities support operational priorities
7. Support competitive sourcing processes including RFI and RFP, supplier negotiations, and contract award in line with company procurement policies and governance requirements
8. Assist in supplier performance monitoring through clear service expectations, performance reviews, and issue resolution to ensure reliable service delivery
9. Support contract management and supplier governance to ensure compliance with agreed commercial terms, service levels, and risk requirements, including data privacy considerations and appropriate regard for ESG and supplier diversity
10. Contribute to process simplification and supply base rationalization to reduce complexity, improve service consistency, and strengthen commercial leverage
11. Monitor category spend, supplier concentration, and contract coverage, leveraging digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to identify opportunities for cost control, efficiency, and risk mitigation

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Value delivered across the categories in scope including cost savings, cash improvement, service quality, and risk mitigation, benchmarked against industry standards
* Quality and actionability of spend data analysis, market intelligence, and industry benchmarking delivered to support category strategy and sourcing decisions
* Delivery of sourcing initiatives and contracts
* Supplier performance against agreed service levels including quality, reliability, responsiveness, and issue resolution
* Compliance with Procurement policy, contracting standards, and applicable regulations including data privacy and basic ESG requirements
* Continuity and reliability of critical services
* Timely execution of sourcing processes including RFI, RFP, negotiations, and contract implementation
* Supply base effectiveness including appropriate supplier coverage, service consistency, and managed risk exposure
* Effective use of digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to improve spend visibility and process efficiency
* Growing personal capability, engagement, and effectiveness within the Procurement team

**Qualifications**

**Education and Experience Requirements:**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Supply Chain, or a related field
* Working knowledge of data analytics tools such as Excel or Power BI as well as AI tools
* Working knowledge of procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba is a plus
* Foundational knowledge or coursework in project management is a plus

**Experience**

* Minimum of 5 years in procurement, strategic sourcing, or category management, including exposure to service-based categories, within global or multi-regional organizations
* Hands-on experience with spend data analysis and procurement analytics, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for category strategy and stakeholder recommendations
* Demonstrated experience supporting category strategies and sourcing initiatives that delivered measurable cost savings, cash flow improvement, stronger supplier performance, effective risk mitigation, and supplier-driven solutions
* Experience conducting market benchmarking, supply market intelligence, and spend analysis to inform sourcing direction and category strategy
* Commercial acumen and developing negotiation skills, with the ability to support competitive sourcing processes and evaluate commercial proposals, payment structures, and supplier agreements
* Financial analysis skills including Total Cost of Ownership modeling and basic cash flow concepts applied to supplier agreements
* Experience supporting supplier management and service contracts in global organizations, including performance tracking and SLA governance
* Good understanding of procurement systems and digital tools supporting sourcing, contracting, and spend management, including SAP Ariba or equivalent platforms, with the ability to leverage data to drive visibility and process improvement
* Basic awareness of data privacy requirements and ESG principles

**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

title: Deputy Manager - FP&A
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an Opex & Capex Financial Analyst to support the Vodafone Business International (VBI) function in managing opex and capex budgets. The individual will play a critical role in delivering high-quality financial reporting, analysis, forecasting and insights by partnering with regional finance teams and cross-functional stakeholders. This position suits someone who is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with complex data across a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Manage, review and report monthly opex and capex within defined timelines, ensuring accuracy and adherence to financial controls
* Partner with FinOps teams to deliver timely and accurate month-end results
* Provide variance analysis, commentary and insights to explain performance and inform business decision‑making
* Act as a financial translator for business leads by presenting clear commercial and analytical narratives
* Deliver baseline forecasting, working closely with regional teams such as HR and Sales
* Support annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, gap tracking and performance challenge discussions with business leads
* Handle large data sets from multiple systems, ensuring accuracy while meeting tight deadlines
* Independently manage multiple priorities and maintain strong stakeholder engagement across levels

* Experienced in operating within a multi-functional, complex matrix environment
* Curious, collaborative and someone who challenges traditional approaches to drive better ways of working
* Skilled at engaging with senior and non-financial stakeholders, with the ability to simplify complex financial concepts
* Proactive with experience driving change and implementing process improvements or complex financial projects
* Strong analytical thinker with financial modelling experience and exceptional attention to detail
* CA/CWA qualified (or equivalent) with 5–10 years of experience in Finance or Commercial analysis
* Proficient in Advanced Excel, SAP, Power BI and financial planning systems
* Clear and articulate communicator, both in writing and verbally

* Opportunity to collaborate with global finance teams across APAC and the Americas
* Exposure to international business operations and end‑to‑end financial planning cycles
* Scope to contribute to process transformation and efficiency improvements
* A role that strengthens stakeholder management, analytical reasoning, and strategic thinking capabilities

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced financial modelling and forecasting techniques
* Cross-regional stakeholder engagement and business partnering
* Use of enterprise finance tools such as SAP and Power BI in complex environments

title: Manager, Campaign Operations (L09)
description:
**Role Title**
:
**Manager, Campaign Operations (L09)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Support incident analysis and root-cause investigation for data defects, failed jobs and environment issues.
  
  
Contribute to Agile delivery through sprint execution, backlog refinement and collaboration within Scrum, Kanban or SAFe environments.

Previous experience within the telecommunications industry and SAFe Agile/Scrum environments is preferred.
  
  
Knowledge of AWS cloud infrastructure, automation framework design and scripting languages such as Python or Go is beneficial.

Risk and business-impact assessment.
  
  
Incident escalation and cross-functional response coordination.
  
  
Audit-ready cybersecurity incident documentation.
  
  
Stakeholder communication during complex and high-priority incidents.

title: Team Lead, ADM Ops
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
Addepar's Private Fund Look-Through (PFLT) offering gives clients deep visibility into the underlying holdings of their private fund investments by extracting holding-level data directly from GP financial statements—primarily the Schedule of Investments (SOI). This white-glove solution combines proprietary AI/ML extraction technology with human-in-the-loop review to ensure maximum accuracy and full portfolio transparency.
  
  
As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the
**PFLT Data Operations Team Lead**
is responsible for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts focused on reviewing, validating, and enriching complex fund holding data within target SLAs. This role acts as a domain subject matter expert, overseeing exception resolution, pipeline monitoring (Databricks, Retool, Monday.com), and data entity mapping. You will play a pivotal role in driving team performance metrics, leading ML model retraining initiatives, and collaborating across Product, Engineering, ML Operations, and Client Success teams.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage a team of PFLT Analysts & Senior Analysts, driving effective work allocation, daily queue management (Monday.com), and SLA compliance across peak quarter-end processing periods.
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Support operational workflows, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for private fund Look-through processing.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation across the pipeline.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting the team on complex Schedule of Investments (SOI) processing, special asset classes (e.g., crypto/token assets, real estate), and intricate fund accounting mechanics (e.g., PQ reconciliation, derived metric calculations, corporate actions).
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex extraction errors across pipeline stages and front-end verification checks.
* Perform quality control reviews and high-level audits to assist the team in correcting improperly extracted or mapped holdings data.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for data quality discrepancies, pipeline failures, and complex mapping issues (SOAP UI, GSM Search, PitchBook).
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and AIP teams to enhance operational efficiency by identifying extraction errors, curating edge-case datasets for AI model retraining, and refining pipeline tooling and UI (Retool/Databricks).
* Engage directly with clients, GPs, and Fund Administrators to resolve technical data inquiries, document discrepancies, and reporting edge cases.

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
* Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before go-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source-to-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data.
* Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design.
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth.
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery.
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap.

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

Finance Technology catalyst for technology and process transformation, enabling Finance teams to replace manual, non-compliant workflows with scalable, automated, and simplified systems across the bank.
  
  
Driving Innovation, efficiency and scalability through automation and Integration, these solutions enable Citi to comply with regulatory mandates and empower our businesses to achieve their goals, both current and long-term.
  
  
As part of Finance technology, our products and initiatives adhere to Citi’s strategic architecture principles and support the end-to-end integration of multiple global functions within the bank including Finance, Risk, and Controllers.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Technology Product Management Analyst is a strategic professional who owns defining our overarching product strategy, spearheading business engagement and transformation and contributing to directional strategy for AI, integration and automation capabilities.
  
  
Key responsibility will be defining Product vision, strategy and roadmap, develop solution proposals, business cases, solution design and tactics in engagement with Business and Technology stakeholders.
  
  
This role will be responsible for leading business process redesign, map existing and to-be processes for operational optimization, digital transformation initiative and change management.
  
  
With Data at the heart of everything we do, this role will require strong data analytical skills, tracing lineage of data, and developing conceptual and logical data models.
  
  
The role is expected to drive cross-functional collaboration and effective communication with business and technology partners, to guide, influence and convince others and lay the direction for Product development.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Understand requirements through partnership with business users, cross functional teams, and stakeholders.
* Ownership of the requirement backlog and roadmap, strategy, outlining the vision and direction for the product offering over time, to ensure users derive the most value possible from the product.
* Perform analysis and mapping to trace lineage of data and develop conceptual and logical data models.
* Collaborate with various teams and application owners to unify data concepts across finance applications across Citi.
* Appropriately assess risk and impact when business decisions are made, demonstrating consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing, and reporting control issues with transparency.
* Understand and anticipate user needs. Analyze gaps in capabilities, opportunities for optimization and efficiency and enhancing user experience, remediating risk, and control gaps.
* Provide evaluative judgment based on analysis of information in complicated and unique situations, where development of an approach/taking of an action involves weighing various alternatives and balancing potentially conflicting situations using multiple sources of information.
* Report control issues with transparency and take accountability of deliveries.
* Develop plans and execute functional strategies, requiring coordination and integration across units.
* Help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results, and assist in identifying and removing product development blockers.
* Coordinate UAT testing with technology and business users.
* Conduct data analysis to document business requirements at the right level.

**Must-have skills:**

* Strong understanding of Finance processes and data flows, record to report, Accounting, reconciliation, regulatory reporting and close process, with ability to interpret financial data. Familiarity with Financial products and asset classes, with an appreciation of how transactions flow from source product systems to financial reporting.
* Strong working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and their practical applications in business processes across financial services.
* Ability to critically assess where AI adds value vs, where traditional rule-based automaton / process improvements are more effective ensuring pragmatic and cost-efficient solutions.
* Data analysis, basic, SQL, Python will be added advantage.
* Process mapping and problem structuring, breaking down complex workflows into components.

title: Analyst– Research & Financial Analytics
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and intellectually curious professional to support strategic decision-making through deep financial, company, industry, and competitive analysis. The role requires the ability to transform complex datasets and market intelligence into actionable insights for senior leadership.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong financial acumen, structured problem-solving, excellent presentation skills, and the ability to independently drive research projects with minimal supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Analysis & Business Performance**

* Analyze financial statements and business performance metrics, including EBITDA, working capital, return ratios, efficiency ratios, margins, and valuations.
* Build revenue-to-margin bridges and identify key drivers impacting profitability.
* Reconcile financial variances and prepare management-level analytical reports.
* Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support business decisions.

**Company & Industry Research**

* Conduct in-depth research on companies, industries, and market ecosystems.
* Evaluate business models, competitive positioning, technological capabilities, regulatory environments, and growth opportunities.
* Assess industry attractiveness, market structure, pricing power, and profitability implications.
* Analyze operational metrics and connect them to financial performance.

**Competitive Intelligence & Benchmarking**

* Develop comprehensive competitor benchmarking studies.
* Compare peer companies across financial, operational, commercial, and strategic dimensions.
* Normalize datasets for accounting policies, reporting periods, currency impacts, and business models.
* Present actionable insights for strategic decision-making.

**Strategic Analytics & Insights**

* Integrate and reconcile large, fragmented datasets from multiple sources.
* Identify trends, opportunities, risks, and business implications through data-driven analysis.
* Support market sizing, market share estimation, demand-supply analysis, and industry structure assessments.
* Provide recommendations backed by robust analytical frameworks.

**Presentation & Executive Communication**

* Create high-quality executive presentations and strategy decks.
* Develop compelling storylines, key messages, and insightful visualizations.
* Translate complex analysis into clear and concise recommendations for senior management.
* Coach and guide team members on presentation quality and analytical output standards.

**Research Quality & Methodology**

* Critically evaluate market research sources and methodologies.
* Identify limitations, assumptions, and risks within research findings.
* Ensure analytical conclusions are appropriately supported by data and evidence.
* Establish sound research frameworks for strategic projects.

**Dashboarding & Reporting (Preferred)**

* Design and structure multidimensional dashboards for management decision-making.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define KPIs and reporting requirements.

**Qualification:**

* **CA with 3-4 years of experience**
  **OR**
* **MBA (Finance) with 8-10 years of relevant experience**
  in corporate strategy, industry research, equity research, investment research, ratings agencies, GCCs, consulting firms, or chemical/agri-business organizations.

We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Business Analysis
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
In this role, you will:
  
  
**The Avaloq Technical Business Analyst Will**

* Work with stakeholders to understand business goals, processes, scope, users, controls, and expected outcomes.
* Analyse requirements and translate them into clear Avaloq functional and technical requirements.
* Document current and future processes, business rules, data flows, interfaces, system dependencies, and operational impacts.
* Identify gaps between business needs and existing Avaloq functionality.
* Assess the impact of changes on Avaloq modules, configuration, customisation, integrations, data, reports, controls, and support processes.
* Recommend practical solutions that follow Avaloq standards and HSBC technology, risk, and control requirements.
* Work with solution architects and technical teams to define interfaces, data mappings, dependencies, and non-functional requirements.
* Support Avaloq configuration, customisation, workflow, and integration design.
* Produce functional specifications, technical requirement documents, process models, interface specifications, data mappings, and acceptance criteria.
* Support estimation by identifying scope, dependencies, delivery risks, and likely configuration, development, migration, and testing effort.
* Clarify requirements for developers, Avaloq specialists, testers, and vendors during delivery.
* Define test scenarios and expected results for functional, integration, regression, migration, and user acceptance testing.
* Analyse defects and production issues across Avaloq processes, configuration, custom code, interfaces, data, and connected systems.
* Support migration analysis, including data mapping, data quality rules, reconciliation, and migration validation.
* Assess the impact of regulatory, policy, and control changes on Avaloq processes and data.
* Work with Avaloq vendors and internal teams on enhancements, defects, releases, upgrades, and technical dependencies.
* Maintain traceability from the original requirement through design, implementation, testing, approval, and release.
* Communicate decisions, risks, dependencies, progress, and open issues clearly to both business and technical audiences.
* Help prioritise competing requirements and make practical recommendations when scope, timelines, or technical constraints conflict

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:
  
  
**Role profile**
The Avaloq Technical Business Analyst supports Avaloq change and delivery activities across HSBC locations and different system landscapes.
  
  
The role requires strong knowledge of the Avaloq Banking Suite, combined with the ability to understand banking processes and explain technical impacts. The successful candidate can challenge unclear requirements, identify dependencies, document complex processes, and help delivery teams reach a safe and workable outcome.
  
  
**Qualifications And Experience**

* 10+ Yrs of overall experience in technology and 5+ Yrs in executing projects using Avaloq skillset
* Strong hands-on experience with the Avaloq Banking Suite.
* Experience analysing Avaloq requirements for implementation, configuration, customisation, migration, upgrades, and integration.
* Practical understanding of Avaloq processes, product setup, workflows, data structures, interfaces, batch processing, and downstream systems.
* Experience taking Avaloq change requests from initial analysis through development, testing, implementation, and post-release support.
* Experience writing Avaloq functional specifications, technical requirements, interface definitions, data mappings, process flows, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience assessing the impact of Avaloq changes across connected systems, reporting, operations, controls, and regulatory processes.
* Experience working on major Avaloq implementation, migration, upgrade, or transformation programmes.
* Experience working with Avaloq vendors and understanding vendor standards, release processes, product constraints, and technical dependencies.
* Experience supporting functional, integration, regression, migration, and user acceptance testing for Avaloq solutions.
* Experience analysing defects and incidents involving Avaloq configuration, custom code, interfaces, data, or business processes.
* Experience with data migration, reconciliation, data quality, and migration validation in an Avaloq environment.
* Knowledge of transactional banking, securities, OTC trading, finance, lombard lending, and Private Bank products is an advantage.
* Understanding of banking controls, operational risk, regulatory requirements, and audit expectations.
* Ability to work with stakeholders across several banking domains.
* Ability to communicate clearly with business users, product owners, developers, testers, architects, vendors, and control functions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis and downstream impact assessment.
* Strong documentation and workshop facilitation skills.
* Ability to prioritise changing requirements and make pragmatic decisions.
* Ability to explain complex Avaloq, banking, data, and integration topics clearly in writing and verbally.

In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
The People & Purpose Reporting Services Analyst will be a key member of the People Operations team, providing Workday Reporting support for all employees Join our People & Purpose Reporting Services team, part of People Operations, where we help every employee and manager across Workday get the data they need. We work side-by-side with our People & Purpose Centers of Excellence — Recruiting, Talent Experience, Total Rewards, HR Partners, Learning, Compliance, Belonging and Diversity, and Global Mobility — to close gaps in data and build reports that help our leaders make informed, real-time decisions. We also build self-service tools so our partners can find answers faster on their own. If you enjoy connecting the dots across many parts of HR and turning complex data into something people can act on, you'll feel right at home here.

As a
**Reporting Analyst**
