You will own high-impact, ad-hoc reporting requests from start to finish, helping requesters shape raw data into a clear story they can bring to their own audience. title: Software Engineering Team Leader-Data License Analytics
description:
Location
  
  
Pune
  
  
Business Area
  
  
Engineering and CTO
  
  
Ref #
  
  
10054453
  
  
**Description & Requirements**
Bloomberg delivers billions of data points to hundreds of thousands of customers daily. When markets move, our customers need their data immediately and without fail. That's not a nice-to-have. It's the whole product.
  
  
The Data License Reliability & Analytics group exists to make sure that promise holds — and to make sure we keep it efficiently. Our new Pune-based DL Optimization & Automation team will build the AI tooling and the context layer that lets engineers, SREs, and AI agents across Data License reason about our systems the way our most experienced people do: which pipelines feed which products, where capacity is wasted, which risks are real, and what to fix first.
  
  
**Role**
In this role, you'll build and lead a team that puts AI to work on one of the most demanding data platforms in financial services. Your team will create intelligent systems that make Data License leaner, safer, and easier to run:
  
  
Smarter use of infrastructure — finding where compute, storage, and other system resources are over-provisioned or idle, and turning that insight into action.
  
  
Sharper data products — analyzing how the datasets in our Data License packages are built, delivered, and used, so we can keep improving what we offer clients.
  
  
Security, risk, and compliance on autopilot — automating the evidence-gathering, tracking, and reporting that keep us ahead of evolving regulatory and security requirements.
  
  
Maintenance that runs itself — finding the routine upkeep that consumes engineering time and handing it to machines.
  
  
Underpinning all of this is an AI context layer you'll help design: a living, machine-readable understanding of our systems, data, and dependencies that lets engineers and AI agents answer hard questions in minutes instead of weeks.
  
  
You will lead a team of four engineers, setting its technical direction and driving projects from idea to delivery. You'll work closely with engineering teams across Data License and Bloomberg infrastructure — as well as our reliability teams in New York and Dublin — turning their hardest operational questions into tools they rely on every day.
  
  
**What You'd Actually Be Working On**

* Building and leading the team. Build and grow a team of four engineers. Set a high bar for engineering quality and analytical rigor, run the team's planning and delivery, and create an environment where people ship useful things quickly and learn fast. You'll stay hands-on — this is a lead who writes code and reviews designs, not just one who runs meetings.
* The AI context layer. Design and evolve the knowledge foundation our AI tools stand on: architecture knowledge bases, semantic models and ontologies of our data and services, and knowledge graphs that connect code, configuration, telemetry, and incident history. You'll own retrieval quality across RAG and GraphRAG pipelines, decide how knowledge is structured, verified, and kept fresh, and make sure an agent's answer can always be traced back to a source.
* AI-driven optimization of systems, processes, and architecture. Turn one-off investigations into repeatable tooling. Build analytics that find underused machines and tenancies, unneeded storage and datasets, and architectural bottlenecks — and quantify the impact of acting on them. If we answered a question once by hand, you'll be figuring out how to answer it on demand.
* Agents and MCP tooling. Build MCP servers and AI agents that expose Data License systems and knowledge to engineers and to other agents, and use agent-to-agent (A2A) patterns to compose them into multi-step workflows. Work on context retrieval, prompt and tool design, evaluation frameworks, and the feedback loops that make these systems more accurate over time.
* Risk and compliance analytics. Own the automated analytics behind regulatory and risk programs such as emerging cyber-resilience regulation and enterprise risk management: scanning codebases and inventories, tracking remediation, and producing evidence that holds up to scrutiny from auditors and leadership.
* Tools people actually use. Build the web applications, dashboards, and reports (React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python) that put these insights in front of engineers, managers, and leadership, and make them self-service.
* Shaping the AI Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC). Help define how Data License builds software with AI agents — agentic development workflows, guardrails, and evaluation. Your team will be an early adopter and an example for the rest of the organization.
* Partnering across Data License and Bloomberg infrastructure. Marketing, building dashboards and analyses that help us understand where revenue is coming from and where

* Strong integration knowledge across PP (MRP, Shop Floor Control, Master Data), QM (Inspection Planning, In-Process and Final Inspection), IBP/APO (Demand and Supply Planning), PM (Equipment Maintenance and Scheduling)

title: Business Analyst
description:
Business Analyst - AI Platform

CLOUDLEX | JOB DESCRIPTION

**Location:**
Pune, India |
**Employment:**
Full time |
**Work mode:**
Work from office |
**Experience:**
3 to 5 years

About CloudLex

CloudLex is a leading cloud based legal technology platform for litigation firms in the United States. Headquartered in New York, with engineering, product, and marketing in Pune, India. Reaching 300 professionals globally. Backed by prestigious venture capital and growth private equity, including Aligned Capital, Rosepark Advisors, and The Riverside Company.

CloudLex is a connected ecosystem: the platform that United States litigation firms run their entire practice on, an AI layer built into it, and managed services delivered inside the case file.

The Role: Business Analysis for the Future

AI now writes requirements documents, user stories, and specifications in minutes, and writes them well. That frees the Business Analyst to focus on the harder part: deciding what should be built, understanding the workflow deeply enough to know where it breaks, and judging whether what the platform produces is accurate enough to go in front of a lawyer. You will own a product area, decide what gets built in it, and define how the platform behaves.

Your Role

Use AI to produce the work

* Draft business requirements, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria using AI, then review and correct them before they go to engineering
* Build AI workflows that capture requirements and constraints from existing sources: support tickets, call recordings, user feedback, and current documentation
* Set up AI assisted research on competitors, industry trends, and workflow comparisons
* Maintain a prompt and template library the whole product team can reuse

Analyze the product with data

* Define what needs to be tracked in each workflow and work with engineering to instrument it
* Write SQL queries and prompts to pull usage data, and use AI to speed up the analysis
* Produce a monthly read on how your product area is actually being used
* Recommend what to build next, with the usage data behind the recommendation

Define how the platform behaves

* Write acceptance criteria for both standard features and AI driven features
* Build test sets that check whether AI output is accurate and complete
* Define confidence thresholds, what the system does when it is unsure, and where a human must approve before anything reaches a case file
* Work with engineering and QA through the sprint until the feature ships

What you will learn here

* **Prompt engineering.**
  How to get reliable, repeatable output from a model, and how to tell when the prompt is the problem rather than the model
* **RAG, or Retrieval Augmented Generation.**
  How the platform feeds a model the right case context, and what that means for the specifications you write
* **AI agents.**
  How multi-step AI workflows are built, where they fail, and where a human checkpoint belongs
* **Data storytelling.**
  Turning usage data into an argument that changes what the team builds
* **Working Python.**
  Enough to pull data, run your own analysis, and build small tools without waiting for engineering

What we need from you

* 3 to 5 years as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or Product Manager, preferably in B2B SaaS
* Daily hands on use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini, with a clear view of where they fail
* SQL or equivalent. You should be able to pull data and reach a conclusion from it
* Strong written English. This role produces documents that American teams act on
* An example of a time you changed what the team decided to build, and were right

Please send one work sample with your application: a specification you wrote, an analysis that changed a decision, a test or evaluation framework, or something you built using AI tools. We read these, and they count for more than the resume.

Practical

* Pune, work from office
* Some overlap with United States hours is part of the role, and we would rather tell you now than after you join

title: Senior Process Analyst - Celonis
description:
**Job Title: Senior Process Analyst (Celonis)**
**Location(s):**
Pune
  
  
**Application Deadline:**
NA
  
  
**About Springer Nature**
Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. We are proud to be part of progress, working together with the communities we serve to share knowledge and bring greater understanding to the world. For more information, please visit about.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature.
  
  
**About The Brand**
Nature Portfolio’s high-quality journals and services across the life, physical, chemical and applied sciences help move science and society forward.
  
  
Nature Portfolio is home to the leading, international weekly journal of science, Nature – founded in 1869. It is also home to the Nature research and Nature Reviews journals, the leading open access multidisciplinary journal Nature Communications, and open access journals including Scientific Reports. Together, these journals publish some of the world's most significant scientific discoveries.
  
  
Online, nature.com provides over nine million unique visitors per month with content, including news and comment from the Nature journal, and the leading scientific jobs board, Nature Careers. As part of Springer Nature, Nature Portfolio also offers a range of researcher services, including online and in-person training. For more information, please visit nature.com and follow @NaturePortfolio.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Process Analyst to join our Celonis Team. This hybrid role spans Celonis front-end and back-end development — combining data engineering, process intelligence and automation delivery to drive measurable business value across enterprise functions. The role covers both the Data Analyst scope (Studio, Views, Knowledge Models, Action Flows) and the Data Engineer scope (Data Integration, pipeline design, data modelling), making it a senior, full-stack Celonis position.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities:**
**Celonis Technical Expertise —**

* Own end-to-end Celonis Studio development including PQL, Knowledge Models, Views, Action Flows, and Orchestration Engine workflows for both Case Centric and Object Centric processes.
* Build and customize Celonis apps, automations, and analytical dashboards to deliver actionable, data-driven insights — including process analysis leveraging Variant Explorer and OLAP components.
* Build AI-powered Celonis solutions using Process Copilot, Insight Explorer, and AI Annotation Builder to surface predictive insights and enable intelligent process automation.
* Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable data pipelines — using Data Jobs, Replication Cockpit, and Process Connector to connect Celonis to SAP, Salesforce, Marketo, SuccessFactors, and ServiceNow.
* Design event logs with correctly structured Activity and Case tables as the foundation of process mining data models; apply best practices in ETL/ELT to ensure data accuracy and transformation efficiency.
* Leverage Celonis Extractor Builder and Data Push API for custom source system integrations where Process Connectors are unavailable.
* Develop and enforce data quality and governance processes to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and integrity across all models. Apply Data Explorer for pipeline validation and troubleshooting.
* Provide ongoing support, troubleshooting, and maintenance for Celonis applications and data pipelines, ensuring high system availability.
* Optimize large-scale data processing systems for performance, scalability, and long-term reliability.

**Process Mining & Continuous Improvement**

* Act as Subject Matter Expert for process mining — applying deep domain knowledge to identify use cases, frame business value, and prioritize improvement opportunities.
* Lead the identification, scoping, and implementation of process improvement initiatives from discovery through to deployment.
* Define and track KPIs and success metrics to measure the impact of process improvement initiatives.
* Produce clear documentation of solutions, data models, and workflows to enable knowledge transfer and long-term maintainability.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment**

* Partner with process owners, business stakeholders, and data scientists to translate business requirements into scalable Celonis solutions and automated workflows.
* Work with integration and platform teams to connect automation solutions with existing enterprise systems, ensuring smooth data flow and interoperability.
* Communicate findings, recommendations, and solution designs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences including senior leadership.
* Support change management efforts by driving adoption of new automated workflows and process changes across impacted teams.

**Experience, Skills & Qualifications:**
**Essential**

* 5+ years in a process analytics / data engineering role
* Celonis Studio: PQL, Knowledge Models, Views, Action Flows, Orchestration Engine
* Celonis Data Integration: Data Jobs, Replication Cockpit, Process Connectors, OCPM
* Python scripting for data manipulation and pipeline automation
* Strong SQL / ETL-ELT data modelling skills
* Experience with SAP, Salesforce & other ERP systems data
* Proven end-to-end process mining project delivery
* Celonis Certified Data Analyst and/or Celonis Certified Data Engineer
* Familiarity with Agile / sprint delivery

*Desirable*

* Experience with Object-Centric Process Mining (OCPM)
* Prior CI / Lean Six Sigma exposure
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
* Familiarity with Celonis AI features: Process Copilot, Insight Explorer, AI Annotation Builder
* Experience with Process Designer / Process Navigator

**Springer Nature Skills associated with this Job Profile include:**
SN-Tech Savvy, SN-Process Optimization, SN-Manages Complexity, SN-Communicates Effectively, SN-Data Analytics/Quantitative skills, SN-Data Domain Savvy, SN-Data security & Governance, SN-Operational Excellence, SN-Process & Systems Design and, SN-Customer / User Requirements Discovery

31-10-2026

Over time, you will also develop into a recognized ESG Subject Matter Expert within the organization.

* Ensure data accuracy and quality to deliver reliable emissions calculations across all entities and KPIs.
* Collect, transform, and report ESG data from multiple stakeholders, including preparation for pre-closing, closing, and wrap-up activities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather ESG data, assess performance, and enhance ESG systems and processes.
* Lead and support the onboarding of new colleagues and entities into the ESG reporting framework.
* Prepare ESG reports, presentations, and communication materials for internal and external stakeholders, including investors, customers, employees, and NGOs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, Engineering, Sustainability, Finance, Business, or related field (Master’s degree or MBA preferred).

* Proficiency in data analysis with hands-on experience using ESG databases, SQL, advanced MS Excel, and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
* Excellent analytical, research, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex ESG information and provide actionable insights.
* Proven experience in project management, stakeholder engagement, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate ESG issues and solutions to diverse audiences.
* A self-starter with a proactive, results-oriented mindset, capable of working independently and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and sustainability.

title: Sr. Business Analyst
description:
Job Description

**Business Analyst - Lab Informatics**

Location

India (Pune) | Work from Office

About Excelra

Excelra is a science-led, data-driven outcomes company with more than 20 years of experience in the pharmaceutical and life-sciences sector. Our Lab Informatics practice combines deep scientific expertise — including a team of PhD-level researchers — with hands-on delivery experience across ELN, LIMS, SDMS, and data migration programmes for 16 of the top 20 global pharma companies.

We act as a trusted client advocate, representing our clients' best interests in all vendor and technology interactions. This role sits within our Lab Informatics delivery team, embedded in a global Revvity Signals implementation and migration programme.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with a strong background in pharmaceutical R&D and laboratory informatics to join our delivery team on an exciting and high-priority engagement. The programme covers the migration from Biovia ELN to Revvity Signals (ELN, LIMS, DLX, VitroVivo) across six global R&D sites, along with data migration from legacy systems and full GXP validation (E3 / CSA framework).

The BA will act as the primary liaison between the client's R&D scientists and the Revvity implementation team, ensuring that the system is configured to serve the scientists' real-world needs — not simply what the vendor delivers by default.

**Key Responsibilities**

Requirements Gathering & Process Mapping

* Engage directly with R&D scientists across chemistry, biology, and formulation disciplines to elicit and document current workflows and pain points.
* Translate scientific processes into structured IT and configuration requirements for Revvity Signals (Notebook, LIMS, DLX, VitroVivo modules).
* Map existing Biovia ELN and Cispro workflows to the target Revvity data model, identifying gaps and proposing solutions.
* Produce and maintain detailed requirements documentation, use cases, and process flow diagrams.

**Vendor & Programme Coordination**

* Serve as the client's advocate in all interactions with the Revvity implementation team, challenging vendor-led decisions where they do not serve the client's operational needs.
* Coordinate closely with the Data Migration Specialist (using the Intly AI migration tool) and the CSV/Validation Specialist to ensure requirements, migration, and validation streams are aligned.
* Participate in programme governance and status reviews, flagging risks and dependencies proactively.

**Change Management & Training**

* Develop change management plans for each site rollout, ensuring end-user buy-in and readiness prior to go-live.
* Design and deliver end-user training (scientists and lab managers) for the Revvity Signals platform across all six global sites.
* Create training materials, user guides, and quick-reference documentation in collaboration with the client's IT team.

**User Acceptance Testing (UAT)**

* Plan and facilitate UAT cycles at each site, ensuring test scenarios accurately reflect scientific workflows.
* Log, track, and drive resolution of defects and configuration issues identified during UAT.
* Obtain formal sign-off from site representatives ahead of each go-live.

GXP Compliance Awareness

* Work within a fully GXP-validated environment (100% of sites are GXP; E3/CSA approach adopted).
* Ensure all requirement changes and configuration decisions are appropriately documented to support IQ/OQ/PQ activities led by the validation specialist.
* Maintain traceability between user requirements, system configurations, and test evidence.

**Qualifications & Experience**

Essential

* Master's degree or above in a life-sciences field (Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Bioinformatics, or equivalent).
* 8+ years' experience as a Business Analyst in a pharmaceutical, biotech, or CRO environment, with direct exposure to R&D or laboratory functions.
* Hands-on experience with ELN or LIMS systems (Biovia, Revvity Signals, IDBS, LabVantage, or similar).
* Demonstrable experience conducting requirements workshops with scientific stakeholders and producing formal requirement documents.
* Familiarity with GXP-regulated environments and an understanding of validation concepts (IQ, OQ, PQ, UAT in a validated context).
* Strong communication skills — able to translate between scientific language and IT/vendor terminology with equal fluency.

Preferred

* Direct experience with Revvity Signals (Notebook, LIMS, or DLX modules).
* Exposure to data migration projects, particularly migrating from Biovia ELN or similar legacy ELN platforms.
* Certification in Business Analysis (ECBA, CCBA, or CBAP).
* Experience working in a vendor-agnostic advisory or consulting capacity on behalf of a pharma client.
* Familiarity with the E3 (Enterprise, Existing, Experienced) computer software assurance framework.
* Working knowledge of instrument integration concepts (LIMS/DLX connectivity, chromatography data systems).

title: Senior Business Analyst, AI
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
Business Analyst, AI
  
  
So, what’s the role all about?
  
  
NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. Your idea. Our spark.
  
  
As Business Analyst in the SPARK team, you will be the bridge between the people who have the ideas and the architects and builders who make them real. You will shape raw ideas into clear, prioritised, buildable use cases, and make sure what we build solves the problem it was meant to solve.
  
  
This is a business analysis role with a technical edge. You come from a programming background, so you can read code, query data, test an API, and prototype a quick proof of concept, and you can still run a room full of non-technical stakeholders. You will work closely with the Project Manager, the AI Architects & Builders, and the Change Management & Evangelist.
  
  
How will you make an impact?
  
  
You will own the front end of the incubation pipeline, from the first conversation about an idea through to accepted, measurable outcomes, working hands-on with business teams, architects, and delivery colleagues across regions.
  
  
Discover and Shape Ideas
  
  

* Run discovery sessions, interviews, and workshops with business teams to understand pain points, current processes, and the outcome they want
* Turn ideas into clear use case briefs covering the problem statement, users, expected value, data needs, risks, and success measures
* Assess and rank ideas against business value, feasibility, data readiness, effort, and risk, and give the team a clear recommendation on what to build next
* Build lightweight business cases, including estimated time saved, quality gains, and cost or revenue impact for presentation to Management and AI steering committee

Define What Gets Built
  
  

* Map as-is and to-be processes, and identify where an AI agent, an automation, or a human-in-the-loop step fits best
* Write user stories, acceptance criteria, and edge cases that architects and builders can build from without guesswork
* Specify expected AI behaviour: what the solution should do, what it should never do, when it hands over to a person, and how answers will be checked for quality
* Prepare test scenarios and evaluation datasets with the builders to measure accuracy, reliability, and usefulness before launch
* Update initiative register

Prototype and Validate
  
  

* Use SQL, Python, or low-code tools to analyse process data, test assumptions, and build simple prototypes that prove an idea before engineering effort is committed
* Review APIs and system documentation to confirm integration feasibility with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, and Microsoft 365
* Gather early user feedback on prototypes and turn it into prioritised backlog items

Support Delivery and Adoption
  
  

* Own and groom the product backlog, and take part in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives
* Plan and run user acceptance testing with business users, and manage defects and feedback through to closure
* Partner with the Change Management & Evangelist and the Support Helpdesk to turn user questions and feedback into clear improvements

Measure and Share Value
  
  

* Capture baseline metrics before launch and track results afterwards, so every solution can show real impact
* Understand the Software Development Lifecylse to review adoption, continuous business iteration and value realization.
* Maintain the use case library, requirement templates, and playbooks that make the next idea faster to shape

Have you got what it takes?
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

title: Analytics Manager
description:
**About Us**
Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and has been an industry pioneer for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.
  
  
With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.
  
  
Join us as we harness cutting-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.
  
  
To learn more about everything that Maersk does, visit us at www.maersk.com.
  
  
Are you ready to lead Ocean reporting while remaining close to the solutions that turn data into better decisions?
  
  
We’re looking for a
**Reporting Lead**
to join our centralized reporting team. In this role, you will functionally own this reporting portfolio, lead and develop reporting professionals, and ensure the delivery of high-quality, sustainable reporting solutions for the relevant business stakeholders.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Reporting Lead for Ocean, you will be accountable for the direction, quality, governance, and delivery of the reporting portfolio. You will translate business priorities into a clear reporting roadmap, align stakeholders, manage demand, and coordinate delivery across the team. You will lead team members through direct leadership, set standards, remove delivery obstacles, and build capability through coaching and hands-on guidance. The role is also expected to retain the technical depth of a Senior Reporting Analyst: you must be able to independently design, develop, troubleshoot, and improve advanced Power BI and Excel solutions when priorities, complexity, or capacity require it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Functional Ownership of the Reporting Scope
* Own the Ocean reporting portfolio, roadmap, standards, and delivery outcomes.
* Translate business priorities into a transparent, value-based backlog and make informed trade-offs across new development, enhancements, maintenance, and technical debt.
* Act as the primary functional point of contact for relevant stakeholders, aligning them on requirements, priorities, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.
* Drive standardization, governance, adoption, and lifecycle decisions across the reporting portfolio, including consolidation and decommissioning where appropriate.
* Accountable for the timely and accurate delivery of all reports within the reporting scope, including monitoring service levels, managing delivery risks, and ensuring appropriate stakeholder communication and escalation.
* Team and Delivery Leadership
* Lead reporting professionals directly or indirectly by setting clear priorities, coordinating work, and maintaining accountability for quality and delivery.
* Coach team members, provide technical and functional guidance, and support capability development and effective ways of working.
* Plan capacity, manage dependencies, and remove impediments to ensure reliable delivery against agreed commitments.
* Foster collaboration across reporting, data, finance, and business teams while promoting constructive challenge and continuous improvement.
* Hands-On Report Development
* Personally design and deliver advanced Power BI dashboards, semantic models, and Excel-based reporting solutions when required.
* Own complex developments end to end, from requirements and solution design through data modelling, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Write and optimize SQL queries and stored procedures for complex transformations, and use Python where appropriate to automate reporting processes or support advanced analytics.
* Review and troubleshoot solutions developed by others, ensuring sound design, maintainability, performance, and a consistent user experience.


**Technology and Innovation**

* Utilize Databricks, Dremio, and other platforms to build custom queries and reporting logic that strengthen reporting solutions.
* Develop standardized templates and reusable components to scale reporting.
* Introduce and champion new technologies to improve efficiency and scalability.


**Automation, AI and Maintenance Support**

* Support automation of recurring reporting tasks and refresh processes.
* Proactively identify opportunities to optimize reporting and reduce manual effort.
* Ensure all deliverables comply with documentation and governance standards.
* Identify and implement AI-enabled solutions to improve reporting efficiency, report development productivity, data validation, and user self-service capabilities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Proven experience functionally owning a reporting, BI, or analytics scope comparable to Ocean reporting including roadmap management, demand prioritization, stakeholder alignment, governance, and delivery accountability.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and develop a team directly or indirectly, with experience setting priorities, delegating work, coaching colleagues, and maintaining accountability for outcomes.
* Advanced hands-on expertise in Power BI, Excel, Power Query (M), and DAX, including the design of scalable semantic models and enterprise reporting solutions.
* Strong SQL skills and practical experience using Python for automation or analytics. Experience with platforms such as Databricks, Dremio, and Power Automate is an advantage.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and drive decisions.
* Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into clear priorities, scalable technical solutions, and user-friendly reporting deliverables.
* Sound understanding of reporting governance, quality assurance, documentation, adoption, and solution lifecycle management.
* Solid knowledge of financial statements, variance analysis, and budgeting and forecasting processes.
* Comfort working in an Agile environment and managing work through tools such as Jira.
* Champion the adoption of AI and emerging technologies across the reporting function, driving productivity improvements, process simplification, automation, and enhanced stakeholder experiences.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Typically 7+ years of relevant experience in BI, reporting, or analytics, including substantial hands-on report development experience.
* Previous experience leading people, a workstream, or a reporting portfolio, with clear accountability for delivery and stakeholder outcomes.

**What We Offer**

* A visible leadership role with the opportunity to shape Ocean reporting and influence how stakeholders access and use insights.
* A balance of functional ownership, people leadership, stakeholder engagement, and hands-on technical delivery.
* A dynamic, learning-focused environment with opportunities to develop reporting capabilities, modernize the technology landscape, and deliver business impact at scale.

**Join Us at Maersk**
If you combine reporting leadership with strong hands-on BI expertise and are ready to take accountability for Ocean Reporting, we want to hear from you. Apply now to join our team and help shape the future of reporting and technology enablement in the organization.
  
  
Join a company committed to innovation, excellence, and growth, where your expertise can truly make a difference.
  
  
**Apply today and help shape the future of Finance at Maersk.**
The role is based in any one of the following locations: Mumbai, Chennai, or Pune.
  
  
Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

title: Business Analyst - Pricing & Distribution (US Hotels)
description:
**Location: Yerwada, Pune. Work from office.**

**Hours: 4:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST.**

**Experience: 2 to 4 years.**

About Us: Atica is a leading, tech-first remote sales & revenue management company for Hotels and Hotel operators in the US, enabled by a unified tech-led solution. We are a startup, funded by the top investors in the country, like Titan Capital, DIBS. As innovators at the forefront of the industry, we strive to deliver the highest quality service to all our clients while setting new standards for efficiency and effectiveness. We aspire to build high-quality, innovative & robust software that makes an impact!

**Find more about us!**

https://www.aticaglobal.com

https://www.linkedin.com/company/atica-global

**The opportunity**

We are building our distribution vertical for scale. Our hotels sell through wholesalers, bedbanks, corporate and crew channels, day-use platforms and niche marketplaces. Each channel has its own rate structure and its own contract. The same room night can carry six different net rates at the same time.

Somebody has to own those numbers and decide which channel makes money for which hotel. That is this role.

**What you will do**

Decide which hotels should sell on which channels, and at what rate, and show the working.

Own the net rate cards: markups, commissions, parity and rate audits across 300 hotels.

Find the hotels and channels that do not sell, and say why.

Build the data layer behind these decisions, from the first spreadsheet to the dashboard the team uses every day.

Prepare the numbers behind every commercial position before it goes to a partner.

You work directly with the Director of Distribution. Your analysis goes to US hotel owners and to global distribution partners.

**Must have**

2 to 4 years in pricing, revenue management or business analytics. Hotels, OTAs, travel marketplaces or consumer internet.

Correct and fast arithmetic. You can work out net rates, markups and commissions without help.

Strong Excel: pivot tables, lookups, weighted averages.

You check your own numbers before you share them.

You can work 4:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST, on-site in Pune.

**Good to have**

SQL, Python, or a BI tool such as Metabase or Power BI.

Experience with hotel metrics: ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, BAR.

Experience building dashboards or automating reports.

Experience with US markets.

**Why this role**

You build a function, not maintain one. The first version of everything here is yours.

Direct exposure to the US market: hotel owners and global distribution partners.

We use AI tooling heavily, so you spend your time on decisions, not on manual work.

Pay among the best in Indian hospitality.

**How to apply**

**Apply here, or send your CV to siddharth@aticastays.com.**

title: Manager, Enterprise Risk Analytics (L09)
description:
**Role Title: Manager, Enterprise Risk Analytics (L09)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks & providing effective challenge. Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
  
  
Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit & Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Manager (L9), Enterprise Risk Analytics is an individual contributor role and will be responsible for providing reporting and visual analytics solutions based off the company’s Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) system. This role is a key driver in transforming raw risk data into clear, actionable, and visually compelling reports and dashboards primarily using Tableau. The role will have a dotted line of reporting to the AVP – Enterprise Risk Analytics (US) while directly reporting into the Enterprise Risk Analytics Team in India, which rolls up into Synchrony Financial India.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end development, implementation, and maintenance of advanced risk reports, dashboards, and visualizations primarily utilizing Tableau based on data extracted from the GRC system and related data sources
* Partner with the eGRC FA and DM teams to understand continuous upgrades and changes to the system and data that can affect downstream reporting
* Collaborate with senior leaders, risk managers, and governance functions to gather, understand, and translate complex business requirements into technical reporting specifications
* Present analytics findings and visualizations to stakeholders, clearly articulating the story behind the data to drive risk-informed decision-making
* Design and build data extracts and queries from the eGRC Data Mart to efficiently support complex risk analytics and reporting requirements
* Perform in-depth analysis of risk data to identify emerging trends, concentrations, and key risk indicators (KRIs) across the enterprise
* Perform other special tasks as needed

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with 2-4 years of relevant experience in coding, reporting, or analytics. Or else 4-6 years of coding, reporting or analytics experience in lieu of a degree.
* 2+ years’ hands-on experience with Tableau
* 2+ years’ hands-on experience with one or more data analytics tools like SAS/SQL an Python etc.
* Strong written/oral communication skills.
* Proven ability to deliver Analytical solutions for Business problems.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s Degree in a STEM related or Business field.
* Experience in consumer credit/risk analytics role
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, organize workflow, and prioritize work assignments
* Working knowledge and experience with GenAI in workspace
* Commercially effective and collaborative across teams and functions
* Intermediate EXCEL skill-set

**Eligibility Criteria**
Bachelor’s degree in any discipline with 2-4 years of relevant experience in coding, reporting, or analytics. Or else 4-6 years of coding, reporting or analytics experience in lieu of a degree.
  
  
**Work Timings:**
**02:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST**
(WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Manufacturing Experienced Professional - Production Planning & Scheduling
description:
**Would you like to be a part of successful team?**
**Role Purpose**
The Role will support the Global Drilling Services S&OP organization by transforming complex materials and operational data into scalable, automated, and actionable planning solutions.
  
  
The role will have a particular focus on repairable materials, sub-assemblies and capitalized inventory, connecting data across operations, AMO, Manufacturing and regional organizations.
  
  
Rather than relying on manual analysis and individual material reviews, the role will develop automated data models, dashboards and analytics capable of identifying planning gaps, determining inventory requirements and supporting proactive materials decisions at global scale.
  
  
SQL, Power BI and automation will be key enablers of the role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop scalable analytical models and automated solutions supporting global S&OP and materials planning processes, with particular focus on repairables, sub-assemblies and capitalized inventory.
* Connect and analyze data from SAP and other enterprise data sources, including material consumption, scrap, repair activity, circulation hours, installed/available asset population and inventory.
* Develop models to determine appropriate material and sub-assembly requirements based on asset population, historical consumption, utilization, repair behavior and operational demand.
* Build and maintain end-to-end Power BI solutions, including data extraction, transformation, data modeling, business logic, DAX and dashboard development.
* Use SQL to create scalable datasets and analytical models, reducing dependency on manual Excel-based analysis and repetitive data preparation.
* Develop automated planning alerts and exception-management mechanisms to identify material shortages, excess inventory, abnormal consumption, planning gaps and other conditions requiring action.
* Develop and progressively enhance predictive analytics supporting materials requirements and repairable inventory decisions.
* Maintain and improve analytical methodologies such as sub-assembly-to-asset ratios, ensuring planning parameters evolve with changes in fleet size, utilization and operational behavior.
* Improve visibility and control of capitalized inventory, supporting appropriate inventory positioning and utilization.
* Partner directly with Regional S&OP/Planning teams, AMO and Manufacturing to understand operational problems, validate assumptions and translate business requirements into analytical solutions.
* Work independently from an initially defined business problem to investigate data, identify root causes, develop potential solutions and implement sustainable tools with appropriate stakeholder guidance.
* Identify opportunities to standardize and automate existing manual processes across regions rather than developing isolated local solutions.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to S&OP and operational stakeholders based on the analytical models developed.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on SQL skills, including the ability to extract, combine, transform and analyze large datasets from multiple sources.
* Strong Power BI capabilities, with demonstrated experience developing solutions end-to-end, including Power Query/data transformation, data modeling, DAX and visualization.
* Experience developing automated and scalable analytical solutions, replacing repetitive manual processes with sustainable data-driven workflows.
* Ability to translate an ambiguous business problem into a structured analytical approach and independently drive the solution with limited guidance.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect operational behavior with materials and inventory requirements.
* Ability to work effectively across a global, cross-functional organization, interacting with regional teams, Manufacturing, AMO, S&OP and other functions.
* Fluent English and strong communication skills, including the ability to explain analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SAP data and materials-related processes. Deep SAP expertise is not required, but familiarity with SAP environments would be advantageous.
* Experience within Drilling Services, Oilfield Services or another asset-intensive industrial environment.
* Understanding of drilling tools, AMO/repair operations, manufacturing processes, repairables and sub-assemblies.
* Understanding of S&OP, materials planning, inventory management, MRP and/or supply-demand planning concepts.
* Experience with automation technologies such as Power Automate, SAP automation or similar workflow/automation platforms.
* Exposure to predictive analytics, statistical modeling or advanced demand/material requirement modeling.

title: Sr Business Analyst (Pharmacovigilance & AI Systems)
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Requirements Engineering**

* Elicit, document and maintain URS and FRS for each platform module, using structured workshops, process walkthroughs, system demonstrations and review of current SOPs, work instructions and conventions.
* Produce the supporting artefacts: as-is and to-be process maps, data-flow diagrams, user stories with acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, interface specifications and non-functional requirements (performance, availability, security, auditability, data retention).
* Build and maintain the Requirements Traceability Matrix from URS to FRS to design, test cases and validation evidence, so every requirement can be implemented and tested.
* Run requirement reviews with PV operations, Quality, IT Security, Data Privacy and Engineering; manage change control on approved requirements.
* Prioritize with the Product Owner, write release-level scope statements and support sprint planning and backlog refinement.

**Domain coverage**
You will specify requirements across the following modules, working with the respective PV subject-matter experts:
  
  

* Global and local literature search strategy management, database connectors (MEDLINE/PubMed, Embase and others), de-duplication, AI-assisted relevance screening and ICSR identification, full-text handling, reviewer workflow, hit-level audit trail, reconciliation and KPIs; alignment with GVP Module VI and local literature requirements.
* Multi-channel intake (email, portal, call centre, partner feeds, literature, social media), duplicate detection, AI-assisted data extraction from unstructured sources, MedDRA and WHODrug coding support, seriousness and expectedness assessment, narrative generation with human review, E2B(R3) submission, follow-up management, and integration with safety databases (e.g. Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety).
* Data sources (safety database, EudraVigilance, FAERS, literature), disproportionality and signal detection methods, signal validation, prioritisation, assessment and tracking workflows, signal-to-risk linkage, and documentation aligned to GVP Module IX.
* Data retrieval and reconciliation, line listings and summary tabulations, AI-assisted section drafting with locked source-to-text traceability, author and reviewer workflow, version control, schedule and submission tracking, aligned to 21 CFR 314.80 and ICH E2C(R2).
* Source and channel configuration, listening rules, AI classification of posts for potential adverse events, identifiability and validity criteria, PII handling, reviewer workflow and conversion to case intake, aligned to GVP Module VI and FDA guidance on internet and social media.
* PSMF support, audit-trail reporting and query, compliance dashboards (timeliness, quality, backlog), deviation and CAPA linkage, document and training evidence retrieval, and the ability to reproduce any AI-assisted decision on request.

**Agentic AI specifics**

* Define, for every agent in the platform, its role, inputs, tools, permitted actions and decision authority, and the human-in-the-loop checkpoints where a qualified person must review, approve or override.
* Specify AI output acceptance criteria with the SMEs: target precision and recall for screening and classification tasks, confidence thresholds for auto-routing versus human review, and how performance is measured and monitored in production.
* Write requirements for explainability and auditability of AI decisions: rationale capture, source citation, prompt and model version logging, reproducibility, and retention of the evidence an inspector would ask for.
* Specify guardrails: what agents must never do without human approval (e.g. submit an ICSR, close a signal, finalise a report), handling of low-confidence or out-of-distribution inputs, and fallback behaviour when a model or tool is unavailable.
* Define requirements for model lifecycle governance: evaluation datasets, change control for prompts and models, regression testing, periodic review, and restrictions on use of client data for model training.

**Regulatory, quality and privacy compliance**

* Translate the following into explicit, testable requirements and work with Quality on validation strategy:

+ 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11: electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, access control, data integrity (ALCOA+), system security, record retention and retrieval.
+ GDPR and other applicable data-protection laws: lawful basis, data minimisation, pseudonymisation, data-subject rights, cross-border transfer, retention and deletion, privacy by design; support Data Protection Impact Assessments.
+ GVP Modules (notably I, II, IV, VI, VII, IX) and ICH E2B(R3), E2C(R2), E2D, E2E as they apply to each module.
+ Computerised system validation: GAMP 5 (second edition), risk-based and Computer Software Assurance approaches; author or contribute to validation plans, functional risk assessments, test strategies and traceability.
+ Quality Management System requirements for product development: SDLC procedures, change control, deviation and CAPA management, supplier qualification, documentation standards; alignment with ISO 9001 and information-security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2).
+ Emerging AI-specific regulation and guidance (EU AI Act, FDA and EMA positions on AI in pharmacovigilance and GxP): assess applicability, track developments and reflect them in requirements.

* Act as the requirements-side point of contact during internal audits and client or regulatory inspections of the platform.

**Stakeholder and delivery**

* Work day-to-day with PV operations leads, medical reviewers, Quality Assurance, Data Privacy, IT Security, product management, UX, data scientists and engineers.
* Support UAT: author or review test scripts against the FRS, coordinate business testers, triage defects and confirm requirement coverage.
* Prepare release notes, user-facing functional documentation and training inputs for operations teams.
* Contribute to client-facing material describing how the platform meets regulatory expectations.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, medicine, computer science or a related field.
* 6+ years in pharmacovigilance or PV systems, with at least 3 years in a business analyst, systems analyst or product requirements role on GxP software.
* Demonstrated experience authoring URS and FRS (and ideally validation documentation) for PV or other regulated life-sciences systems.
* Working knowledge of at least four of the six domain areas above, gained in operations, a safety-system implementation or a technology vendor; hands-on familiarity with at least one commercial safety database (Argus, LifeSphere, Veeva Vault Safety or equivalent).
* Solid understanding of 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, data-integrity principles and GDPR, and of how they translate into system requirements.
* Experience working within a QMS and formal SDLC (change control, CSV/CSA, traceability, deviation handling).
* Practical understanding of how LLMs and AI agents work, their failure modes, and what it takes to make their output acceptable in a regulated setting. Prior involvement in an AI or automation project in PV is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical writing: you can produce a requirement that an engineer can build, a tester can test and an auditor can verify, without ambiguity.
* Comfortable with Agile delivery and tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.

**Preferred**

* Experience with E2B(R3) implementation, MedDRA and WHODrug coding, and EudraVigilance or FAERS data.
* Experience specifying NLP, machine-learning or GenAI features (classification, extraction, summarisation) including evaluation metrics and acceptance criteria.
* Familiarity with GAMP 5 second edition and the FDA Computer Software Assurance approach.
* Awareness of the EU AI Act and of EMA/FDA reflection papers on AI in the medicinal-product lifecycle.
* Prior participation in regulatory inspections or client audits of PV systems.
* Certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, or ISPE/GAMP training.

Business Analytics

Business Analyst

Director, Data Strategy & Analytics

Bhosari, Pune

As a Business Analyst / Use Case Lead at Lear, you will play a pivotal role in bridging business needs with technical solutions within the Palantir Foundry platform. Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) from a reputed institution.

* Minimum 6 years of experience in business analytics, data analytics, or a similar role.

* Proven ability to translate business needs into technical specifications.

* Familiarity with project tracking tools (e.g., Jira) and data visualization platforms.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Exposure to web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is a plus.

**Responsibilities:**

**Business Requirement Management:**

* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and document business requirements.
* Translate business needs into structured specifications for process flows, data pipelines, Ontology models, and Workshop applications.
* Ensure alignment between business logic and technical implementation.

**Project Tracking and Execution:**

* Manage timelines, milestones, and deliverables for data and application projects.
* Use collaborative tools to track progress and resolve blockers.
* Ensure alignment with program and product delivery phases.

**Dataset Validation and Business Coordination:**

* Coordinate with business users and data engineers to validate datasets.
* Facilitate data walkthroughs and feedback sessions to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
* Support data profiling and quality checks.

**Application Development Support (Workshop):**

* Collaborate with developers to design and test user-centric applications using Foundry’s Workshop.

**Automotive Process Alignment:**

* Apply domain knowledge of automotive operations (e.g., supply chain, manufacturing, quality, warranty) to ensure solutions reflect real-world business flows.

**Insight Generation and Visualization:**

* Use Foundry tools such as Contour and Quiver to explore data and extract actionable insights.
* Present findings through dashboards and narratives to support strategic decisions.

**Change Management and User Enablement:**

* Support user onboarding and training for new applications and workflows.
* Gather feedback and iterate on features to drive adoption and usability.

**Governance, Documentation, and Compliance:**

* Ensure documentation aligns with internal governance frameworks such as ITPM and Sarbanes-Oxley.
* Collaborate with IT and data governance teams to uphold data privacy and security standards.
* Motivates the immediate reporting staff for better performance and effective service and encourage team spirit.
* Coordinates with the senior and junior management of other departments as well, as every department in the organization is directly or indirectly associated with the finance department.

Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for Collections Strategy analytics to generate insights in strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring of complex, regulatory\-sensitive loss mitigation programs. The person in this role will participate in the design of challenger (test) strategies including eligibility criteria, opportunity sizing, performance monitoring, and on\-going strategy enhancement. The creation and delivery of presentations to cross functional audiences is essential. In addition, there is on\-going responsibilities for maintaining key performance reporting and strategy documentation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own loss mitigation program reporting and analytics: Create materials and lead monthly presentation to Collections Leadership. Create required quarterly OCC loss mitigation volume and performance presentation slides. Interpret performance and clearly present findings.
* Drive automation and perform ongoing validation/maintenance of new and existing loss mitigation reports; create automated reports with interactive data visualization intelligence.
* Proactively drive visual and content enhancements to loss mitigation program reporting for volumes and performance (e.g. advanced filters for due stage, channel, client, plan type, plan duration etc.).
* Support strategic initiatives by researching industry best practices, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to strengthen pre\-charge\-off loss mitigation efforts.

* Proactively communicate and engage across multiple levels, on the status of project progress and analytic priorities

This includes obtaining Working Group and Tollgate approvals, strategy sheet updates, requests to Strategy Delivery, and tracking pre \& post implementation validations (if applicable).
* Support in transitioning all existing and future loss mitigation strategy test performance monitoring to the Growth team
* Provide Analytics support to build best in class strategies for Loss Mitigation programs
* Evaluate new data elements, sources, industry best practices for collections
* Co\-lead or support cross\-functional project teams to consistently track performance. Perform analytics to understand performance changes and make enhancements to address degradation.
* Support OCC, Audit, NMT accuracy requests, regulatory requirements for all loss mitigation programs and ensure strategy documentation is comprehensive, accurate and up to date (i.e., audit ready).
* Participate in ad\-hoc projects and analyses, as needed, Other duties as assigned.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.
* 4\+ years’ experience in SAS, SQL, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, organizational and written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to make decisions and recommendations based on quantitative analysis and creative thinking
* Strong self\-starter balanced with desire to achieve team goals
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior Collection Strategy Development or Credit Strategy Development/ Risk Management experience and/or prior Collections experience in other functions
* 4\+ years demonstrated success developing and delivering advanced analytics solutions
* Data lake experience and strategies
* Master's degree in Business or in a Quantitative Related Field

title: Specialist - Commercial Controller (Retail Focus)
description:
Established in 2011 and headquartered in Pune, METRO Global Solution Center (GSC) India is a strategic hub driving METRO’s global transformation. With 1,200\+ professionals, we deliver specialized integrated expertise across Master Data Management, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Marketing \& Design, Strategy, Finance \& Accounting, Controlling (FP\&A), and People \& Culture (HR) solutions that drive operational excellence and digital innovation.
   

  

 By supporting METRO’s sCore strategy, we enable sustainable growth and strengthen business processes. With a solutions\-first mindset, we reduce complexity, accelerate transformation, and create measurable value for METRO businesses scaling up globally. METRO is a leading international food wholesaler operating in over 30 countries with a strong network of wholesale stores, digital marketplaces, and food service distribution. It supports businesses that keep the world running, from hotels, restaurants, and cafés to local retailers \- offering quality, reliability, and smart solutions that help small and medium\-sized businesses succeed.
   

  

 Headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany, METRO AG employs over 85,000 people worldwide and acts as the central management holding company of the group, driving strategic direction, and enabling consistent excellence across all markets. Around the world, METRO has approx. 15 million customers who benefit from the wholesale company’s unique multichannel mix: customers can purchase their goods in one of the large stores in their area as well as by delivery (Food Service Distribution, FSD) – all digitally supported and connected. In parallel, METRO MARKETS is being developed as an international online marketplace for professional customers, which has been growing and expanding continuously since 2019\.
   

  

 Acting sustainably is one of the company principles of METRO, which has been listed in various sustainability indices and rankings, including MSCI, Sustainalytics and CDP.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**P\&L Ownership \& Analysis**
* Full responsibility for departmental P\&L analysis across \~50 departments.
* Conduct weekly and monthly KPI reviews, including margin, supplier income, pricing effects, NWC, stock days, and payment terms.
* Perform in\-depth analyses across supplier, buying category, channel, and customer group dimensions.
* Ensure margin accuracy and alignment with Romanian accounting standards and MCC Romania requirements.


**Financial Planning \& Forecasting**
* Lead budget planning and execution for Offer Management department
* Prepare business cases for buying decisions with necessary approvals.
* Support special projects during month\-end (e.g., advance goods loading).


**Reporting \& Presentations**
* Prepare and present reports for weekly sales meetings and monthly board reviews.
* Provide commentary and insights for category managers and open forums.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting to local authorities (language dependency can be delegated).


**Data \& Systems Expertise**
* Proficient in SAP, advanced Excel, and VBA including the ability to read and modify scripts.
* Work confidently with complex data structures and perform advanced financial analyses.
* Experience with MS Access and Big Data environments would be considered an advantage.


**Cross\-functional Collaboration**
* Collaborate closely with Commercial, Ops, and IT teams.
* Actively participate in transition discussions and retrospectives.


**Language \& Local Knowledge**
* Romanian language proficiency preferred for local reporting and stakeholder engagement.
* Knowledge of the Romanian chart of accounts and local accounting regulations is highly desirable, although not a mandatory hiring requirement.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* University degree in Finance, Accounting, or Controlling.


**Experience**
* Proven experience in budget cycles and controlling.
* Previous experience in retail and stock management environments; experience with Tesco would be considered an advantage.
* Exposure to Romanian accounting systems and post\-LUCA implementation environments.


**Skills**
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and presentation skills.
* Advanced Excel and VBA capabilities.
* Ability to navigate complex metrics and systems.


**Mindset**
* Transition\-oriented, proactive, and detail\-focused.
* Adaptable to evolving systems and able to contribute added value.

title: Data Quality Officer
description:
**About The Role**
**As a
 **Data Quality Officer for HR \& Reference Data** 
 , you will be the key enabler in maximizing the value and trustworthiness of our most critical enterprise domains: our workforce information and core reference datasets.**
**You will act as a proactive partner, collaborating closely with business and technical teams. A critical part of your role is bridging perspectives—from HR business partners to IT architects—into clear, actionable data analysis.**
**Your mission is to resolve data issues and nurture a proactive prevention mindset across the organization. You will translate HR processes and Reference Data requirements into formal data quality policies, rules, and governance standards. By storylining data health metrics and serving as a data provocateur when needed, you will drive the continuous improvement of our core data foundation.**
****Key Responsibilities****
* Domain\-Specific Insight Generation \& Profiling:
+ Perform deep\-dive root cause analysis on HR datasets (e.g., employee lifecycle, payroll interfaces, org structures) and Reference Data (e.g., enterprise code tables, locations, job classifications, cost centers) to isolate systemic, process, or integration issues.
+ Conduct thorough data profiling on critical master and reference datasets to detect anomalies, cross\-system discrepancies, orphan records, and data drift.
+ Document findings and quantify the business impact of poor data quality on operational HR, compliance, reporting, and downstream integrations.

* Stakeholder Collaboration \& Standard Setting:
+ Work closely with HR Data Stewards, Data Governance, and IT to define, document, and enforce clear data quality rules and reference data standards.
+ Translate HR business rules and Reference Data governance policies into precise technical specifications for automated validation and monitoring tools.
+ Act as the primary liaison between business domain owners and technical teams, ensuring alignment on data lineage and data definitions.

* Monitoring, Reporting \& Governance:
+ Maintain domain\-specific Data Quality Dashboards (e.g., tracking HR data completeness, reference data synchronization) for clear visibility across business units.
+ Track and report HR and Reference Data quality KPIs to leadership, driving transparency and accountability.
+ Support reference data management processes, ensuring code values, mappings, and taxonomies remain synchronized across target applications.

* Remediation \& Prevention:
+ Collaborate with IT and HR Tech teams to define requirements for data cleansing, automated enrichment, and exception management.
+ Support business teams at the point of data entry/creation to improve source data quality and minimize manual workarounds.


****Your Profile****
* Boundary Spanner: Ability to connect HR business processes and enterprise reference data structures with backend technical architectures.
* Influencer \& Storyteller: Skilled at translating complex data anomalies into compelling narratives for HR leadership and business managers.
* Collaborator: A strong team player dedicated to building cross\-functional alignment across HR Operations, Enterprise Data Management/Governance, and IT.
* Mindset: Detail\-oriented, persistent, and proactive about driving data transparency and operational excellence.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, HR Analytics, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Data Quality Officer, Data Governance Analyst, or Data Steward, with direct experience handling HR data, Master Data Management (MDM), or Reference Data domains.
* Essential: Strong proficiency in SQL for complex data querying, profiling, and joining datasets across multi\-table environments.
* Hands\-on experience with modern HR Information Systems (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM) and Reference Data concepts (code lists, hierarchies, mapping tables).
* Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with global teams.


**Preferred Skills**
* Familiarity with Data Governance frameworks (Metadata Management, Data Lineage, Data Cataloging).
* Experience using scripting languages (e.g., Python) for automated data checks or profiling is a plus.
* Knowledge of global HR data privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, local DPDP regulations).
